## beardista-brew/CLAUDE.md

```
Beardista Brew
Web-based digital menu and customer analytics system for Beardista Brew (React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase).

Rules
Only read and edit the files I name in the task.
Keep the current design (colors, fonts, Tailwind classes).
This is a view-only digital menu: never add ordering, carts, checkout or order buttons.
Ask before installing packages.
No git commands (no commits, no pushes). I handle git myself.
Explain changes in 1 short line each, in simple words.
Always plan first in 5 bullets max, then wait for my OK before editing.
Mobile layout (phones, under 640px)
Apply to every admin page without changing desktop:

2 cards per row
Smaller padding and headings
Hide decorative extras (sparklines, captions, decorative icons)
Long lists use pagination, not long scrolling
Buttons and tap areas stay at least 44px tall
```

## beardista-brew/src/app/CustomerApp.jsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

// --- CUSTOMER DATA ---


// --- CUSTOMER COMPONENTS ---
import { Navbar } from '../components/Navbar.jsx';
import { Footer } from '../components/Footer.jsx';
import { Hero } from '../features/landing/Hero.jsx';
import { CustomerFavorites } from '../features/landing/CustomerFavorites.jsx';
import { WhatsBrewing } from '../features/landing/WhatsBrewing.jsx';
import { OurStorySection } from '../features/landing/OurStorySection.jsx';
import OurStory from '../features/landing/OurStory.jsx';
import { WhyChooseUs } from '../features/landing/WhyChooseUs.jsx';
import { BeardistaBlend } from '../features/landing/BeardistaBlend.jsx';
import { CustomerVoice } from '../features/landing/CustomerVoice.jsx';
import { StayConnected } from '../features/landing/StayConnected.jsx';
import MenuPage from '../features/menu/MenuPage.jsx';
import {
  customerFavoritesData,
  whatsBrewingData,
  whyChooseData,
  blendDetailsData,
  reviewsData,
  wifiData,
} from '../data/customerData.js';

// --- LIVE DATA (Supabase) ---
import { useMenuItems, useCategories } from '../backend/hooks/useMenu';
import { buildFavorites } from '../backend/mappers/menuMapper';
import { useEvents } from '../backend/hooks/useEvents';
import { buildFeaturedEvent } from '../backend/mappers/eventMapper';

// --- CUSTOMER MODALS ---
import { ItemDetailsModal } from '../features/menu/ItemDetailsModal.jsx';
import { SurveyModal } from '../features/landing/SurveyModal.jsx';
import { EventDetailsModal } from '../features/landing/EventDetailsModal.jsx';
import { StoryModal } from '../features/landing/StoryModal.jsx';


const PAGE_PATHS = { home: '/', menu: '/menu', story: '/our-story' };

/**
 * CustomerApp: the public-facing customer digital menu.
 */
export const CustomerApp = ({ onOpenAdminLogin }) => {
   const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  

  const currentPage =
    location.pathname.startsWith('/menu') ? 'menu' :
    location.pathname.startsWith('/our-story') ? 'story' : 'home';

  // Customer Favorites: real data from Supabase. While loading, on error,
  // or if no item is marked favorite, the sample data is shown instead.
  const { data: menuItems } = useMenuItems({ availableOnly: true });
  const { data: categories } = useCategories({ activeOnly: true });
  const liveFavorites = buildFavorites(menuItems, categories);
  const favorites = liveFavorites.length > 0 ? liveFavorites : customerFavoritesData;

  // What's Brewing event card: real event from Supabase. While loading, on error,
  // or when there is no running event, the sample event is shown instead.
  const { data: events } = useEvents();
  const brewingData = {
    ...whatsBrewingData,
    event: buildFeaturedEvent(events) ?? whatsBrewingData.event,
  };

  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState(null);
  const [isSurveyOpen, setIsSurveyOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEventOpen, setIsEventOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isStoryOpen, setIsStoryOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleExploreMenu = () => {
    navigate('/menu');
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const handleViewTsamporado = () => {
    setSelectedItem({
      id: 'tsamporado',
      name: whatsBrewingData.mustTry.title,
      category: 'Seasonal Feature',
      description: whatsBrewingData.mustTry.description,
      image: 'https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDcnRgPZvSAeWjuil3h6B2n2OeNmjdePD_56mCf8tbN27R8djWpb41wqtMsGBB33MYEq7MYoc_XEHazaMV5djUC4aj1tO7WGri2VDOrQCpwy9kfyTW4pIYbtD8y59TdVLEfgT2Ki2fRvmGUqh5cRCsPjEqBERczKKEpig7TaOjLdLq44MoClCswni8iPvsyuD3vwdh1i2k-mEzX34CSvsakhJcRy4hB49x3HF7RP_GpqHHKZ443mMC5eogBmmiYaFNL2_G9B2LFwlduvQ',
      details: whatsBrewingData.mustTry.details
    });
  };

  const handleNavigate = (page) => {
    if (page === 'admin-login' || page === 'admin') {
      if (onOpenAdminLogin) onOpenAdminLogin();
      return;
    }
    navigate(PAGE_PATHS[page] ?? '/');
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-dvh overflow-x-hidden bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#111111] flex flex-col antialiased ...">

      {currentPage === 'story' ? (
        <OurStory
          onNavigate={handleNavigate}
          onOpenSurvey={() => setIsSurveyOpen(true)}
        />
      ) : currentPage === 'menu' ? (
        <>
          <Navbar
            currentPage={currentPage}
            onNavigate={handleNavigate}
            onOpenSurvey={() => setIsSurveyOpen(true)}
          />
          <MenuPage
            onNavigate={handleNavigate}
            onSelectItem={(item) => setSelectedItem(item)}
          />
          <Footer onNavigate={handleNavigate} />
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Navbar
            currentPage={currentPage}
            onNavigate={handleNavigate}
            onOpenSurvey={() => setIsSurveyOpen(true)}
          />
          <Hero onExploreMenu={handleExploreMenu} />
          <CustomerFavorites
            items={favorites}
            onViewDetails={(item) => setSelectedItem(item)}
          />
          <WhatsBrewing
            data={brewingData}
            onRegister={() => setIsEventOpen(true)}
            onViewTsamporado={handleViewTsamporado}
          />
          <OurStorySection onReadMore={() => handleNavigate('story')} />
          <WhyChooseUs pillars={whyChooseData} />
          <BeardistaBlend details={blendDetailsData} />
          <CustomerVoice
            reviews={reviewsData}
            onOpenSurvey={() => setIsSurveyOpen(true)}
          />
          <StayConnected wifi={wifiData} />
          <Footer onNavigate={handleNavigate} />
        </>
      )}

      <ItemDetailsModal item={selectedItem} onClose={() => setSelectedItem(null)} />
      <SurveyModal isOpen={isSurveyOpen} onClose={() => setIsSurveyOpen(false)} />
      <EventDetailsModal
        isOpen={isEventOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsEventOpen(false)}
        eventData={brewingData.event}
      />
      <StoryModal isOpen={isStoryOpen} onClose={() => setIsStoryOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
};
```

## beardista-brew/src/app/routes/AppRoutes.jsx

```
import React from 'react';
import { Routes, Route, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CustomerApp } from '../CustomerApp.jsx';
import { AdminLogin } from '../../features/admin/auth/AdminLogin.jsx';
import { AdminPortal } from '../../features/admin/AdminPortal.jsx';
import { MobileAdminLayout } from '../../features/admin/mobile/MobileAdminLayout.jsx';
import { useAuth } from '../../backend/hooks/useAuth';

// Real session + active staff profile (logIn() already rejects disabled accounts).
const RequireAdmin = ({ isAuthed, isLoading, children }) => {
  if (isLoading) return <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">Loading...</p>;
  return isAuthed ? children : <Navigate to="/admin/login" replace />;
};

export function AppRoutes() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user, profile, isLoading, logOut } = useAuth();
  const isAuthed = Boolean(user && profile?.status === 'active');

  const openAdminLogin = () => {
    navigate('/admin/login');
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const logout = async (to) => {
    try {
      await logOut();
    } finally {
      navigate(to);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route path="/" element={<CustomerApp onOpenAdminLogin={openAdminLogin} />} />
      <Route path="/menu" element={<CustomerApp onOpenAdminLogin={openAdminLogin} />} />
      <Route path="/our-story" element={<CustomerApp onOpenAdminLogin={openAdminLogin} />} />

      <Route path="/admin/login" element={
        isAuthed ? <Navigate to="/admin" replace /> : (
          <AdminLogin
            onLoginSuccess={() => navigate('/admin')}
            onBackToCustomer={() => navigate('/')}
            onSwitchToMobileLogin={() => navigate('/admin/login')}
          />
        )
      } />

      <Route path="/admin" element={
        <RequireAdmin isAuthed={isAuthed} isLoading={isLoading}>
          <AdminPortal
            onSwitchToCustomerMenu={() => navigate('/')}
            onLogout={() => logout('/admin/login')}
            onSwitchToMobileView={() => navigate('/admin/mobile')}
          />
        </RequireAdmin>
      } />

      {/* TEMP: MobileLogin is a fake login (any password of 4+ characters, any 4-digit PIN).
          Sending phones to the real login until MobileLogin is wired to useAuth. */}
      <Route path="/admin/mobile/login" element={<Navigate to="/admin/login" replace />} />

      <Route path="/admin/mobile" element={
        <RequireAdmin isAuthed={isAuthed} isLoading={isLoading}>
          <MobileAdminLayout
            onLogout={() => logout('/admin/login')}
            onSwitchToDesktop={() => navigate('/admin')}
            onSwitchToCustomerMenu={() => navigate('/')}
          />
        </RequireAdmin>
      } />

      <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
    </Routes>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/backend/hooks/useAuth.js

```
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";
import {
  changePassword,
  getProfile,
  getSession,
  logIn,
  logOut,
  sendPasswordReset,
} from "../services/authService";

const AUTH_QUERY_KEY = ["auth", "current"];
const EMPTY_AUTH = { user: null, profile: null };

export function useAuth() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const currentAuth = useQuery({
    queryKey: AUTH_QUERY_KEY,
    queryFn: async () => {
      const session = await getSession();
      if (!session?.user) return EMPTY_AUTH;

      const profile = await getProfile(session.user.id);
      return { user: session.user, profile };
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const {
      data: { subscription },
    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      if (!session) {
        queryClient.setQueryData(AUTH_QUERY_KEY, EMPTY_AUTH);
      } else {
        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: AUTH_QUERY_KEY });
      }
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, [queryClient]);

  const loginMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ email, password }) => logIn(email, password),
    onSuccess: (auth) => queryClient.setQueryData(AUTH_QUERY_KEY, auth),
  });

  const logoutMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: logOut,
    onSuccess: () => queryClient.setQueryData(AUTH_QUERY_KEY, EMPTY_AUTH),
  });

  const passwordMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: changePassword });
  const resetMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: sendPasswordReset });

  return {
    user: currentAuth.data?.user ?? null,
    profile: currentAuth.data?.profile ?? null,
    isLoading: currentAuth.isPending,
    error: currentAuth.error,
    logIn: loginMutation.mutateAsync,
    isLoggingIn: loginMutation.isPending,
    logOut: logoutMutation.mutateAsync,
    isLoggingOut: logoutMutation.isPending,
    changePassword: passwordMutation.mutateAsync,
    isChangingPassword: passwordMutation.isPending,
    sendPasswordReset: resetMutation.mutateAsync,
    isSendingPasswordReset: resetMutation.isPending,
  };
}

```

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  getAnnouncements,
  getBaristaTeam,
  getFaqs,
  getStoreSettings,
  updateAnnouncement,
  updateStoreSetting,
} from "../services/contentService";

export const contentQueryKeys = {
  all: ["content"],
  announcements: (options) => [...contentQueryKeys.all, "announcements", options],
  baristaTeam: () => [...contentQueryKeys.all, "barista-team"],
  faqs: () => [...contentQueryKeys.all, "faqs"],
  storeSettings: () => [...contentQueryKeys.all, "store-settings"],
};

export function useAnnouncements(options = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: contentQueryKeys.announcements(options),
    queryFn: () => getAnnouncements(options),
  });
}

export function useUpdateAnnouncement() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, ...updates }) => updateAnnouncement(id, updates),
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [...contentQueryKeys.all, "announcements"],
      }),
  });
}

export function useBaristaTeam() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: contentQueryKeys.baristaTeam(),
    queryFn: getBaristaTeam,
  });
}

export function useFaqs() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: contentQueryKeys.faqs(),
    queryFn: getFaqs,
  });
}

export function useStoreSettings() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: contentQueryKeys.storeSettings(),
    queryFn: getStoreSettings,
  });
}

export function useUpdateStoreSetting() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ key, value }) => updateStoreSetting(key, value),
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: contentQueryKeys.storeSettings(),
      }),
  });
}

## beardista-brew/src/backend/hooks/useEvents.js

```
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  createEvent,
  deleteEvent,
  getEventById,
  getEvents,
  registerForEvent,
  updateEvent,
  verifyEventCode,
} from "../services/eventsService";

export const eventQueryKeys = {
  all: ["events"],
  lists: () => [...eventQueryKeys.all, "list"],
  list: (options) => [...eventQueryKeys.lists(), options],
  details: () => [...eventQueryKeys.all, "detail"],
  detail: (id, options) => [...eventQueryKeys.details(), id, options],
};

export function useEvents(options = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: eventQueryKeys.list(options),
    queryFn: () => getEvents(options),
  });
}

export function useEvent(id, options = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: eventQueryKeys.detail(id, options),
    queryFn: () => getEventById(id, options),
    enabled: id !== undefined && id !== null,
  });
}

export function useRegisterForEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: registerForEvent,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: eventQueryKeys.all }),
  });
}

export function useVerifyEventCode() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ registrationId, code }) =>
      verifyEventCode(registrationId, code),
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: eventQueryKeys.all }),
  });
}

export function useCreateEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: createEvent,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: eventQueryKeys.all }),
  });
}

export function useUpdateEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, ...updates }) => updateEvent(id, updates),
    onSuccess: (_event, variables) =>
      Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: eventQueryKeys.all }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: eventQueryKeys.detail(variables.id),
        }),
      ]),
  });
}

export function useDeleteEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: deleteEvent,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: eventQueryKeys.all }),
  });
}

```

    queryFn: () => getReviews(options),
  });

  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: submitReview,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [...feedbackQueryKeys.all, "reviews"],
      }),
  });
}

export function useToggleReviewPublished() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, isPublished }) => toggleReviewPublished(id, isPublished),
    onSuccess: () =>
      Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: [...feedbackQueryKeys.all, "reviews"],
        }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: feedbackQueryKeys.dashboardAnalytics(),

    queryKey: feedbackQueryKeys.surveys(options),

  return useMutation({

      submitSurveyResponse(surveyId, answers),
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: feedbackQueryKeys.all,
      }),
  });
}

export function useDashboardAnalytics() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: feedbackQueryKeys.dashboardAnalytics(),
    queryFn: getDashboardAnalytics,
  });
}

  categoryList: (options) => [...menuQueryKeys.categories(), options],
  items: () => [...menuQueryKeys.all, "items"],
  itemList: (options) => [...menuQueryKeys.items(), options],
};

export function useCategories(options = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: menuQueryKeys.categoryList(options),
    queryFn: () => fetchCategories(options),
  });
}

export function useMenuItems(options = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: menuQueryKeys.itemList(options),
    queryFn: () => fetchMenuItems(options),
  });
}

export function useCreateCategory() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: addCategory,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.categories() }),
  });
}

export function useUpdateCategory() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, ...updates }) => editCategory(id, updates),
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.categories() }),
  });
}

export function useDeleteCategory() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: deleteCategory,
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: menuQueryKeys.categories(),
        }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.items() }),
      ]);
    },
  });
}

export function useReorderCategories() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: reorderCategories,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.categories() }),
  });
}

export function useCreateMenuItem() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: addMenuItem,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.items() }),
  });
}

export function useUpdateMenuItem() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, ...updates }) => editMenuItem(id, updates),
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.items() }),
  });
}

export function useDeleteMenuItem() {

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: deleteMenuItem,
    onSuccess: () =>
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: menuQueryKeys.items() }),

export function useIncrementItemViewCount() {

  return useMutation({

    onSuccess: () =>

// src/lib/brevo.js

/**
 * Sends an email using Brevo's REST API.
 * @param {Object} params
 * @param {string} params.toEmail - Recipient email address
 * @param {string} [params.toName] - Recipient name
 * @param {string} params.subject - Email subject
 * @param {string} params.htmlContent - HTML content or template string
 */
export async function sendEmail({ toEmail, toName = '', subject, htmlContent }) {
  const apiKey = process.env.BREVO_API_KEY;
  const senderEmail = process.env.BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL;

  if (!apiKey || !senderEmail) {
    throw new Error('Missing Brevo API Key or Sender Email in environment variables.');
  }

  const response = await fetch('https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'accept': 'application/json',
      'api-key': apiKey,
      'content-type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      sender: {
        name: 'Project App',
        email: senderEmail,
      },
      to: [
        {
          email: toEmail,
          name: toName,
        },
      ],
      subject: subject,
      htmlContent: htmlContent,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorData = await response.json();
    throw new Error(`Brevo API Error: ${errorData.message || response.statusText}`);
  }

  return await response.json();
}

export function mapEventToDb(event) {
  const mapped = {};
  const fields = {
    title: "title",
    description: "description",
    location: "location",
    startTime: "start_time",
    endTime: "end_time",
    capacity: "capacity",
    status: "status",
    imageUrl: "image_url",
    isActive: "is_active",
  };

  for (const [source, target] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(event, source)) mapped[target] = event[source];
  }

  for (const field of ["start_time", "end_time", "image_url", "is_active"]) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(event, field)) mapped[field] = event[field];
  }

  return mapped;
}

export function mapEventRegistrationFromDb(registration) {
  if (!registration) return registration;

  return {
    ...registration,
    eventId: registration.event_id,
    userEmail: registration.user_email,
    fullName: registration.full_name,
    verificationCode: registration.verification_code,
    verificationAttempts: registration.verification_attempts,
    verificationExpiresAt: registration.verification_expires_at,
    verificationSentAt: registration.verification_sent_at,
    isVerified: registration.is_verified,

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Customer home page: "What's Brewing" event card.
// Picks the next event that is still running (not draft / cancelled / done)
// and returns the card shape. Returns null when there is none, so the page
// can keep showing its sample data.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const HIDDEN_STATUSES = ["draft", "cancelled", "canceled", "completed", "closed", "concluded"];

export function buildFeaturedEvent(events, now = new Date()) {
  if (!Array.isArray(events)) return null;

  const running = events.filter(
    (e) =>
      e.isActive !== false &&
      !HIDDEN_STATUSES.includes(String(e.status ?? "").toLowerCase())
  );
  if (running.length === 0) return null;

  // events arrive ordered by start time: take the next upcoming one,
  // or the most recent one if every running event has already started
  const upcoming = running.filter((e) => !e.startTime || new Date(e.startTime) >= now);
  const pick = upcoming[0] ?? running[running.length - 1];

  return {
    id: pick.id,
    tag: pick.tag || "COMMUNITY EVENT",
    title: pick.title,
    description: pick.description ?? "",
    buttonLabel: pick.button_label || "REGISTER & JOIN",
    location: pick.location ?? "",
    startTime: pick.startTime ?? null,
    endTime: pick.endTime ?? null,
    image: pick.imageUrl ?? null,
  };
}

export function mapReviewFromDb(review) {
  if (!review) return review;

  return {
    ...review,
    comment: review.comment ?? review.quote,
    customerName: review.customer_name ?? review.author,
    isPublished: review.is_published ?? review.status === "approved",
    createdAt: review.created_at,
  };
}

export function mapReviewToDb(review) {
  const mapped = {};
  if (Object.hasOwn(review, "rating")) mapped.rating = review.rating;
  if (Object.hasOwn(review, "comment") || Object.hasOwn(review, "quote")) {
    const comment = Object.hasOwn(review, "comment")
      ? review.comment
      : review.quote;
    mapped.comment = comment;
    mapped.quote = comment;
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(review, "customerName") || Object.hasOwn(review, "author")) {
    const customerName = Object.hasOwn(review, "customerName")
      ? review.customerName
      : review.author;
    mapped.customer_name = customerName;
    mapped.author = customerName;
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(review, "isPublished")) {
    mapped.is_published = review.isPublished;
  }
  return mapped;
}

```
import fallbackImg from "@/assets/beardista_brew.jpg";

export function mapCategoryFromDb(category) {
  if (!category) return category;

  return {
    ...category,
    sortOrder: category.sort_order,
    isActive: category.is_active,
    createdAt: category.created_at,
  };
}

export function mapMenuItemFromDb(item) {
  if (!item) return item;

  return {
    ...item,
    categoryId: item.category_id,
    isAvailable: item.is_available,
    isFavorite: item.is_favorite,
    viewCount: item.view_count,
    sortOrder: item.sort_order,
    createdAt: item.created_at,
  };
}

export function mapCategoryToDb(category) {
  const mapped = {};
  const fields = {
    name: "name",
    sortOrder: "sort_order",
    isActive: "is_active",
  };

  for (const [source, target] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(category, source)) mapped[target] = category[source];
  }

  if (Object.hasOwn(category, "sort_order")) {
    mapped.sort_order = category.sort_order;
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(category, "is_active")) {
    mapped.is_active = category.is_active;
  }

  return mapped;
}

export function mapMenuItemToDb(item) {
  const mapped = {};
  const fields = {
    categoryId: "category_id",
    name: "name",
    description: "description",
    price: "price",
    imageUrl: "image_url",
    isAvailable: "is_available",
    isFavorite: "is_favorite",
    viewCount: "view_count",
    sortOrder: "sort_order",
  };

  for (const [source, target] of Object.entries(fields)) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(item, source)) mapped[target] = item[source];
  }

  for (const field of [
    "category_id",
    "image_url",
    "is_available",
    "is_favorite",
    "view_count",
    "sort_order",
  ]) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(item, field)) mapped[field] = item[field];
  }

  return mapped;
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Display mappers: ONE shape used by BOTH the customer site and the admin.
// Input rows come from menuService (already passed through mapMenuItemFromDb /
// mapCategoryFromDb). Output matches what MenuPage, CustomerFavorites and
// ItemDetailsModal expect.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function mapMenuItemForDisplay(item, categoryNameById = {}) {
  if (!item) return item;

  const isAvailable = Boolean(item.isAvailable ?? item.is_available);
  const categoryId = item.categoryId ?? item.category_id;

  return {
    id: item.id,
    name: item.name,
    categoryId,
    category: categoryNameById[categoryId] ?? "",
    description: item.description ?? "",
    price: `₱${Number(item.price)}`, // shown to customers, e.g. "₱140"
    priceValue: Number(item.price), // plain number, for admin forms
    image: item.image_url || fallbackImg,
    isAvailable,
    status: isAvailable ? "AVAILABLE" : "SOLD OUT",
    isFavorite: Boolean(item.isFavorite ?? item.is_favorite),
    viewCount: item.viewCount ?? item.view_count ?? 0,
    // Optional columns. Only filled if they exist in the database;
    // otherwise undefined and ItemDetailsModal uses its own defaults.
    flavorProfile: item.flavor_profile ?? undefined,
    contains: item.contains ?? undefined,
    details: item.details ?? undefined,
  };
}

export function mapCategoryForDisplay(category) {
  if (!category) return category;

  return {
    id: category.id,
    name: category.name,
    icon: category.icon ?? null, // null -> the page picks a default icon
  };
}

function categoryLookup(categories) {
  const byId = {};
  (Array.isArray(categories) ? categories : []).forEach((c) => {
    byId[c.id] = c.name;
  });
  return byId;
}

// All items, ready to show. Returns [] when there is nothing yet.
export function buildMenuItems(items, categories) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
  const byId = categoryLookup(categories);
  return items.map((item) => mapMenuItemForDisplay(item, byId));
}

// Categories, ready to show. Returns [] when there is nothing yet.
export function buildCategories(categories) {
  if (!Array.isArray(categories)) return [];
  return categories.map(mapCategoryForDisplay);
}

// Home page "Customer Favorites" (max `limit`, available items only).
export function buildFavorites(items, categories, limit = 3) {
  return buildMenuItems(items, categories)
    .filter((item) => item.isFavorite && item.isAvailable)
    .slice(0, limit);
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Admin shape: what the admin Menu Management page and its drawers expect.
// Same database rows as the customer site, different display shape
// (category as a name, price as a plain number, "available"/"availability").
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function mapMenuItemForAdmin(item, categoryNameById = {}) {
  if (!item) return item;

  const isAvailable = Boolean(item.isAvailable ?? item.is_available);
  const categoryId = item.categoryId ?? item.category_id;

  return {
    id: item.id,
    name: item.name,
    categoryId,
    category: categoryNameById[categoryId] ?? "",
    description: item.description ?? "",
    price: Number(item.price),
    image: item.image_url ?? "",
    available: isAvailable,
    availability: isAvailable,
    isFavorite: Boolean(item.isFavorite ?? item.is_favorite),
    viewCount: item.viewCount ?? item.view_count ?? 0,
  };
}

// All items for the admin. Returns [] while loading or on error.
export function buildAdminMenuItems(items, categories) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
  const byId = categoryLookup(categories);
  return items.map((item) => mapMenuItemForAdmin(item, byId));
}

## beardista-brew/src/backend/services/authService.js

```
import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";

export class AuthServiceError extends Error {
  constructor(message, code) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AuthServiceError";
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export async function logIn(email, password) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email,
    password,
  });

  if (error) {
    if (
      error.code === "invalid_credentials" ||
      error.message.toLowerCase().includes("invalid login credentials")
    ) {
      throw new AuthServiceError(
        "Email or password is incorrect.",
        "invalid_credentials"
      );
    }
    throw error;
  }

  const profile = await getProfile(data.user.id);
  if (!profile || profile.status !== "active") {
    const { error: signOutError } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
    if (signOutError) throw signOutError;

    if (profile?.status === "disabled") {
      throw new AuthServiceError(
        "This account is disabled. Contact the owner for help.",
        "account_disabled"
      );
    }
    throw new AuthServiceError(
      "Your staff profile could not be found. Contact the owner for help.",
      "profile_missing"
    );
  }

  return { user: data.user, profile };
}

export async function logOut() {
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
  if (error) throw error;
}

export async function getSession() {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.session;
}

export async function getProfile(userId) {
  if (!userId) throw new Error("A user ID is required to load a profile.");

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", userId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

export async function changePassword(password) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.user;
}

export async function sendPasswordReset(email) {
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email);
  if (error) throw error;
}

import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";
import {
  mapAnnouncementFromDb,
  mapAnnouncementToDb,
  mapBaristaFromDb,
  mapFaqFromDb,
  mapStoreSettingFromDb,
} from "../mappers/contentMapper";

export async function getAnnouncements({ activeOnly = true } = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("announcements").select("*").order("created_at", {
    ascending: false,
  });
  if (activeOnly) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    query = query
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .or(`start_date.is.null,start_date.lte.${now}`)
      .or(`end_date.is.null,end_date.gt.${now}`);
  }

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapAnnouncementFromDb);
}

export async function updateAnnouncement(id, updates) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("announcements")
    .update(mapAnnouncementToDb(updates))
    .eq("id", id)
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapAnnouncementFromDb(data);
}

export async function getBaristaTeam() {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("barista_team")
    .select("*")
    .order("display_order")
    .order("name");
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapBaristaFromDb);
}

export async function getFaqs() {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("faqs")
    .select("*")
    .order("display_order")
    .order("question");
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapFaqFromDb);
}

export async function getStoreSettings() {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("store_settings")
    .select("*")
    .order("key");
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapStoreSettingFromDb);
}

export async function updateStoreSetting(key, value) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("store_settings")
    .upsert(
      { key, value, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() },
      { onConflict: "key" }
    )
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapStoreSettingFromDb(data);
}

import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";
import { mapEventFromDb, mapEventToDb } from "../mappers/eventMapper";

export async function getEvents({ includeDraft = false } = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("events").select("*").order("start_time");
  if (!includeDraft) query = query.neq("status", "draft");

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapEventFromDb);
}

export async function getEventById(id, { includeDraft = false } = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("events").select("*").eq("id", id);
  if (!includeDraft) query = query.neq("status", "draft");

  const { data, error } = await query.maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapEventFromDb(data);
}

export async function registerForEvent(registration) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke("event-code", {
    body: {
      action: "register",
      eventId: registration.eventId,
      email: registration.email ?? registration.userEmail,
      fullName: registration.fullName,
      phone: registration.phone ?? null,
    },
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
  return data;
}

export async function verifyEventCode(registrationId, code) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke("event-code", {
    body: { action: "verify", registrationId, code },
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
  return data;
}

export async function createEvent(event) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("events")
    .insert(mapEventToDb(event))
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapEventFromDb(data);
}

export async function updateEvent(id, updates) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("events")
    .update(mapEventToDb(updates))
    .eq("id", id)
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapEventFromDb(data);
}

export async function deleteEvent(id) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from("events").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) throw error;
}

import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";
import {
  mapDashboardAnalyticsFromDb,
  mapReviewFromDb,
  mapReviewToDb,
  mapSurveyFromDb,
} from "../mappers/feedbackMapper";

export async function getReviews({ publishedOnly = true } = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("reviews").select("*").order("created_at", {
    ascending: false,
  });
  if (publishedOnly) query = query.eq("is_published", true);

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapReviewFromDb);
}

export async function submitReview(review) {
  const payload = mapReviewToDb(review);
  const { error } = await supabase.from("reviews").insert(payload);
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapReviewFromDb({
    ...payload,
    is_published: false,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
}

export async function toggleReviewPublished(id, isPublished) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("reviews")
    .update({ is_published: isPublished })
    .eq("id", id)
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapReviewFromDb(data);
}

export async function getSurveys({ activeOnly = true } = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("surveys").select("*").order("created_at", {
    ascending: false,
  });
  if (activeOnly) query = query.eq("is_active", true);

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapSurveyFromDb);
}

export async function submitSurveyResponse(surveyId, answers) {
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("survey_responses")
    .insert({ survey_id: surveyId, answers });
  if (error) throw error;
  return { surveyId, answers };
}

export async function getDashboardAnalytics() {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("get_dashboard_analytics");
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapDashboardAnalyticsFromDb(data);
}

## beardista-brew/src/backend/services/menuService.js

```
import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";
import {
  mapCategoryFromDb,
  mapCategoryToDb,
  mapMenuItemFromDb,
  mapMenuItemToDb,
} from "../mappers/menuMapper";

const MENU_IMAGE_BUCKET = "menu-images";

export async function fetchCategories({ activeOnly = false } = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("categories").select("*").order("sort_order");
  if (activeOnly) query = query.eq("is_active", true);

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapCategoryFromDb);
}

export async function addCategory(category) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("categories")
    .insert(mapCategoryToDb(category))
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapCategoryFromDb(data);
}

export async function editCategory(id, updates) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("categories")
    .update(mapCategoryToDb(updates))
    .eq("id", id)
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapCategoryFromDb(data);
}

export async function deleteCategory(id) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from("categories").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) throw error;
}

export async function reorderCategories(categories) {
  const updates = categories.map((category, index) => ({
    id: typeof category === "object" ? category.id : category,
    sort_order: index,
  }));
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc("reorder_categories", {
    category_orders: updates,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
}

export async function fetchMenuItems({
  categoryId,
  availableOnly = false,
} = {}) {
  let query = supabase.from("menu_items").select("*").order("sort_order");
  if (categoryId !== undefined) query = query.eq("category_id", categoryId);
  if (availableOnly) query = query.eq("is_available", true);

  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return data.map(mapMenuItemFromDb);
}

export async function addMenuItem(item) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("menu_items")
    .insert(mapMenuItemToDb(item))
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapMenuItemFromDb(data);
}

export async function editMenuItem(id, updates) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("menu_items")
    .update(mapMenuItemToDb(updates))
    .eq("id", id)
    .select()
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return mapMenuItemFromDb(data);
}

export async function deleteMenuItem(id) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from("menu_items").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) throw error;
}

export async function uploadMenuItemImage(file, filePath) {
  const extension = file.name.includes(".")
    ? file.name.split(".").pop().toLowerCase()
    : "";
  const path =
    filePath ??
    `${crypto.randomUUID()}${extension ? `.${extension}` : ""}`;
  const { error } = await supabase.storage
    .from(MENU_IMAGE_BUCKET)
    .upload(path, file, { upsert: false });
  if (error) throw error;

  const { data } = supabase.storage.from(MENU_IMAGE_BUCKET).getPublicUrl(path);
  return data.publicUrl;
}

export async function incrementItemViewCount(id) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(
    "increment_menu_item_view_count",
    { p_item_id: id }
  );
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

import React from 'react';

/**
 * Navbar component renders the top persistent navigation header.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Function} props.onOpenSurvey - Callback to trigger the Customer Survey modal
 * @param {string} props.currentPage - Currently active view ('home' or 'menu')
 * @param {Function} props.onNavigate - Callback to switch views
 */
export const Navbar = ({ onOpenSurvey, currentPage = 'home', onNavigate }) => {
  // Smooth scroll helper to navigate to page sections by their HTML element ID
  const scrollToSection = (sectionId) => {
    if (currentPage !== 'home' && onNavigate) {
      onNavigate('home');
      setTimeout(() => {
        const targetElement = document.getElementById(sectionId);
        if (targetElement) targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }, 50);
      return;
    }
    const targetElement = document.getElementById(sectionId);
    if (targetElement) {
      targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  return (
    // Navigation container: sticky positioned with warm cream background and subtle bottom border
    <nav className="bg-[#FFF3E7] flex justify-between items-center w-full px-6 md:px-16 py-4 sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-black/5">
      {/* Brand Wordmark: Anybody bold display typeface in signature Navy color */}
      <a
        href="#"
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (onNavigate) onNavigate('home');
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }}
        className="font-black text-2xl md:text-3xl text-[#19244E] tracking-tight hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity"
      >
        Beardista Brew
      </a>

      {/* Navigational Anchor Links: Home, Menu, About Us, Contact */}
      <div className="hidden md:flex items-center space-x-8">
        {/* Home Link */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (onNavigate) onNavigate('home');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          className={`text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide transition-colors cursor-pointer relative py-1 ${
            currentPage === 'home'
              ? 'text-[#E58422] font-bold after:content-[""] after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:right-0 after:h-0.5 after:bg-[#E58422]'
              : 'text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#E58422]'
          }`}
        >
          Home
        </button>

        {/* Dynamic Digital Menu Link */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (onNavigate) onNavigate('menu');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          className={`text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide transition-colors cursor-pointer relative py-1 ${
            currentPage === 'menu'
              ? 'text-[#E58422] font-bold after:content-[""] after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:right-0 after:h-0.5 after:bg-[#E58422]'
              : 'text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#E58422]'
          }`}
        >
          Menu
        </button>

        {/* Navigational link to the full Our Story / About Us page */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (onNavigate) {
              onNavigate('story');
              window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
            } else {
              scrollToSection('story-section');
            }
          }}
          className={`text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide transition-colors cursor-pointer relative py-1 ${
            currentPage === 'story'
              ? 'text-[#E58422] font-bold after:content-[""] after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:right-0 after:h-0.5 after:bg-[#E58422]'
              : 'text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#E58422]'
          }`}
        >
          About Us
        </button>

        {/* Scroll link to footer location and social channels */}
        <button
          onClick={() => scrollToSection('contact-section')}
          className="text-[#19244E] text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide hover:text-[#E58422] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          Contact
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Primary Action Button: "Take Survey" styled with brand orange (#E58422) */}
      <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenSurvey}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-full shadow-sm active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
        >
          Take Survey
        </button>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
};

## beardista-brew/src/features/admin/AdminPortal.jsx

```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

// Sample data (temporary; replaced by Supabase hooks page by page)
import {
  initialAdminStats,
  customerFavoritesThisMonth,
  initialAuditLogs,
  individualFeedbackList,
  initialContentData,
  initialEventsData,
  initialSettingsData,
} from '../../data/adminMockData.js';

// Live menu data (Supabase), shared with the customer site
import {
  useCategories,
  useMenuItems,
  useCreateCategory,
  useCreateMenuItem,
  useUpdateMenuItem,
  useDeleteMenuItem,
} from '../../backend/hooks/useMenu';
import { buildCategories, buildAdminMenuItems } from '../../backend/mappers/menuMapper';

// Pages / Views
import { LoginView } from './pages/LoginView.jsx';
import { DashboardView } from './pages/DashboardView.jsx';
import { MenuManagement as MenuManagementView } from "./pages/MenuManagement.jsx";
import { AnalyticsReportsView } from './pages/AnalyticsReportsView.jsx';
import { ContentManagerView } from './pages/ContentManagerView.jsx';
import { EventsManagerView } from './pages/EventsManagerView.jsx';
import { AuditLogsView } from './pages/AuditLogsView.jsx';
import { UserManagement } from './pages/UserManagement.jsx';
import { SettingsView } from './pages/SettingsView.jsx';

// Slide-Over Drawers 
import { AddCategoryDrawer } from './drawers/AddCategoryDrawer.jsx';
import { EditMenuItemDrawer } from './drawers/EditMenuItemDrawer.jsx';

// Modals
import { ChangePasswordModal } from './auth/ChangePasswordModal.jsx';
import { LogoutModal } from './auth/LogoutModal.jsx';
import { SurveyBuilderModal } from './modals/SurveyBuilderModal.jsx';

export const AdminPortal = ({ onSwitchToCustomerMenu, onLogout, onSwitchToMobileView }) => {
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(true);
  const [activePage, setActivePage] = useState('dashboard');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(initialAdminStats);
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState(customerFavoritesThisMonth);
  // Menu: real data from Supabase (same tables the customer site reads)
  const categoriesQuery = useCategories();
  const itemsQuery = useMenuItems();
  const categories = buildCategories(categoriesQuery.data);
  const menuItems = buildAdminMenuItems(itemsQuery.data, categoriesQuery.data);
  const createCategory = useCreateCategory();
  const createItem = useCreateMenuItem();
  const updateItem = useUpdateMenuItem();
  const deleteItem = useDeleteMenuItem();
  const [auditLogs, setAuditLogs] = useState(initialAuditLogs);
  const [feedbackList, setFeedbackList] = useState(individualFeedbackList);
  const [contentData, setContentData] = useState(initialContentData);
  const [eventsData, setEventsData] = useState(initialEventsData);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(initialSettingsData);
  const [globalAvailability, setGlobalAvailability] = useState(true);

  const [isAddCategoryOpen, setIsAddCategoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditItemOpen, setIsEditItemOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState(null);
  const [isChangePasswordOpen, setIsChangePasswordOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLogoutModalOpen, setIsLogoutModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSurveyBuilderOpen, setIsSurveyBuilderOpen] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState(null);

  const showToast = (message) => {
    setToastMessage(message);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToastMessage(null);
    }, 3500);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (itemsQuery.isError || categoriesQuery.isError) {
      showToast('We could not load the menu. Please refresh the page.');
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [itemsQuery.isError, categoriesQuery.isError]);

  const logAudit = (action, actionType, itemAffected, itemId, previousValue, newValue) => {
    const now = new Date();
    const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
    const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour12: false }) + ' UTC';
    const newLog = {
      id: `log-${Date.now()}`,
      date: dateStr,
      time: timeStr,
      action,
      actionType,
      itemAffected,
      itemId,
      previousValue,
      newValue,
      user: 'admin@beardistabrew.com'
    };
    setAuditLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev]);
  };

  const handleLogin = (user) => {
    setIsAuthenticated(true);
    showToast(`Welcome back, ${user.username || 'Admin'}!`);
  };

  const handleConfirmLogout = () => {
    setIsLogoutModalOpen(false);
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    showToast('You have been logged out of the Admin Portal.');
    if (onLogout) {
      onLogout();
    }
  };

  const handleToggleGlobalAvailability = () => {
    const nextState = !globalAvailability;
    setGlobalAvailability(nextState);
    showToast(nextState ? 'Global Availability: Store Menu Online' : 'Global Availability: Store Menu Paused');
    logAudit('System Mode', 'sync', 'Global Availability', 'SYS-AVAIL', globalAvailability ? 'Online' : 'Paused', nextState ? 'Online' : 'Paused');
  };

  const handleToggleItemAvailability = async (itemId) => {
    if (!globalAvailability) {
      showToast('Global Store Availability is paused. Switch Global Store Online to update item inventory.');
      return;
    }
    const item = menuItems.find((i) => i.id === itemId);
    if (!item) return;

    const updated = !item.available;
    try {
      await updateItem.mutateAsync({ id: itemId, isAvailable: updated });
      logAudit('Availability Toggle', 'update', item.name, item.id, item.available ? 'Available' : 'Unavailable', updated ? 'Available' : 'Unavailable');
      showToast(`${item.name} is now ${updated ? 'available' : 'unavailable'}`);
    } catch {
      showToast('We could not update that item. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  const handleSaveCategory = async (newCat) => {
    try {
      await createCategory.mutateAsync({
        name: newCat.name,
        sortOrder: newCat.sortPriority,
        isActive: !newCat.isDraft && newCat.publishToOnlineMenu !== false,
      });
      showToast(`Category "${newCat.name}" created successfully!`);
      logAudit('Create Category', 'create', newCat.name, newCat.id, 'None', 'New category added');
    } catch {
      showToast('We could not create that category. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  // The drawer's default placeholder photo is not a real image, so it is not saved.
  const PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE = 'images.unsplash.com/photo-1514432324607';

  const handleSaveItem = async (savedItem) => {
    const existing = menuItems.find((i) => i.id === savedItem.id);
    const category = categories.find((c) => c.name === savedItem.category);
    const payload = {
      categoryId: category?.id ?? null,
      name: savedItem.name,
      description: savedItem.description,
      price: savedItem.price,
      imageUrl:
        savedItem.image && !savedItem.image.includes(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE) ? savedItem.image : null,
      isAvailable: savedItem.availability,
    };

    try {
      if (existing) {
        await updateItem.mutateAsync({ id: savedItem.id, ...payload });
        showToast(`Updated "${savedItem.name}" successfully.`);
        logAudit('Update Item', 'update', savedItem.name, savedItem.id, `₱${existing.price}`, `₱${savedItem.price}`);
      } else {
        await createItem.mutateAsync(payload);
        showToast(`Added "${savedItem.name}" to menu inventory.`);
        logAudit('Create Item', 'create', savedItem.name, savedItem.id, 'None', `Base Price: ₱${savedItem.price}`);
      }
      if (!category) {
        showToast(`Saved, but category "${savedItem.category}" was not found, so it has no category yet.`);
      }
    } catch {
      showToast('We could not save that item. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  // The menu has no "archived" column, so this removes the item (the page already asks to confirm).
  const handleArchiveItem = async (item) => {
    try {
      await deleteItem.mutateAsync(item.id);
      showToast(`"${item.name}" removed from the menu.`);
      logAudit('Archive Item', 'delete', item.name, item.id, 'Catalog Active', 'Removed from active menu');
    } catch {
      showToast('We could not remove that item. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEditItem = (item) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setIsEditItemOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenAddItem = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setIsEditItemOpen(true);
  };

  const handleToggleSyncVoice = (feedbackId) => {
    setFeedbackList((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) => {
        if (f.id === feedbackId) {
          const next = !f.syncToVoice;
          showToast(next ? `Synced ${f.name}'s review to Customer Voice.` : `Removed review from Customer Voice.`);
          return { ...f, syncToVoice: next };
        }
        return f;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleArchiveFeedback = (feedbackId) => {
    setFeedbackList((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== feedbackId));
    showToast('Customer feedback record archived.');
    logAudit('Archive Feedback', 'delete', 'Customer Feedback Record', feedbackId, 'Active', 'Archived');
  };

  const handleSaveContent = (newContent) => {
    setContentData(newContent);
    showToast('Public brand story and team roster published!');
    logAudit('Update Content', 'update', 'Brand Story & Team Roster', 'CMS-CONTENT', 'Previous Version', 'New Live Content Published');
  };

  const handleSaveEvent = (updatedEvent) => {
    setEventsData((prev) => ({ ...prev, activeEvent: updatedEvent }));
    showToast(`Event "${updatedEvent.title}" configuration published!`);
    logAudit('Update Event', 'update', updatedEvent.title, 'EV-ACTIVE', 'Previous Setup', `Status: ${updatedEvent.status}`);
  };

  const handleSaveSettings = (newSettings) => {
    setSettings(newSettings);
    showToast('Café details and Wi-Fi configuration saved!');
    logAudit('Update Settings', 'update', 'Store & Wi-Fi Settings', 'CONF-STORE', 'Previous Config', 'New Settings Applied');
  };

  const handleSaveSurvey = (survey) => {
    showToast(`Survey "${survey.title}" published!`);
    logAudit('Publish Survey', 'create', survey.title, 'SURV-NEW', 'Draft', 'Published to customer app');
  };

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <LoginView onLogin={handleLogin} onSwitchToCustomerMenu={onSwitchToCustomerMenu} />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F4F6F9] flex flex-row relative font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif] text-gray-900">
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed top-6 right-6 z-[9999] bg-[#19244E] text-white px-5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-white/20 flex items-center gap-3 animate-slideDown">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] animate-pulse" />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold">{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* RENDER INLINED SIDEBAR HERE */}
      <AdminSidebar
        activePage={activePage}
        onNavigate={setActivePage}
        onOpenLogout={() => setIsLogoutModalOpen(true)}
        onSwitchToCustomerMenu={onSwitchToCustomerMenu}
      />

      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-y-auto min-h-screen">
        <header className="bg-white border-b border-gray-100 px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-20">
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
              Beardista Brew · Caloocan Flagship
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#19244E] capitalize">
              {activePage}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {onSwitchToMobileView && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onSwitchToMobileView}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-orange-50 hover:bg-orange-100 text-[#E58422] border border-orange-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 shadow-2xs"
              >
                <span>📱</span>
                <span>Mobile App Shell</span>
              </button>
            )}


            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 border-l border-gray-200">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#19244E] text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center">
                BB
              </div>
              <div className="hidden sm:block text-left text-xs">
                <div className="font-bold text-[#19244E]">Administrator</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">admin@beardistabrew.com</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div className="p-6 md:p-8 flex-1">
          {activePage === 'dashboard' && (
            <DashboardView
              stats={stats}
              favorites={favorites}
              globalAvailability={globalAvailability}
              onToggleGlobalAvailability={handleToggleGlobalAvailability}
              onNavigateToMenu={() => setActivePage('menu')}
            />
          )}

          {activePage === 'menu' && (
            <MenuManagementView
              items={menuItems}
              categories={categories}
              globalAvailability={globalAvailability}
              onToggleGlobalAvailability={handleToggleGlobalAvailability}
              onOpenAddCategory={() => setIsAddCategoryOpen(true)}
              onOpenAddItem={handleOpenAddItem}
              onEditItem={handleOpenEditItem}
              onToggleItemAvailability={handleToggleItemAvailability}
              onArchiveItem={handleArchiveItem}
            />
          )}

          {activePage === 'analytics' && (
            <AnalyticsReportsView
              feedbackList={feedbackList}
              onOpenSurveyBuilder={() => setIsSurveyBuilderOpen(true)}
              onToggleSyncVoice={handleToggleSyncVoice}
              onArchiveFeedback={handleArchiveFeedback}
            />
          )}

          {activePage === 'content' && (
            <ContentManagerView contentData={contentData} onSaveContent={handleSaveContent} />
          )}

          {activePage === 'events' && (
            <EventsManagerView eventsData={eventsData} onSaveEvent={handleSaveEvent} />
          )}

          {activePage === 'audit' && (
            <AuditLogsView logs={auditLogs} />
          )}

          {activePage === 'users' && (
            <UserManagement onLogAudit={logAudit} />
          )}

          {activePage === 'settings' && (
            <SettingsView
              settings={settings}
              onSaveSettings={handleSaveSettings}
              onOpenChangePassword={() => setIsChangePasswordOpen(true)}
              onNavigateToUsers={() => setActivePage('users')}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </main>

      <AddCategoryDrawer isOpen={isAddCategoryOpen} onClose={() => setIsAddCategoryOpen(false)} onSave={handleSaveCategory} />
      <EditMenuItemDrawer categoryOptions={categories.map((c) => c.name)} isOpen={isEditItemOpen} item={editingItem} onClose={() => setIsEditItemOpen(false)} onSave={handleSaveItem} onArchive={handleArchiveItem} />
      <ChangePasswordModal isOpen={isChangePasswordOpen} onClose={() => setIsChangePasswordOpen(false)} onSuccess={(msg) => showToast(msg)} />
      <LogoutModal isOpen={isLogoutModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsLogoutModalOpen(false)} onConfirm={handleConfirmLogout} />
      <SurveyBuilderModal isOpen={isSurveyBuilderOpen} onClose={() => setIsSurveyBuilderOpen(false)} onSave={handleSaveSurvey} />
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../../backend/hooks/useAuth';

export const AdminLogin = ({ onLoginSuccess, onBackToCustomer, onSwitchToMobileLogin }) => {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('');
  const [showForgotModal, setShowForgotModal] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const { logIn, isLoggingIn } = useAuth();

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage('');

    try {
      await logIn({ email: username.trim(), password });
      onLoginSuccess?.();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Admin sign-in failed:', error);
      if (error.code === 'account_disabled') {
        setErrorMessage('This account is disabled. Contact the owner for help.');
      } else if (error.code === 'profile_missing') {
        setErrorMessage('Your staff profile could not be found. Contact the owner for help.');
      } else if (error.code === 'invalid_credentials') {
        setErrorMessage('Email or password is incorrect.');
      } else {
        setErrorMessage('Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.');
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex flex-col justify-center items-center p-4 sm:p-6 relative font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif] selection:bg-[#E58422] selection:text-white">
      {/* Top action buttons */}
      <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 right-6 flex items-center justify-between">
        {onBackToCustomer && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onBackToCustomer}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-[#19244E] transition-colors cursor-pointer bg-white px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-2xs hover:border-gray-300"
          >
            <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m-7 7h18" />
            </svg>
            <span>Return to Customer Menu</span>
          </button>
        )}

        {onSwitchToMobileLogin && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onSwitchToMobileLogin}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-extrabold text-[#E58422] hover:text-[#c46914] bg-white px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 shadow-2xs hover:border-orange-300 cursor-pointer ml-auto transition-all active:scale-95"
          >
            <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 18h.01M8 21h8a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H8a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2z" />
            </svg>
            <span>Mobile App & PIN Login</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main Login Card */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-8 sm:p-10 relative">
        {/* Brand Header */}
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-[#19244E] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black text-2xl mx-auto mb-4 shadow-md border-2 border-[#E58422]">
            BB
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
            Beardista Brew
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">
            Admin Portal Access
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2">
            Secure administrative control center for Caloocan Flagship.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Login Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5">
          {/* Email Input Field */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
              Email
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z" />
                </svg>
              </span>
              <input
                type="email"
                autoComplete="username"
                required
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setUsername(e.target.value);
                  if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage('');
                }}
                placeholder="Enter your email"
                className="w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-gray-400"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Password Input Field */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider">
                Password
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z" />
                </svg>
              </span>
              <input
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPassword(e.target.value);
                  if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage('');
                }}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                className="w-full pl-11 pr-11 py-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-gray-400"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3.5 top-3.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 cursor-pointer"
                title={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M13.875 18.825A10.05 10.05 0 0112 19c-4.478 0-8.268-2.943-9.543-7a9.97 9.97 0 011.563-3.029m5.858.908a3 3 0 114.243 4.243M9.878 9.878l4.242 4.242M9.88 9.88l-3.29-3.29m7.532 7.532l3.29 3.29M3 3l18 18" />
                  </svg>
                ) : (
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
                  </svg>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Error Message */}
            {errorMessage && (
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-fadeIn">
                <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7 4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-9a1 1 0 00-1 1v4a1 1 0 102 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
                <span>{errorMessage}</span>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isLoggingIn}
            className="w-full py-3.5 px-6 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-sm font-extrabold rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-70"
          >
            {isLoggingIn ? (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
                <span>Verifying...</span>
              </span>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span>Secure Login</span>
                <span className="text-base leading-none">→</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Forgot Credentials Link */}
        <div className="text-center mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-gray-100">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowForgotModal(true)}
            className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-[#E58422] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Forgot your credentials?
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Forgot Credentials Modal Dialog */}
      {showForgotModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs cursor-pointer"
            onClick={() => setShowForgotModal(false)}
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 shadow-2xl z-10 text-center space-y-4 animate-scaleUp">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-orange-100 text-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center text-xl mx-auto font-black">
              <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                Credential Recovery
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2 leading-relaxed px-2">
                Please contact the system administrator to request a secure password reset link for your account.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowForgotModal(false)}
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#23336d] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer mt-2"
            >
              Close Window
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminLogin;

import React, { useState } from 'react';

export const ChangePasswordModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSuccess }) => {
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!currentPassword) {
      setError('Please enter your current administrator password.');
      return;
    }
    if (!newPassword || newPassword.length < 6) {
      setError('New password must be at least 6 characters long.');
      return;
    }
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError('New password and confirmation do not match.');
      return;
    }

    onSuccess('Security credentials updated successfully.');
    setCurrentPassword('');
    setNewPassword('');
    setConfirmPassword('');
    setError('');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      {/* Dimmed backdrop */}
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity cursor-pointer"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* Modal Dialog Card */}
      <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden transform transition-all z-10 animate-scaleUp">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#19244E] px-6 py-5 text-white flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-sm">
              🔒
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base tracking-tight">Change Password</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#FFF3E7]/70">Admin security settings</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-gray-300 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-4">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-medium">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
              Current Password *
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={currentPassword}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCurrentPassword(e.target.value);
                if (error) setError('');
              }}
              placeholder="••••••••"
              className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
              New Password *
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={newPassword}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setNewPassword(e.target.value);
                if (error) setError('');
              }}
              placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"
              className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
              Confirm New Password *
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setConfirmPassword(e.target.value);
                if (error) setError('');
              }}
              placeholder="Re-enter new password"
              className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
              required
            />
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="pt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              Update Password
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
