```
import React, { useState } from 'react';

const INITIAL_ICON_OPTIONS = [
  { id: 'coffee', icon: '☕', label: 'Coffee' },
  { id: 'cup', icon: '🥤', label: 'Cold Drink' },
  { id: 'croissant', icon: '🥐', label: 'Pastry' },
  { id: 'sparkles', icon: '✨', label: 'Specialty' },
  { id: 'flame', icon: '🔥', label: 'Artisan' },
  { id: 'bowl', icon: '🍜', label: 'Food / Pasta' },
  { id: 'leaf', icon: '🍃', label: 'Matcha / Tea' },
  { id: 'cake', icon: '🍰', label: 'Dessert' }
];

const QUICK_EMOJIS = [
  { icon: '🧋', label: 'Boba / Milk Tea' },
  { icon: '🥪', label: 'Sandwiches' },
  { icon: '🥗', label: 'Salads' },
  { icon: '🥑', label: 'Avocado Toast' },
  { icon: '🧇', label: 'Waffles' },
  { icon: '🍩', label: 'Donuts' },
  { icon: '🍕', label: 'Flatbread' },
  { icon: '🍷', label: 'Wine / Cocktails' },
  { icon: '🍺', label: 'Craft Brews' },
  { icon: '🫖', label: 'Loose Teas' },
  { icon: '🧊', label: 'Cold Brew' },
  { icon: '🍋', label: 'Citrus' },
  { icon: '🍫', label: 'Chocolates' },
  { icon: '🥯', label: 'Bagels' },
  { icon: '🥞', label: 'Pancakes' },
  { icon: '🌮', label: 'Tacos' }
];

const COLOR_OPTIONS = [
  { id: 'orange', hex: '#E58422', label: 'Amber Orange' },
  { id: 'navy', hex: '#19244E', label: 'Deep Navy' },
  { id: 'emerald', hex: '#10B981', label: 'Mint Emerald' },
  { id: 'rose', hex: '#F43F5E', label: 'Rose Red' },
  { id: 'purple', hex: '#8B5CF6', label: 'Purple' },
  { id: 'amber', hex: '#F59E0B', label: 'Gold Amber' }
];

const DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS = [
  'Beverages & Espresso',
  'Signature Creations',
  'Savory Kitchen & Pasta',
  'Bakery & Bar Bites',
  'Matcha & Tea Bar',
  'Merchandise & Retail'
];

export const AddCategoryDrawer = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSave }) => {
  const [iconOptions, setIconOptions] = useState(INITIAL_ICON_OPTIONS);
  const [selectedIcon, setSelectedIcon] = useState('☕');
  const [isAddingCustomIcon, setIsAddingCustomIcon] = useState(false);
  const [customIconInput, setCustomIconInput] = useState('');
  const [customLabelInput, setCustomLabelInput] = useState('');
  const [customIconImage, setCustomIconImage] = useState('');

  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState('');
  const [sortPriority, setSortPriority] = useState('1');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState('Beverages & Espresso');
  const [tagColor, setTagColor] = useState('#E58422');
  const [publishToOnlineMenu, setPublishToOnlineMenu] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleIconUpload = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const result = event.target?.result;
      if (typeof result === 'string') {
        setCustomIconImage(result);
        if (!customLabelInput) {
          const cleanName = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').replace(/[-_]/g, ' ');
          setCustomLabelInput(cleanName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + cleanName.slice(1));
        }
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSaveCustomIcon = () => {
    const iconVal = customIconImage || customIconInput.trim();
    if (!iconVal) return;

    const labelVal = customLabelInput.trim() || 'Custom Icon';
    const newEntry = {
      id: `custom-${Date.now()}`,
      icon: iconVal,
      label: labelVal
    };

    setIconOptions((prev) => [...prev, newEntry]);
    setSelectedIcon(iconVal);
    setIsAddingCustomIcon(false);
    setCustomIconInput('');
    setCustomLabelInput('');
    setCustomIconImage('');
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleNameChange = (val) => {
    setName(val);
    if (!slug || slug === name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')) {
      setSlug(val.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-'));
    }
    if (error) setError('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = (isDraft = false) => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setError('Please enter a valid category name.');
      return;
    }

    const newCategory = {
      id: `cat-${Date.now()}`,
      name: name.trim(),
      slug: slug.trim() || name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-'),
      icon: selectedIcon,
      department,
      tagColor,
      publishToOnlineMenu: isDraft ? false : publishToOnlineMenu,
      isDraft,
      count: 0,
      description: description.trim(),
      sortPriority: parseInt(sortPriority, 10) || 1
    };

    onSave(newCategory);
    // Reset form
    setName('');
    setSlug('');
    setDescription('');
    setError('');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif]">
      {/* Dimmed backdrop */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity cursor-pointer"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      <div className="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 max-w-full flex pl-10">
        {/* Right-aligned sliding drawer panel */}
        <div className="w-screen max-w-lg bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out">
          {/* Drawer Header */}
          <div className="px-6 py-5 bg-[#19244E] text-white flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#24336c]">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
              <div
                className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white text-base shadow-sm font-bold overflow-hidden"
                style={{ backgroundColor: tagColor }}
              >
                {selectedIcon.startsWith('data:') || selectedIcon.startsWith('http') ? (
                  <img src={selectedIcon} alt="Badge Icon" className="w-5 h-5 object-contain" />
                ) : (
                  selectedIcon
                )}
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base tracking-tight text-white">Add Category</h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#FFF3E7]/70">Configure taxonomy, badge, and live menu status</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-gray-300 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Drawer Body Form */}
          <div className="p-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 text-xs">
            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-medium">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 1. Category Icon & Visual Badge selection */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Category Icon & Visual Badge
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddingCustomIcon((prev) => !prev)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:text-[#c76e19] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2.5} d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>{isAddingCustomIcon ? 'Close Adder' : 'Add Icon'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Icon Selection Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                {iconOptions.map((item) => (
                  <button
                    key={item.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedIcon(item.icon)}
                    className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      selectedIcon === item.icon
                        ? 'border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#19244E] ring-2 ring-[#E58422]/20 font-bold'
                        : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300 bg-gray-50/50 text-gray-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="text-xl flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7">
                      {item.icon.startsWith('data:') || item.icon.startsWith('http') ? (
                        <img src={item.icon} alt={item.label} className="w-5 h-5 object-contain" />
                      ) : (
                        item.icon
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] truncate max-w-full">{item.label}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}

                {/* + Add Icon Button */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddingCustomIcon(true)}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-[#E58422]/40 hover:border-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]/40 text-[#19244E] flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer group min-h-[64px]"
                  title="Add custom icon or upload badge image"
                >
                  <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-[#FFF3E7] group-hover:bg-[#E58422] group-hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center text-[#E58422] transition-colors">
                    <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2.5} d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422]">Add Icon</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Add Custom Icon Drawer / Inline Panel */}
              {isAddingCustomIcon && (
                <div className="mt-3 p-4 bg-[#FFF9F3] border border-[#E58422]/30 rounded-2xl space-y-3 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-[#E58422]/15">
                    <div className="font-bold text-xs text-[#19244E] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[#E58422]">✨</span>
                      <span>Add New Category Icon</span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsAddingCustomIcon(false)}
                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 text-xs cursor-pointer p-1"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* 1. Quick Select Cafe & Food Emojis */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      Quick Pick Popular Emoji
                    </label>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-1.5">
                      {QUICK_EMOJIS.map((item) => (
                        <button
                          key={item.icon}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setCustomIconInput(item.icon);
                            setCustomIconImage('');
                            if (!customLabelInput) setCustomLabelInput(item.label);
                          }}
                          className={`h-8 rounded-lg text-base border flex items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                            customIconInput === item.icon && !customIconImage
                              ? 'border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] ring-2 ring-[#E58422]/30 scale-105 font-bold'
                              : 'border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300'
                          }`}
                          title={item.label}
                        >
                          {item.icon}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 2. Custom Character / Emoji & Label Input */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                        Emoji or 1-2 Char Symbol
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={customIconInput}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setCustomIconInput(e.target.value);
                          if (e.target.value) setCustomIconImage('');
                        }}
                        placeholder="e.g. 🥪 or B"
                        maxLength={4}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] outline-none text-center"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                        Icon Label Name
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={customLabelInput}
                        onChange={(e) => setCustomLabelInput(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Artisanal Sandwiches"
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] outline-none"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 3. Upload Custom PNG / SVG Image */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                      Or Upload Custom Icon Image (PNG / SVG)
                    </label>
                    <label className="flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 border border-dashed border-gray-300 hover:border-[#E58422] bg-white rounded-xl cursor-pointer text-xs text-gray-600 transition-colors">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {customIconImage ? (
                          <img src={customIconImage} alt="Uploaded" className="w-5 h-5 object-contain rounded" />
                        ) : (
                          <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12" />
                          </svg>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-700 truncate max-w-[200px]">
                          {customIconImage ? 'Custom image loaded ✓' : 'Choose PNG/SVG icon file...'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
                        Browse
                      </span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/png,image/svg+xml,image/jpeg"
                        onChange={handleIconUpload}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  {/* Actions */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setIsAddingCustomIcon(false);
                        setCustomIconInput('');
                        setCustomLabelInput('');
                        setCustomIconImage('');
                      }}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleSaveCustomIcon}
                      disabled={!customIconInput.trim() && !customIconImage}
                      className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d07317] disabled:opacity-40 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Add & Select Icon
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* 2. Category Name & Slug */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Category Name *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => handleNameChange(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Competition Artisans"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Category Slug
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={slug}
                  onChange={(e) => setSlug(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. competition-artisans"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 3. Department / Group & Sort Priority */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Department / Group
                </label>
                <select
                  value={department}
                  onChange={(e) => setDepartment(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS.map((dep) => (
                    <option key={dep} value={dep}>{dep}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Sort Priority (Order)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="99"
                  value={sortPriority}
                  onChange={(e) => setSortPriority(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 4. Tag Highlight Color Picker */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                Tag Highlight Color
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
                {COLOR_OPTIONS.map((col) => (
                  <button
                    key={col.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTagColor(col.hex)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      tagColor === col.hex
                        ? 'border-gray-900 bg-gray-100 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-black'
                        : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border border-black/10 inline-block"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: col.hex }}
                    />
                    <span>{col.label}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 5. Description */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Description / Menu Intro
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows="3"
                value={description}
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Short customer-facing blurb displayed under category header in digital menu..."
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all resize-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* 6. Publish to Online Menu toggle */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="font-extrabold text-[#19244E] text-xs">Publish to Online Menu</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Make this category visible to patrons on live QR menus</div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPublishToOnlineMenu(!publishToOnlineMenu)}
                className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  publishToOnlineMenu ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-gray-300'
                }`}
              >
                <span
                  className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow-xs transition-transform ${
                    publishToOnlineMenu ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                  }`}
                />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Drawer Footer Actions: Cancel, Save as Draft, Create Category */}
          <div className="p-5 border-t border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/80 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-200/60 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSubmit(true)}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-300 hover:border-gray-400 text-gray-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95"
              >
                Save as Draft
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSubmit(false)}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Create Category
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## beardista-brew/src/features/admin/drawers/EditMenuItemDrawer.jsx

```
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const CATEGORY_OPTIONS = [
  'Signatures',
  'Specialty Coffee',
  'Competition Artisans',
  'Milk Creations',
  'Zero-Proof',
  'Matcha',
  'Foam Series',
  'Bespokes',
  'Savory Bites',
  'Pasta',
  'Rice',
  'Salad',
  'Extras'
];

export const EditMenuItemDrawer = ({ isOpen, item, onClose, onSave, onArchive, categoryOptions }) => {
  // Real category names from the database; falls back to the built-in list
  const options = categoryOptions && categoryOptions.length > 0 ? categoryOptions : CATEGORY_OPTIONS;
  const isEditing = Boolean(item && item.id);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    category: 'Espresso & Coffee',
    price: 150,
    availability: true,
    image: '',
    description: '',
    flavorProfile: '',
    allergens: 'None'
  });

  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showArchiveConfirm, setShowArchiveConfirm] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (item) {
      setFormData({
        name: item.name || '',
        category: item.category || 'Espresso & Coffee',
        price: item.price || 150,
        availability: item.availability !== undefined ? item.availability : true,
        image: item.image || '',
        description: item.description || '',
        flavorProfile: item.flavorProfile || '',
        allergens: item.allergens || 'None'
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        category: 'Espresso & Coffee',
        price: 150,
        availability: true,
        image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514432324607-a09d9b4aefdd?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
        description: '',
        flavorProfile: '',
        allergens: 'None'
      });
    }
    setError('');
    setShowArchiveConfirm(false);
  }, [item, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: value
    }));
    if (error) setError('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setError('Item title is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.price || formData.price <= 0) {
      setError('Please provide a valid price.');
      return;
    }

    const payload = {
      ...(item || {}),
      id: item ? item.id : `menu-${Date.now()}`,
      name: formData.name.trim(),
      category: formData.category,
      price: Number(formData.price),
      availability: formData.availability,
      image: formData.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514432324607-a09d9b4aefdd?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
      description: formData.description.trim(),
      flavorProfile: formData.flavorProfile.trim(),
      allergens: formData.allergens.trim()
    };

    onSave(payload);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity cursor-pointer"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      <div className="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 max-w-full flex pl-10">
        <div className="w-screen max-w-lg bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out">
          {/* Drawer Header */}
          <div className="px-6 py-5 bg-[#19244E] text-white flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-sm">
                {isEditing ? '✎' : '+'}
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base tracking-tight">
                  {isEditing ? `Edit: ${item.name}` : 'Add New Menu Item'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#FFF3E7]/70">
                  {isEditing ? 'Modify product details and pricing' : 'Expand digital menu inventory'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-gray-300 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Drawer Body Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-medium">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Quick Preview Thumbnail & Availability Bar */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-4">
              <img
                src={formData.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514432324607-a09d9b4aefdd?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80'}
                alt="Preview"
                className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl object-cover bg-gray-200 border border-gray-300 flex-shrink-0"
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.target.src = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514432324607-a09d9b4aefdd?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80';
                }}
              />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Status:</span>
                  <span
                    className={`text-[11px] font-extrabold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                      formData.availability
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {formData.availability ? 'Available for Ordering' : 'Currently Out of Stock'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleChange('availability', !formData.availability)}
                    className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      formData.availability ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                        formData.availability ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600">
                    {formData.availability ? 'In Stock (Live)' : 'Mark Out of Stock'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Item Name */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                Item Name *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('name', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Alon at Apoy"
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* Category & Price in 2 Columns */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Category *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={formData.category}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('category', e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {options.map((cat) => (
                    <option key={cat} value={cat}>
                      {cat}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Price (PHP ₱) *
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 font-bold text-sm">₱</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    step="5"
                    value={formData.price}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('price', e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full pl-8 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Image URL */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                Image Source URL
              </label>
              <input
                type="url"
                value={formData.image}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('image', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="https://..."
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                Detailed Description
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows="3"
                value={formData.description}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('description', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Describe tasting experience, brewing method, and specialty ingredients..."
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all resize-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Flavor Profile */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                Flavor Profile Notes
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.flavorProfile}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('flavorProfile', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Smoky, bittersweet cacao, caramelized citrus"
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Contains / Allergens */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                Contains / Allergens
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.allergens}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('allergens', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Dairy, Tree Nuts, Gluten or None"
                className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
              />
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Archive Confirmation Banner */}
          {showArchiveConfirm && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 border-t border-rose-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-700">
                Are you sure you want to remove {formData.name}?
              </span>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowArchiveConfirm(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onArchive(item);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1 bg-rose-600 text-xs font-bold text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-700 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Confirm Archive
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Drawer Footer Actions */}
          <div className="p-6 border-t border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-between">
            {isEditing && !showArchiveConfirm ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowArchiveConfirm(true)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
                </svg>
                <span>Archive</span>
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div />
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200/60 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isEditing ? 'Save Changes' : 'Add to Menu'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```
// Helper for price formatting
const formatPrice = (p) => {
  if (typeof p === 'number') return `₱${p.toFixed(2)}`;
  if (!p) return '₱0.00';
  const str = String(p);
  if (str.startsWith('₱')) return str;
  if (str.startsWith('P')) return `₱${str.slice(1)}`;
  return `₱${str}`;
};

// Helper for secure random password generator
const generateRandomPassword = () => {
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789!@#$%^&*';
  let pass = 'Beardista#';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    pass += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }
  return pass;
};

// ==============================================================================
// MAIN COMPONENT: MobileAdminLayout
// ==============================================================================
export const MobileAdminLayout = ({
  activeTab: propActiveTab,
  onTabChange,
  onLogout,
  onSwitchToDesktop,
  onSwitchToCustomerMenu,
  children
}) => {
  // Navigation State: 'dashboard' | 'menu' | 'analytics' | 'contents' | 'users' | 'audit'
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState(propActiveTab || 'dashboard');
  const activeTab = propActiveTab || currentTab;

  const handleSelectTab = (tabId) => {
    setCurrentTab(tabId);
    if (onTabChange) onTabChange(tabId);
    setIsBottomSheetOpen(false);
    setIsDrawerOpen(false);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  // Synced Live Application States from adminMockData
  const [menuItems, setMenuItems] = useState(initialMenuItems);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState(initialCategories);
  const [auditLogs, setAuditLogs] = useState(initialAuditLogs);
  const [contentData, setContentData] = useState(initialContentData);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState(INITIAL_USERS);
  const [isGlobalAvailable, setIsGlobalAvailable] = useState(true);

  // Filter & Search States
  const [menuSearch, setMenuSearch] = useState('');
  const [menuFilter, setMenuFilter] = useState('All Items');
  const [userSearch, setUserSearch] = useState('');
  const [userRoleFilter, setUserRoleFilter] = useState('All');

  // UI Interactive States
  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isBottomSheetOpen, setIsBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  // Modals
  const [isAddProductModalOpen, setIsAddProductModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAddCategoryModalOpen, setIsAddCategoryModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSurveyModalOpen, setIsSurveyModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // User Management Drawers & Modals
  const [isUserModalOpen, setIsUserModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState(null);
  const [userToDelete, setUserToDelete] = useState(null);

  const [userFormData, setUserFormData] = useState({
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    email: '',
    role: 'Store Admin',
    status: 'Active',
    password: ''
  });
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [passwordCopied, setPasswordCopied] = useState(false);
  const [userFormError, setUserFormError] = useState('');

  // Toast Trigger
  const showToast = (msg) => {
    setToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3200);
  };

  // Log Audit Action Helper
  const logAudit = (action, actionType, itemAffected, itemId, previousValue, newValue) => {
    const newLog = {
      id: `log-${Date.now()}`,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }),
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
      action,
      actionType,
      itemAffected,
      itemId,
      previousValue,
      newValue,
      user: 'admin@beardistabrew.com'
    };
    setAuditLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev]);
  };

  // Toggle individual item availability (synced with master global toggle)
  const handleToggleItem = (id) => {
    if (!isGlobalAvailable) {
      showToast('Global store availability is paused. Switch Global Store Online to update item inventory.');
      return;
    }
    setMenuItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = item.available !== undefined ? !item.available : !item.availability;
          logAudit(
            'Availability Toggle',
            'update',
            item.name,
            `menu-${id}`,
            updated ? 'Unavailable' : 'Available',
            updated ? 'Available' : 'Unavailable'
          );
          return { ...item, available: updated, availability: updated };
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  // Page Header Title mapping
  const getPageTitle = () => {
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return 'Dashboard Overview';
      case 'menu':
        return 'Menu Management';
      case 'analytics':
        return 'Survey Analytics';
      case 'contents':
        return 'Content Manager';
      case 'users':
        return 'User Management';
      case 'audit':
        return 'Audit Logs';
      default:
        return 'Beardista Brew';
    }
  };

  // Filtered menu items
  const filteredMenuItems = useMemo(() => {
    return menuItems.filter((item) => {
      const q = menuSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (item.description && item.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (item.flavorNotes && item.flavorNotes.toLowerCase().includes(q));

      const matchesCat =
        menuFilter === 'All Items' ||
        item.category?.toLowerCase() === menuFilter.toLowerCase();

      return matchesSearch && matchesCat;
    });
  }, [menuItems, menuSearch, menuFilter]);

  // Filtered users for User Management
  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    return users.filter((u) => {
      const q = userSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        u.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        u.email.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        u.role.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      const matchesRole =
        userRoleFilter === 'All' ||
        (userRoleFilter === 'Suspended' ? u.status === 'Suspended' : u.role === userRoleFilter);

      return matchesSearch && matchesRole;
    });
  }, [users, userSearch, userRoleFilter]);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // USER MANAGEMENT ACTIONS
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleOpenAddUser = () => {
    setEditingUser(null);
    setUserFormData({
      firstName: '',
      lastName: '',
      email: '',
      role: 'Store Admin',
      status: 'Active',
      password: generateRandomPassword()
    });
    setUserFormError('');
    setShowPassword(false);
    setPasswordCopied(false);
    setIsUserModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditUser = (user) => {
    setEditingUser(user);
    const mappedRole = user.role === 'Owner' ? 'Owner Admin' : 'Store Admin';
    setUserFormData({
      firstName: user.firstName || user.name.split(' ')[0] || '',
      lastName: user.lastName || user.name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ') || '',
      email: user.email,
      role: mappedRole,
      status: user.status || 'Active',
      password: ''
    });
    setUserFormError('');
    setShowPassword(false);
    setPasswordCopied(false);
    setIsUserModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveUser = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!userFormData.firstName.trim() || !userFormData.lastName.trim()) {
      setUserFormError('Please enter both first and last name.');
      return;
    }
    if (!userFormData.email.trim() || !userFormData.email.includes('@')) {
      setUserFormError('Please enter a valid administrative email address.');
      return;
    }

    const normalizedRole = userFormData.role === 'Owner Admin' ? 'Owner' : 'Admin';
    const fullName = `${userFormData.firstName.trim()} ${userFormData.lastName.trim()}`;

    if (editingUser) {
      setUsers((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === editingUser.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                firstName: userFormData.firstName.trim(),
                lastName: userFormData.lastName.trim(),
                name: fullName,
                email: userFormData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
                role: normalizedRole,
                status: userFormData.status
              }
            : u
        )
      );
      logAudit('Update User', 'update', fullName, editingUser.id, editingUser.role, normalizedRole);
      showToast(`User "${fullName}" updated successfully!`);
    } else {
      const newUser = {
        id: `usr-${Date.now()}`,
        firstName: userFormData.firstName.trim(),
        lastName: userFormData.lastName.trim(),
        name: fullName,
        email: userFormData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
        role: normalizedRole,
        status: userFormData.status,
        lastLogin: 'Pending First Login',
        avatar: '/src/assets/beardista sign.jpg'
      };
      setUsers((prev) => [newUser, ...prev]);
      logAudit('Create Admin', 'create', fullName, newUser.id, 'None', `Role: ${normalizedRole}`);
      showToast(`New admin "${fullName}" added with role ${normalizedRole}.`);
    }

    setIsUserModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleConfirmRevoke = () => {
    if (!userToDelete) return;
    const deletedName = userToDelete.name;
    const deletedId = userToDelete.id;
    setUsers((prev) => prev.filter((u) => u.id !== deletedId));
    logAudit('Revoke Access', 'delete', deletedName, deletedId, 'Active Access', 'Access Revoked');
    setUserToDelete(null);
    showToast(`Access revoked for ${deletedName}.`);
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // BOTTOM SHEET ACTIONS
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleSheetAction = (actionKey) => {
    setIsBottomSheetOpen(false);

    switch (actionKey) {
      // Menu Tab Actions
      case 'add-product':
        setIsAddProductModalOpen(true);
        break;
      case 'add-category':
        setIsAddCategoryModalOpen(true);
        break;
      case 'import-csv':
        showToast('Menu CSV template generated. Upload CSV file to batch sync items.');
        break;

      // Analytics Tab Actions
      case 'create-survey':
        setIsSurveyModalOpen(true);
        break;
      case 'generate-pdf':
        showToast('Generating Executive CSAT & NPS PDF summary report...');
        setTimeout(() => showToast('Executive PDF generated and downloaded.'), 1000);
        break;
      case 'export-csv': {
        const csvContent =
          'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,Date,Customer,Rating,Pillar,Comments\n' +
          individualFeedbackList
            .map((f) => `"${f.date}","${f.name}",${f.rating},"${f.preference}","${f.comment}"`)
            .join('\n');
        const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
        link.setAttribute('download', 'beardista_customer_survey_raw.csv');
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        showToast('Customer survey responses exported to CSV.');
        break;
      }

      // Audit Tab Actions
      case 'backup-logs': {
        const jsonContent =
          'data:text/json;charset=utf-8,' +
          encodeURIComponent(
            JSON.stringify(
              {
                store: 'Beardista Brew Flagship',
                exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                totalLogs: auditLogs.length,
                logs: auditLogs
              },
              null,
              2
            )
          );
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.setAttribute('href', jsonContent);
        link.setAttribute('download', 'beardista_audit_trail_backup.json');
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        showToast('Audit trail and security register backed up successfully.');
        break;
      }

      // User Management Tab Actions
      case 'add-admin':
        handleOpenAddUser();
        break;
      case 'export-users': {
        const csvContent =
          'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,ID,Name,Email,Role,Status,LastLogin\n' +
          users.map((u) => `"${u.id}","${u.name}","${u.email}","${u.role}","${u.status}","${u.lastLogin}"`).join('\n');
        const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
        link.setAttribute('download', 'beardista_admin_directory.csv');
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        showToast('Admin staff directory exported to CSV.');
        break;
      }

      // Dashboard & Contents Tab Actions
      case 'refresh-stock':
        showToast('Inventory levels verified: All 14 signature espresso roasts in stock.');
        break;
      case 'open-shift':
        showToast('Shift float verified: ₱5,000.00 cash float logged.');
        break;
      case 'add-barista':
        showToast('Barista photo roster uploader ready in Content Manager.');
        break;

      default:
        showToast(`Action executed: ${actionKey}`);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8F9FA] text-[#19244E] font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif] selection:bg-[#E58422] selection:text-white flex flex-col relative antialiased">
      {/* Toast Notification Banner (Clean SVG indicator) */}
      {toast && (
        <div className="fixed top-14 left-4 right-4 z-[9999] bg-[#19244E] text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-white/20 flex items-center gap-3 animate-slideDown max-w-sm mx-auto">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] animate-pulse flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight">{toast}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* 1. TOP HEADER                                                        */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
        {/* Hamburger Menu Button */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsDrawerOpen(true)}
          className="p-1.5 -ml-1 text-gray-700 hover:text-[#19244E] hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          aria-label="Open Navigation Menu"
        >
          <IconMenu className="w-6 h-6" />
        </button>

        {/* Centered Page Title */}
        <h1 className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#19244E] tracking-tight truncate max-w-[200px] text-center">
          {getPageTitle()}
        </h1>

        {/* Right Action / Profile Icon */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {onSwitchToDesktop && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onSwitchToDesktop}
              className="text-[10px] font-black text-[#E58422] bg-orange-50 hover:bg-orange-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-orange-200 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-all"
              title="Switch to Desktop Admin"
            >
              <IconDesktop className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E58422]" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Desktop</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#19244E] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs shadow-2xs border border-[#E58422]">
            BB
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* MAIN CONTENT AREA (Handles scroll behind fixed bottom tab bar)       */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <main className="flex-1 pb-28 overflow-y-auto">
        {children ? (
          children
        ) : (
          <div className="max-w-md mx-auto p-4 space-y-5">
            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* VIEW 1: DASHBOARD TAB                                            */}
            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
              <div className="space-y-5 animate-fadeIn">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                    Today's Snapshot
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                    A quick look at current operational metrics.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* 2x2 Operational Metrics Grid (Synced with initialAdminStats) */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  {/* Card 1: Daily Visits */}
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-4 border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600">Daily Visits</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200">
                        {initialAdminStats[0]?.change || '+12.4%'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="my-2">
                      <span className="text-3xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                        {initialAdminStats[0]?.value || '1,428'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      {initialAdminStats[0]?.subtext || 'vs. yesterday (1,270)'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Card 2: Responses */}
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-4 border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600">Responses</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-[#E58422] bg-orange-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-orange-200">
                        Today
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="my-2">
                      <span className="text-3xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                        {initialAdminStats[1]?.value || '384'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      {initialAdminStats[1]?.subtext || '88% positive satisfaction'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Card 3: Most Requested */}
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-4 border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">
                      MOST REQUESTED
                    </span>
                    <div className="my-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-orange-50 text-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center">
                        <IconCoffee className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-extrabold text-xs text-[#19244E] truncate">
                        {initialAdminStats[2]?.value || 'Alon at Apoy'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      {initialAdminStats[2]?.change || '412 orders'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Card 4: Feedback (Dark Navy Card with 5 SVG Stars) */}
                  <div className="bg-[#19244E] text-white rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300">
                        FEEDBACK
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                        <IconStarSolid />
                        <IconStarSolid />
                        <IconStarSolid />
                        <IconStarSolid />
                        <IconStarSolid />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-medium italic text-gray-200 my-1.5 leading-snug">
                      "{individualFeedbackList[0]?.comment || 'The Tsamporado really hits the spot especially in this rainy weather!'}"
                    </p>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-[#E58422] text-right font-bold">
                      — {individualFeedbackList[0]?.name || 'Sarah J.'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Customer Favorites Section (Synced with customerFavoritesThisMonth) */}
                <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                      Customer Favorites
                    </h3>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSelectTab('menu')}
                      className="text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>View All Menu</span>
                      <IconChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {customerFavoritesThisMonth.map((fav) => (
                    <div
                      key={fav.id}
                      className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                        <img
                          src={fav.image}
                          alt={fav.name}
                          className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover border border-gray-100 flex-shrink-0"
                        />
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="text-xs font-black text-[#19244E] truncate">
                            {fav.name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 truncate">
                            {fav.category}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                        <div className="text-sm font-black text-[#19244E]">{fav.orders}</div>
                        <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-wider">ORDERS</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* VIEW 2: MENU MANAGEMENT TAB                                      */}
            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {activeTab === 'menu' && (
              <div className="space-y-4 animate-fadeIn">
                {/* Search Bar */}
                <div className="relative">
                  <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">
                    <IconSearch className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </span>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={menuSearch}
                    onChange={(e) => setMenuSearch(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search menu items..."
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-3 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 placeholder-gray-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] outline-none shadow-2xs"
                  />
                  {menuSearch && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setMenuSearch('')}
                      className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1"
                    >
                      <IconClose className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Category Filter Pills (Synced with categories) */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 no-scrollbar">
                  {['All Items', ...categories.filter((c) => c.name !== 'All Items').map((c) => c.name)].map((cat) => {
                    const isSelected = menuFilter === cat;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={cat}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setMenuFilter(cat)}
                        className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-[#19244E] text-white shadow-2xs'
                            : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {cat}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* Master All Available Toggle */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 border border-gray-200/80 shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${isGlobalAvailable ? 'bg-blue-600 animate-pulse' : 'bg-gray-400'}`} />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">
                      All Available <span className="text-gray-400 font-normal">[Master]</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const next = !isGlobalAvailable;
                      setIsGlobalAvailable(next);
                      showToast(next ? 'Global store ordering active.' : 'Global store ordering paused.');
                      logAudit(
                        'Global Availability Toggle',
                        'update',
                        'Store Catalog',
                        'SYS-CATALOG',
                        isGlobalAvailable ? 'Online' : 'Paused',
                        next ? 'Online' : 'Paused'
                      );
                    }}
                    className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
                      isGlobalAvailable ? 'bg-blue-600' : 'bg-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform ${
                        isGlobalAvailable ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E]">
                      MENU INVENTORY
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      Showing {filteredMenuItems.length} live items
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsAddProductModalOpen(true)}
                    className="px-3 py-1 bg-[#E58422] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <IconPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Add Item</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Items List (Synced with menuItems) */}
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {filteredMenuItems.map((item) => {
                    const isItemAvailable = item.available !== undefined ? item.available : item.availability;
                    const effectiveAvailable = isGlobalAvailable && isItemAvailable;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={item.id}
                        className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 border border-gray-100 shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                          <img
                            src={item.image}
                            alt={item.name}
                            className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover border border-gray-100 flex-shrink-0 transition-opacity ${
                              effectiveAvailable ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-40 grayscale'
                            }`}
                          />
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="text-xs font-black text-[#19244E] uppercase truncate">
                              {item.name}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 truncate">
                              {item.description || item.flavorNotes || 'Signature Beardista creation'}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-shrink-0">
                          <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                            {formatPrice(item.price)}
                          </span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleToggleItem(item.id)}
                            className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
                              effectiveAvailable ? 'bg-blue-600' : 'bg-gray-300'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span
                              className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform ${
                                effectiveAvailable ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                              }`}
                            />
                          </button>
                        </div>
```
