```
import React, { useState } from 'react';

/**
 * SurveyModal component renders the 3-step interactive customer feedback flow.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Boolean controlling modal visibility
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Dismiss callback to hide modal
 */
export const SurveyModal = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  // Guard clause: Return null if modal is not open to avoid unnecessary DOM rendering
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // ============================================================================
  // STATE MANAGEMENT
  // ============================================================================

  // Single formData state object holding all user inputs across the steps
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    ageGroup: '',
    visitFrequency: 'Weekly regular',
    orderPreferences: ['Coffee'],
    orderHighlight: '',
    rating: 'Excellent',
    notes: ''
  });

  // State tracking the active step in the multi-step survey flow (1, 2, or 3)
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);

  // Helper function to update specific fields in the single formData state object
  const updateFormField = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: value
    }));
  };

  // Helper to toggle order preferences pill selection
  const toggleOrderPreference = (category) => {
    setFormData((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.orderPreferences.includes(category);
      if (exists) {
        return {
          ...prev,
          orderPreferences: prev.orderPreferences.filter((c) => c !== category)
        };
      } else {
        return {
          ...prev,
          orderPreferences: [...prev.orderPreferences, category]
        };
      }
    });
  };

  // Navigation handlers
  const handleNext = () => {
    setCurrentStep(2);
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    setCurrentStep(1);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // MOCK DATABASE FUNCTION
  // Executed on Submit click in Step 2 to simulate MySQL backend persistence
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();

    // Required simulation log for the academic examination panel
    console.log("Simulating MySQL Database POST request:", formData);

    // Transition to Step 3: Success Screen
    setCurrentStep(3);
  };

  // Reset and close handler
  const handleDone = () => {
    // Reset back to Step 1 for future opens
    setCurrentStep(1);
    if (onClose) onClose();
  };

  return (
    // Fixed backdrop overlay with dimming background blur
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={handleDone}
    >
      {/* Modal Dialog Card */}
      <div
        className="bg-white w-full max-w-2xl rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-black/10 flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] animate-scaleUp text-[#111111]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} // Prevent closing when clicking inside modal
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MODAL HEADER: Title, Subtitle, Close Button & Progress Bar          */}
        {/* (Rendered on Step 1 and Step 2 as shown in the reference images)    */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {currentStep !== 3 && (
          <div className="pt-6 px-6 sm:px-8 bg-white shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between pb-4">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                  We Value Your Input
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-neutral-500 font-medium mt-1">
                  Help us brew a better experience. (Step {currentStep} of 3)
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Close '✕' Button */}
              <button
                onClick={handleDone}
                className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-700 p-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Close survey"
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Stepped Progress Bar: 33% on Step 1, 66% on Step 2 */}
            <div className="w-full bg-neutral-100 h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="bg-[#f3832b] h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: currentStep === 1 ? '33.33%' : '66.66%' }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MODAL BODY CONTAINER (Scrollable)                                  */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto grow p-6 sm:p-8">
          
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {/* STEP 1: CUSTOMER PROFILE & ORDER PREFERENCES                      */}
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {currentStep === 1 && (
            <div className="space-y-8 animate-fadeIn">
              
              {/* --- SECTION 1: Customer Profile --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19244E]" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Customer Profile</span>
                </div>

                {/* 2-Column Inputs: Customer Name and Age Group */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-5">
                  {/* Customer Name */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                      Customer Name <span className="text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="John Doe"
                      value={formData.name}
                      onChange={(e) => updateFormField('name', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-none text-sm text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E]"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Age Group Dropdown */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                      Age Group
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <select
                        value={formData.ageGroup}
                        onChange={(e) => updateFormField('ageGroup', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full appearance-none px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md text-sm text-[#19244E] shadow-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E] cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <option value="">Select an age group</option>
                        <option value="Under 18">Under 18</option>
                        <option value="18-24">18-24</option>
                        <option value="25-34">25-34</option>
                        <option value="35-44">35-44</option>
                        <option value="45-54">45-54</option>
                        <option value="55+">55+</option>
                      </select>
                      {/* Dropdown Chevron Glyph */}
                      <span className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-3 pointer-events-none text-neutral-500">
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" />
                        </svg>
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Visit Frequency: 2x2 Grid Selection */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2">
                    Visit Frequency
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    {[
                      'First-time visitor',
                      'Weekly regular',
                      'Monthly regular',
                      'Occasional'
                    ].map((frequency) => {
                      const isSelected = formData.visitFrequency === frequency;
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={frequency}
                          onClick={() => updateFormField('visitFrequency', frequency)}
                          className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border flex items-center cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-[#fff6ee] border-[#f3832b] shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-[#fffaf5] border-[#f7e6d5] hover:border-orange-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {/* Radio Check Circle */}
                          <div
                            className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border mr-3 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                              isSelected ? 'border-[#f3832b]' : 'border-neutral-400'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isSelected && <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#f3832b]" />}
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[#19244E]">
                            {frequency}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* --- SECTION 2: Order & Menu Preferences --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  {/* Crossed Cutlery Glyph */}
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19244E]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Order &amp; Menu Preferences</span>
                </div>

                {/* Question: What did you order today? */}
                <div className="mb-5">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2.5">
                    What did you order today?
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
                    {['Coffee', 'Non-Coffee', 'Cocktails', 'Food'].map((category) => {
                      const isSelected = formData.orderPreferences.includes(category);
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={category}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => toggleOrderPreference(category)}
                          className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-[#19244E] text-white shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-neutral-100 hover:bg-neutral-200 text-[#19244E]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {category}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Highlight of your order */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                    What was the highlight of your order today? <span className="text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g., The creamy-salty foam on the Hiromi"
                    value={formData.orderHighlight}
                    onChange={(e) => updateFormField('orderHighlight', e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-none text-sm text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {/* STEP 2: EXPERIENCE & ADDITIONAL NOTES                             */}
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {currentStep === 2 && (
            <div className="space-y-8 animate-fadeIn">
              
              {/* --- SECTION 1: Your Experience --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  <span className="text-lg leading-none">★</span>
                  <span>Your Experience</span>
                </div>

                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-3">
                  How would you rate your overall experience at Beardista Brew today?
                </label>

                {/* 5-Point Emoticon Scale Cards */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                  {[
                    { label: 'Very Poor', icon: '😵' },
                    { label: 'Poor', icon: '🙁' },
                    { label: 'Average', icon: '😐' },
                    { label: 'Good', icon: '🙂' },
                    { label: 'Excellent', icon: '😄' }
                  ].map((tier) => {
                    const isSelected = formData.rating === tier.label;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={tier.label}
                        onClick={() => updateFormField('rating', tier.label)}
                        className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2.5 sm:p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer text-center ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-[#19244E] text-white border-[#19244E] shadow-md scale-102'
                            : 'bg-[#fffaf5] border-[#f7e6d5] hover:border-orange-300 text-[#19244E]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Emoticon Face */}
                        <span className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl mb-1.5">{tier.icon}</span>
                        {/* Tier Label */}
                        <span
                          className={`text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold leading-tight ${
                            isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#19244E]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {tier.label}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* --- SECTION 2: Additional Notes --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  {/* Notes / Pen Glyph */}
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19244E]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Additional Notes</span>
                </div>

                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2">
                  Any other thoughts, suggestions, or feedback? <span className="text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                </label>

                <textarea
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder="Tell us more! We'd love to hear about your favorite drink, our staff, or anything we can improve..."
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFormField('notes', e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-none text-sm text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E] leading-relaxed"
                />
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {/* STEP 3: SUCCESS CONFIRMATION                                      */}
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {currentStep === 3 && (
            <div className="py-8 sm:py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center animate-fadeIn">
              
              {/* Checkmark Badge matching reference image */}
              <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-[#fff2e5] p-2.5 flex items-center justify-center mb-6 shadow-xs border border-[#fde4cc]">
                <div className="w-full h-full rounded-xl bg-[#f3832b] flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-sm">
                  <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={3}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Thank You Title */}
              <h3 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight mb-3">
                Thank You!
              </h3>

              {/* Confirmation Text */}
              <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-neutral-600 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed mb-8">
                Your feedback has been successfully submitted. We appreciate your time and look forward to serving you again soon!
              </p>

              {/* Done Close Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDone}
                className="w-48 py-3 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                DONE
              </button>

            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MODAL FOOTER ACTIONS                                               */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {currentStep === 1 && (
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 bg-white border-t border-black/5 flex justify-end shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleNext}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-7 py-3 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>NEXT</span>
              <span>→</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {currentStep === 2 && (
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 bg-white border-t border-black/5 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            {/* Back Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleBack}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#f3832b] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>←</span>
              <span>Back</span>
            </button>

            {/* Submit Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-7 py-3 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>SUBMIT</span>
              <span>✓</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SurveyModal;
```

```
import React from 'react';

/**

        </h2>

              {/* Feature Title */}
              <h3 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                {data.mustTry.title}

              {/* Feature Description */}

              >

};
```

```
import React from 'react';

/**
 * WhyChooseUs component renders the four core pillars of the cafe.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Array} props.pillars - Array of brand pillars from menuData
 */
export const WhyChooseUs = ({ pillars }) => {
  // SVG Icon Renderer for clean, crisp vector rendering matching the reference design
  const renderIcon = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'coffee':
        // Minimalist coffee cup with steam vector
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M18 8h1a4 4 0 010 8h-1M2 8h16v9a4 4 0 01-4 4H6a4 4 0 01-4-4V8zM6 1v3M10 1v3M14 1v3" />
          </svg>
        );
      case 'sparkle':
        // 4-point sparkle star vector representing bold creations
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 2l2.4 7.6L22 12l-7.6 2.4L12 22l-2.4-7.6L2 12l7.6-2.4L12 2z" />
          </svg>
        );
      case 'shield':
        // Quality guarantee shield with checkmark vector
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z" />
          </svg>
        );
      case 'users':
        // Community group vector
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
          </svg>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    // Section wrapper with warm cream background and subtle divider
    <section className="py-16 md:py-24 bg-[#FFF3E7] px-6 md:px-16 text-[#111111] border-t border-black/10">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        
        {/* Centered Headline */}
        <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold mb-16 text-center uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E]">
          WHY CHOOSE BEARDISTA?
        </h2>

        {/* 4-Pillar Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-12">
          {pillars.map((pillar) => (
            <div key={pillar.id} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
              
              {/* Icon Container with subtle hover animation */}
              <div className="w-20 h-20 mb-6 flex items-center justify-center transition-transform hover:scale-110">
                {renderIcon(pillar.iconType)}
              </div>

              {/* Pillar Title */}
              <h3 className="text-2xl mb-4 font-bold text-[#111111]">
                {pillar.title}
              </h3>

              {/* Pillar Explanation */}
              <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-[#111111]/80 leading-relaxed max-w-xs">
                {pillar.description}
              </p>

            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
```

## beardista-brew/src/features/menu/ItemDetailsModal.jsx

```
import React from 'react';

/**
 * ItemDetailsModal component displays the deep specification for a menu item.
 * Standardized to uniform dimensions matching the Stubble visual reference.
 * 
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Object|null} props.item - Currently selected item, or null if modal is closed
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Callback to dismiss the modal dialog
 */
export const ItemDetailsModal = ({ item, onClose }) => {
  // Guard clause: Render nothing if no item is selected to minimize DOM overhead
  if (!item) return null;

  // Determine if item is food or drink to adapt the description section header
  const isFood = item.category === 'Pasta' || item.category === 'Food' || item.category === 'Rice' || item.category === 'Salad';
  const aboutHeading = isFood ? 'ABOUT THIS ITEM' : 'ABOUT THIS DRINK';

  // Normalize flavor profile array from item data or fallback gracefully
  let flavorTags = [];
  if (Array.isArray(item.flavorProfile) && item.flavorProfile.length > 0) {
    flavorTags = item.flavorProfile;
  } else if (typeof item.flavorProfile === 'string') {
    flavorTags = item.flavorProfile.split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase());
  } else if (item.details && item.details.tastingNotes) {
    flavorTags = item.details.tastingNotes.split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase());
  } else {
    // Default signature profile matching reference image
    flavorTags = ['ROBUST', 'SMOOTH'];
  }

  // Normalize contains / allergen information
  const containsInfo = item.contains || 
    (item.details && item.details.allergens) || 
    (isFood ? 'GLUTEN, DAIRY' : 'COFFEE');

  return (
    // Fixed backdrop overlay with subtle blur
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      {/* Modal Dialog Card: Uniform fixed dimensions matching the Stubble reference */}
      <div
        className="bg-white w-full max-w-215 md:h-140 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-black/5 flex flex-col md:flex-row max-h-[92dvh] animate-scaleUp"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} // Prevent accidental dismissal on card clicks
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* LEFT PANEL: High-Resolution Product Photograph (Fixed 50% width)   */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <div className="w-full md:w-1/2 h-64 sm:h-72 md:h-full relative bg-neutral-900 shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
          <img
            src={item.image}
            alt={item.name}
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            loading="eager"
          />
          {/* Subtle gradient vignette on mobile viewports */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-t from-black/25 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none md:hidden" />
        </div>

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* RIGHT PANEL: Drink Name, Price, Description, Flavor, and Contains  */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <div className="w-full md:w-1/2 h-full p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10 flex flex-col justify-start overflow-y-auto bg-white">
          
          {/* Top Row: Orange Close Button positioned at the top right */}
          <div className="flex justify-end mb-3 shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1.5 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-md shadow-xs active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Close details"
            >
              <span className="text-sm leading-none">✕</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Product Title: Ultra-bold navy uppercase */}
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight uppercase leading-none mb-2 font-display">
            {item.name}
          </h2>

          {/* Price Tag in Bold Navy */}
          <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] mb-5">
            {item.price}
          </div>

          {/* Dashed Horizontal Divider Line matching reference image */}
          <div className="w-full border-b border-dashed border-neutral-300 mb-6 shrink-0" />

          {/* Section 1: ABOUT THIS DRINK / ITEM */}
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E] mb-2.5">
              {aboutHeading}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#111111]/85 leading-relaxed font-normal">
              {item.description}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Section 2: FLAVOR PROFILE (Star-badged peach chips) */}
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E] mb-2.5">
              FLAVOR PROFILE
            </h4>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
              {flavorTags.map((flavor, index) => (
                <span
                  key={index}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#fde2cb] text-[#e87823] text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <span className="text-[11px] leading-none">★</span>
                  <span>{flavor}</span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section 3: CONTAINS (Component / Allergen declaration) */}
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E] mb-2">
              CONTAINS
            </h4>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E]">
              {containsInfo}
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ItemDetailsModal;
```

```
// ==============================================================================

export default function MenuPage({ onNavigate, onSelectItem }) {
  // STATE 1: Tracks the currently active category. Defaults to 'Signatures'.
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState('Signatures');

  // STATE 2: Optional search input filter for quick text lookup
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // STATE 3: Local selected item state (fallback when component is tested standalone)
  const [localSelectedItem, setLocalSelectedItem] = useState(null);

  // HANDLER: Card click router
  const handleItemClick = (item) => {
    if (onSelectItem) {
      onSelectItem(item);
    } else {
      setLocalSelectedItem(item);
    }
  };

  // FILTERING LOGIC:
  const filteredItems = mockCafeData.filter((item) => {
    const matchesCategory = item.category === activeCategory;
    const matchesSearch = item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                          item.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    // Outer page container
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#111111] antialiased">

              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 font-medium mt-0.5">
                Explore our craft

            </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('story')}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline md:hidden cursor-pointer"
              >
                About Us →

            )}

            {categoriesList.map((category) => {
              const isActive = activeCategory === category.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={category.name}
                  onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category.name)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer text-left ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#E58422] text-white shadow-md'
                      : 'text-[#19244E] hover:bg-black/5'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-sm shrink-0">{category.icon}</span>
                  <span className="truncate">{category.name}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* Connection Feature: Direct link to About Us from the Menu */}
          {onNavigate && (
            <div className="hidden md:block mt-8 p-4 bg-white/70 rounded-xl border border-black/10">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
                Behind The Brew
              </span>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#19244E] font-semibold mb-1">
                Curious about our roastery?
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-600 mb-3 leading-relaxed">
                Read how Beardista Brew brings specialty coffee to Caloocan.
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('story')}
                className="w-full py-2 px-3 bg-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#19244E]/90 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <span>About Us</span>
                <span>→</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </aside>

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MAIN CONTENT AREA: Search Bar, Category Title, and Product Grid     */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-10">
          
          {/* Top Search Bar */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <div className="relative max-w-2xl">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-neutral-400">
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                </svg>
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="SEARCH THE BREW..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-transparent border border-neutral-300 rounded-md text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Active Category Header with Navy Underline Bar */}
          <div className="mb-8 pb-3 border-b-2 border-[#19244E] inline-block">
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wide">
              {activeCategory}
            </h1>
          </div>

          {/* Empty State Guard */}
          {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center bg-white/50 rounded-2xl border border-black/10">
              <p className="text-base font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                No items available in this category yet.
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 mt-1">
                Try toggling between 'Signatures' and 'Pasta' to test the filter logic!
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            // Responsive 3-Column Item Cards Grid
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {filteredItems.map((item) => (
                <MenuItemCard
                  key={item.id}
                  item={item}
                  onClick={() => handleItemClick(item)}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

        </main>

      </div>

      {/* Standalone Inspection Dialog fallback */}
      {!onSelectItem && (
        <ItemDetailsModal
          item={localSelectedItem}
          onClose={() => setLocalSelectedItem(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ==============================================================================
// 4. SUB-COMPONENT: MenuItemCard
// Renders an individual product card: image, status tag, title, price, description.
// Invokes onClick when selected to view deep ItemDetails.
// ==============================================================================
function MenuItemCard({ item, onClick }) {
  const isAvailable = item.status === 'AVAILABLE';

  return (
    <div
      onClick={onClick}
      className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-black/10 overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col cursor-pointer group"
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={`View details for ${item.name}`}
    >
      {/* Card Image Container with Status Tag Badge */}
      <div className="relative h-56 bg-neutral-100 overflow-hidden">
        <img
          src={item.image}
          alt={item.name}
          className={`w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105 ${
            !isAvailable ? 'grayscale opacity-70' : ''
          }`}
          loading="lazy"
        />

        {/* Status Badge Tag */}
        <span
          className={`absolute top-3 right-3 text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-sm uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm ${
            isAvailable
              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300'
              : 'bg-neutral-200 text-neutral-700 border border-neutral-300'
          }`}
        >
          {item.status}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Card Text Content */}
      <div className="p-5 flex flex-col grow">
        {/* Top Row: Item Title & Orange Price Pill */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#19244E] group-hover:text-[#E58422] transition-colors leading-snug">
            {item.name}
          </h3>
          <span className="bg-[#E58422] text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded shrink-0">
            {item.price}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Item Description */}
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-600 leading-relaxed grow line-clamp-2">
          {item.description}
        </p>

        {/* Visual cue to open ItemDetails */}
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-black/5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider">
          <span>View Details</span>
          <span className="group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform">→</span>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```
@import "tailwindcss";
/* Force Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere in the admin portal */
.font-\[\'Anybody\'\] {

   --font-admin: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;

/* Layout utilities matching provided HTML */
.px-margin-desktop {
  padding-left: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 4rem);

}

@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px) scale(0.97);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes slideRight {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes scaleUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.94);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  20%, 60% { transform: translateX(-6px); }
  40%, 80% { transform: translateX(6px); }
}

.animate-slideUp {
  animation: slideUp 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-slideDown {
  animation: slideDown 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-slideRight {
  animation: slideRight 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.18s ease-out forwards;
}

.animate-scaleUp {
  animation: scaleUp 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-shake {
  animation: shake 0.4s ease-in-out;
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/AnnouncementFormModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ImagePlus } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "../ModalWrapper";
import {
  cancelButtonClass,
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  labelClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
  textareaClass,
} from "../formStyles";
import { todayISO } from "../events/eventUtils";
import AnnouncementPreview from "./AnnouncementPreview";
import { ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES, DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, linkSummary } from "./announcementUtils";

const emptyAnnouncement = {
  type: "new_event",
  custom_label: "",
  title: "",
  description: "",
  image_url: "",
  button_label: "",
  link_type: "none",
  link_target: "",
  starts_at: todayISO(),
  ends_at: "",
};

const URL_PATTERN = /^(https?:\/\/|\/)\S+$/;

// Create / Edit form with a live landing-page preview (beside the form on desktop, under it on phones).
export default function AnnouncementFormModal({ announcement, events, menuItems, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({
    ...emptyAnnouncement,
    ...announcement,
    link_target: announcement ? String(announcement.link_target ?? "") : "",
  }));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const update = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: "" }));
  };

  const changeLinkType = (value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, link_type: value, link_target: "" }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, link_target: "", button_label: "" }));
  };

  const pickImage = (file) => {
    if (file?.type.startsWith("image/")) update("image_url", URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const submit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const label = form.button_label.trim();
    const hasLink = form.link_type !== "none";
    const target = form.link_target.trim();

    const nextErrors = {
      custom_label: form.type === "custom" && !form.custom_label.trim() ? "Give your custom type a label." : "",
      title: form.title.trim() ? "" : "A title is required.",
      description: form.description.trim() ? "" : "A short description is required.",
      button_label: hasLink && !label ? "Add a button label, or choose No button." : "",
      link_target:
        hasLink && !target
          ? "Pick where the button should go."
          : form.link_type === "url" && !URL_PATTERN.test(target)
            ? "Use a full link (https://…) or a page path (/menu)."
            : "",
      ends_at:
        form.starts_at && form.ends_at && form.ends_at < form.starts_at
          ? "End date must be on or after the start date."
          : "",
    };

    if (Object.values(nextErrors).some(Boolean)) {
      setErrors(nextErrors);
      return;
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      custom_label: form.type === "custom" ? form.custom_label.trim() : "",
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      button_label: hasLink ? label : "",
      link_target: form.link_type === "event" || form.link_type === "menu_item" ? Number(target) : target,
    });
  };

  const fieldError = (field) =>
    errors[field] && (
      <p id={`announcement-${field}-error`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
        {errors[field]}
      </p>
    );

  const errorProps = (field, options) => ({
    "aria-invalid": Boolean(errors[field]),
    "aria-describedby": errors[field] ? `announcement-${field}-error` : undefined,
    className: fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors[field]), ...options }),
  });

  const remaining = DESCRIPTION_LIMIT - form.description.length;
  const previewLink =
    form.link_type !== "none" && form.link_target
      ? linkSummary(form, events, menuItems)
      : "";

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={announcement ? "Edit announcement" : "New announcement"}
      description="This card appears in the “What's Brewing” section of the landing page."
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-5xl"
      sheetOnPhone
      dismissible
      footer={
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" form="announcement-form" className={primaryButtonClass}>
            {announcement ? "Save Changes" : "Add Announcement"}
          </button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,22rem)]">
        <form id="announcement-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-type" className={labelClass}>Type</label>
            <select
              id="announcement-type"
              value={form.type}
              onChange={(event) => update("type", event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              {Object.entries(ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES).map(([value, label]) => (
                <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {form.type === "custom" ? (
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="announcement-custom-label" className={labelClass}>
                Custom label <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                id="announcement-custom-label"
                value={form.custom_label}
                onChange={(event) => update("custom_label", event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Community"
                maxLength={24}
                {...errorProps("custom_label")}
              />
              {fieldError("custom_label")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="hidden sm:block" />
          )}

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label htmlFor="announcement-title" className={labelClass}>
              Title <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              id="announcement-title"
              value={form.title}
              onChange={(event) => update("title", event.target.value)}
              maxLength={60}
              {...errorProps("title")}
            />
            {fieldError("title")}
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
              <label htmlFor="announcement-description" className={labelClass}>
                Short description <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <span
                aria-live="polite"
                className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                  remaining <= 0 ? "text-rose-600" : remaining <= 20 ? "text-amber-600" : "text-gray-400"
                }`}
              >
                {form.description.length}/{DESCRIPTION_LIMIT}
              </span>
            </div>
            <textarea
              id="announcement-description"
              rows={3}
              maxLength={DESCRIPTION_LIMIT}
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(event) => update("description", event.target.value)}
              {...errorProps("description", { height: "", padding: "px-4 py-2.5" })}
            />
            {fieldError("description")}
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <p className={labelClass}>Image (optional)</p>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
              <label className="relative flex aspect-[16/9] w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7]/50 text-center sm:w-56">
                {form.image_url ? (
                  <img src={form.image_url} alt="Image preview" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ImagePlus size={22} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Click to upload</span>
                  </>
                )}
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={(event) => pickImage(event.target.files[0])}
                  aria-label="Upload announcement image"
                  className="sr-only"
                />
              </label>
              {form.image_url && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => update("image_url", "")}
                  className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
                >
                  Remove image
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-link-type" className={labelClass}>Button link</label>
            <select
              id="announcement-link-type"
              value={form.link_type}
              onChange={(event) => changeLinkType(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              <option value="none">No button</option>
              <option value="event">An event</option>
              <option value="menu_item">A menu item</option>
              <option value="url">Custom URL</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-button-label" className={labelClass}>Button label</label>
            <input
              id="announcement-button-label"
              value={form.button_label}
              onChange={(event) => update("button_label", event.target.value)}
              placeholder={form.link_type === "none" ? "Pick a link first" : "e.g. Learn more"}
              disabled={form.link_type === "none"}
              maxLength={28}
              {...errorProps("button_label")}
            />
            {fieldError("button_label")}
          </div>

          {form.link_type !== "none" && (
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label htmlFor="announcement-link-target" className={labelClass}>
                {form.link_type === "event" ? "Event" : form.link_type === "menu_item" ? "Menu item" : "URL"}
              </label>
              {form.link_type === "url" ? (
                <input
                  id="announcement-link-target"
                  type="url"
                  value={form.link_target}
                  onChange={(event) => update("link_target", event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="https://… or /menu"
                  {...errorProps("link_target")}
                />
              ) : (
                <select
                  id="announcement-link-target"
                  value={form.link_target}
                  onChange={(event) => update("link_target", event.target.value)}
                  {...errorProps("link_target")}
                >
                  <option value="">Choose…</option>
                  {(form.link_type === "event" ? events : menuItems).map((entry) => (
                    <option key={entry.id} value={entry.id}>
                      {entry.title ?? entry.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              )}
              {fieldError("link_target")}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-start" className={labelClass}>Start date</label>
            <input
              id="announcement-start"
              type="date"
              value={form.starts_at}
              onChange={(event) => update("starts_at", event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-end" className={labelClass}>End date (optional)</label>
            <input
              id="announcement-end"
              type="date"
              value={form.ends_at}
              min={form.starts_at || undefined}
              onChange={(event) => update("ends_at", event.target.value)}
              {...errorProps("ends_at")}
            />
            {fieldError("ends_at")}
          </div>
        </form>

        <div className="lg:sticky lg:top-0 lg:self-start">
          <p className={labelClass}>Live preview</p>
          <AnnouncementPreview values={form} linkText={previewLink} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/AnnouncementsTab.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, GripVertical, Megaphone, Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import DataCard from "../DataCard";
import Pagination from "../Pagination";
import EmptyState from "../EmptyState";
import ModalWrapper, { ToggleSwitch } from "../ModalWrapper";
import { cancelButtonClass } from "../formStyles";
import { usePagination } from "../usePageSize";
import { formatDate, nextId } from "../events/eventUtils";
import AnnouncementFormModal from "./AnnouncementFormModal";
import {
  LIVE_SLOTS,
  dateRange,
  linkSummary,
  liveIds,
  scheduleState,
  sortAnnouncements,
  typeLabel,
} from "./announcementUtils";

const iconButtonClass =
  "flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-[#19244E] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30";

function StatusChip({ announcement, live }) {
  const state = scheduleState(announcement);
  let chip = { label: "Up next", className: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700" };

  if (live) chip = { label: "Live on landing page", className: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" };
  else if (!announcement.is_visible) chip = { label: "Hidden", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-500" };
  else if (state === "scheduled") {
    chip = { label: `Starts ${formatDate(announcement.starts_at, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}`, className: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700" };
  } else if (state === "ended") chip = { label: "Ended", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-500" };

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip.className}`}>
      {live && <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />}
      {chip.label}
    </span>
  );
}

// Controls the "What's Brewing" cards on the customer landing page.
export default function AnnouncementsTab({ announcements, setAnnouncements, events, menuItems, notify }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null);
  const [armedId, setArmedId] = useState(null);
  const [dragId, setDragId] = useState(null);
  const [overId, setOverId] = useState(null);

  const sorted = sortAnnouncements(announcements);
  const live = liveIds(announcements);
  const pager = usePagination(sorted);

  // Saves the new order as sort_order 1, 2, 3…
  const moveTo = (fromId, toIndex) => {
    const ordered = [...sorted];
    const fromIndex = ordered.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === fromId);
    if (fromIndex === -1 || toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= ordered.length) return;
    const [moved] = ordered.splice(fromIndex, 1);
    ordered.splice(toIndex, 0, moved);
    const position = new Map(ordered.map((entry, index) => [entry.id, index + 1]));
    setAnnouncements((all) => all.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, sort_order: position.get(entry.id) })));
  };

  const clearDrag = () => {
    setArmedId(null);
    setDragId(null);
    setOverId(null);
  };

  // Native drag and drop from the handle; phones use the arrow buttons.
  const dragPropsFor = (announcement, index) => ({
    draggable: armedId === announcement.id,
    onDragStart: (event) => {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", String(announcement.id));
      setDragId(announcement.id);
    },
    onDragOver: (event) => {
      if (dragId === null) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (overId !== announcement.id) setOverId(announcement.id);
    },
    onDrop: (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (dragId !== null && dragId !== announcement.id) moveTo(dragId, index);
      clearDrag();
    },
    onDragEnd: clearDrag,
  });

  const toggleVisible = (announcement) => {
    setAnnouncements((all) =>
      all.map((entry) => (entry.id === announcement.id ? { ...entry, is_visible: !entry.is_visible } : entry))
    );
    notify(`${announcement.title} is now ${announcement.is_visible ? "hidden" : "visible"}.`);
  };

  const save = (values) => {
    if (editing.announcement) {
      setAnnouncements((all) =>
        all.map((entry) => (entry.id === editing.announcement.id ? { ...entry, ...values } : entry))
      );
      notify(`${values.title} was updated.`);
    } else {
      setAnnouncements((all) => [
        ...all,
        {
          ...values,
          id: nextId(all),
          is_visible: true,
          sort_order: Math.max(0, ...all.map((entry) => entry.sort_order)) + 1,
        },
      ]);
      notify(`${values.title} was added. Drag it to the top to put it live.`);
    }
    setEditing(null);
  };

  const remove = () => {
    setAnnouncements((all) => all.filter((entry) => entry.id !== deleteTarget.id));
    notify(`${deleteTarget.title} was deleted.`);
    setDeleteTarget(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DataCard
        title="What's Brewing"
        description={`The first ${LIVE_SLOTS} visible cards (inside their dates) show on the customer landing page.`}
        badge={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setEditing({ announcement: null })}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">New announcement</span>
            <span className="sm:hidden">New</span>
          </button>
        }
        bodyClassName=""
        footer={sorted.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="Announcement pages" />}
      >
        {sorted.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Megaphone}
            title="Nothing brewing yet."
            message="Share a new drink, an event or a notice, and it shows up on the landing page."
          />
        ) : (
          <ol className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4]" onPointerUp={() => setArmedId(null)}>
            {pager.pageItems.map((announcement) => {
              const index = sorted.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === announcement.id);
              const link = linkSummary(announcement, events, menuItems);

              return (
                <li
                  key={announcement.id}
                  {...dragPropsFor(announcement, index)}
                  className={`flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3 transition sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-3 sm:px-6 ${
                    overId === announcement.id && dragId !== announcement.id ? "bg-[#FFF3E7]" : ""
                  } ${announcement.is_visible ? "" : "opacity-70"}`}
                >
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onPointerDown={() => setArmedId(announcement.id)}
                      aria-label={`Drag to reorder ${announcement.title}`}
                      title="Drag to reorder"
                      className="hidden h-14 w-6 shrink-0 cursor-grab items-center justify-center text-gray-300 hover:text-gray-500 active:cursor-grabbing sm:flex"
                    >
                      <GripVertical size={18} />
                    </button>

                    {announcement.image_url ? (
                      <img src={announcement.image_url} alt="" className="h-14 w-14 shrink-0 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]">
                        <Megaphone size={22} />
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#E58422]">
                          {typeLabel(announcement)}
                        </span>
                        <StatusChip announcement={announcement} live={live.includes(announcement.id)} />
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{announcement.title}</p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-gray-500">{announcement.description}</p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                        {dateRange(announcement)}
                        {link && ` · ${link}`}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between sm:justify-end">
                    <div className="flex">
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => moveTo(announcement.id, index - 1)} disabled={index === 0} aria-label="Move up" title="Move up" className={iconButtonClass}>
                        <ArrowUp size={17} />
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => moveTo(announcement.id, index + 1)} disabled={index === sorted.length - 1} aria-label="Move down" title="Move down" className={iconButtonClass}>
                        <ArrowDown size={17} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <ToggleSwitch
                        checked={announcement.is_visible}
                        label={`${announcement.is_visible ? "Hide" : "Show"} ${announcement.title} on the landing page`}
                        onToggle={() => toggleVisible(announcement)}
                      />
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing({ announcement })} aria-label={`Edit ${announcement.title}`} title="Edit" className={iconButtonClass}>
                        <Pencil size={16} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(announcement)}
                        aria-label={`Delete ${announcement.title}`}
                        title="Delete"
                        className={`${iconButtonClass} hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600`}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={16} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {editing && (
        <AnnouncementFormModal
          announcement={editing.announcement}
          events={events}
          menuItems={menuItems}
          onCancel={() => setEditing(null)}
          onSave={save}
        />
      )}

      {deleteTarget && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title="Delete this announcement?"
          description={`${deleteTarget.title} will be removed from the landing page list.`}
          onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
          sheetOnPhone
          dismissible
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)} className={cancelButtonClass}>
              Keep
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={remove}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-rose-700"
            >
              Delete
            </button>
          </div>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/announcementUtils.js

```
import { formatDate, todayISO } from "../events/eventUtils";

export const ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES = {
  new_event: "New Event",
  new_drink: "New Drink",
  must_try: "Must Try",
  notice: "Notice",
  custom: "Custom",
};

export const DESCRIPTION_LIMIT = 140;

// How many "What's Brewing" cards the landing page shows.
export const LIVE_SLOTS = 2;

export const typeLabel = (announcement) =>
  announcement.type === "custom"
    ? announcement.custom_label.trim() || "Custom"
    : ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES[announcement.type];

// "scheduled" (starts later) | "ended" | "running"
export const scheduleState = (announcement) => {
  const today = todayISO();
  if (announcement.starts_at && announcement.starts_at > today) return "scheduled";
  if (announcement.ends_at && announcement.ends_at < today) return "ended";
  return "running";
};

export const sortAnnouncements = (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order);

// Ids of the cards the landing page shows right now: the first visible ones inside their dates.
export const liveIds = (list) =>
  sortAnnouncements(list)
    .filter((announcement) => announcement.is_visible && scheduleState(announcement) === "running")
    .slice(0, LIVE_SLOTS)
    .map((announcement) => announcement.id);

export const dateRange = ({ starts_at: start, ends_at: end }) => {
  if (start && end) return `${formatDate(start)} – ${formatDate(end)}`;
  if (start) return `From ${formatDate(start)}`;
  if (end) return `Until ${formatDate(end)}`;
  return "No end date";
};

export const linkSummary = (announcement, events, menuItems) => {
  const target = announcement.link_target;
  if (announcement.link_type === "event") {
    return `Event: ${events.find((event) => event.id === Number(target))?.title ?? "event not found"}`;
  }
  if (announcement.link_type === "menu_item") {
    return `Menu: ${menuItems.find((item) => item.id === Number(target))?.name ?? "item not found"}`;
  }
  if (announcement.link_type === "url") return target;
  return "";
};
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/BaristaAnimation.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { DotLottieReact } from "@lottiefiles/dotlottie-react";
import BrewingLoader, { SteamingCup } from "./BrewingLoader";

// The .lottie file is looked up in AdminRebuild/assets first, then src/testing/assets (where it is now).
// import.meta.glob returns nothing for a missing file, so the app never crashes; the cup is shown instead.
const animationFiles = import.meta.glob(
  ["../assets/barista-animation.lottie", "../../assets/barista-animation.lottie"],
  { eager: true, query: "?url", import: "default" }
);
const ANIMATION_URL = Object.values(animationFiles)[0] ?? null;

// If the player has not loaded after this long (slow or offline), show the cup instead.
const LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

export default function BaristaAnimation({ className = "" }) {
  const [player, setPlayer] = useState(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(ANIMATION_URL ? "loading" : "failed");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!player) return;

    const onLoad = () => setStatus("ready");
    const onError = () => setStatus("failed");
    player.addEventListener("load", onLoad);
    player.addEventListener("loadError", onError);
    if (player.isLoaded) setStatus("ready");

    return () => {
      player.removeEventListener("load", onLoad);
      player.removeEventListener("loadError", onError);
    };
  }, [player]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== "loading") return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setStatus("failed"), LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [status]);

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col items-center ${className}`}>
      <div className="relative flex aspect-square w-full max-w-[22rem] items-center justify-center">
        {status === "failed" ? (
          <SteamingCup size={160} cupColor="#E58422" saucerColor="#FFF3E7" steamColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)" />
        ) : (
          <>
            <DotLottieReact
              src={ANIMATION_URL}
              loop
              autoplay
              dotLottieRefCallback={setPlayer}
              className={`h-full w-full transition-opacity duration-500 ${status === "ready" ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"}`}
            />
            {status === "loading" && (
              <BrewingLoader tone="light" className="absolute" />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="font-display mt-4 text-center text-lg font-bold text-white/90 sm:text-xl">
        Crafted with passion. Served with character.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
// No clean logo file exists in src/assets yet (the logo only appears inside photos).
// Add one as src/assets/beardista_logo.png (or .svg / .jpg / .webp) and the sidebar and

  eager: true,
  import: "default",
});

export const LOGO_URL = Object.values(logoFiles)[0] ?? null;

// The signed-in account shown in the sidebar, top bar and My Account (sample data).
export const OWNER = {
  name: "Jim Carlo Gorospe",
  role: "Owner",
  initials: "JC",
  email: "founder@beardistabrew.com",
  photo: ownerPhoto,
};
```

```
// Coffee cup with CSS-animated rising steam (the .admin-steam animation lives in admin.css).
export function SteamingCup({ size = 64, cupColor = "#E58422", saucerColor = "#19244E", steamColor = "#C9BFB3" }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width={size} height={size} aria-hidden="true">
      <g fill="none" stroke={steamColor} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path className="admin-steam" d="M24 23c-3-4 3-6 0-10" />
        <path className="admin-steam" style={{ animationDelay: "0.6s" }} d="M32 23c-3-4 3-6 0-10" />
        <path className="admin-steam" style={{ animationDelay: "1.2s" }} d="M40 23c-3-4 3-6 0-10" />
      </g>
      <path d="M14 28h36v7c0 9.4-7.6 17-17 17h-2c-9.4 0-17-7.6-17-17z" fill={cupColor} />
      <path d="M50 31h3a6 6 0 0 1 0 12h-4" fill="none" stroke={cupColor} strokeWidth="3.5" />
      <rect x="9" y="54" width="46" height="4" rx="2" fill={saucerColor} />
    </svg>
  );
}

// Small loader for loading states: a steaming cup with "Brewing...".
// tone="light" is for dark backgrounds (navy panels, orange buttons).
export default function BrewingLoader({ label = "Brewing...", size = 40, tone = "dark", className = "" }) {
  const light = tone === "light";

  return (
    <span role="status" className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 ${className}`}>
      <SteamingCup
        size={size}
        cupColor={light ? "#FFFFFF" : "#E58422"}
        saucerColor={light ? "#FFF3E7" : "#19244E"}
        steamColor={light ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" : "#C9BFB3"}
      />
      <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${light ? "text-white" : "text-[#19244E]"}`}>{label}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```
