## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/CategoryModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, Coffee, CupSoda, ImagePlus, Leaf, UtensilsCrossed } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper, { ToggleSwitch } from "./ModalWrapper";
import {
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  textareaClass,
  labelClass,
  cancelButtonClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
} from "./formStyles";
import { categoryGroups, toSlug } from "./categoryUtils";

const highlightColors = [
  { name: "Brand Orange", value: "#E58422" },
  { name: "Navy", value: "#19244E" },
  { name: "Emerald", value: "#059669" },
  { name: "Sky", value: "#0284C7" },
  { name: "Violet", value: "#7C3AED" },
  { name: "Rose", value: "#E11D48" },
];

const categoryBadges = [
  { name: "coffee", label: "Coffee", icon: Coffee },
  { name: "drink", label: "Cold drink", icon: CupSoda },
  { name: "leaf", label: "Tea and matcha", icon: Leaf },
  { name: "food", label: "Food", icon: UtensilsCrossed },
];

export default function CategoryModal({
  category,
  existingNames,
  defaultPriority,
  onCancel,
  onSave,
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({
    name: category?.name ?? "",
    priority: String(category?.priority ?? defaultPriority),
    description: category?.description ?? "",
    group: category?.group ?? categoryGroups[0],
    color: category?.color ?? highlightColors[0].value,
    badge: category?.badge ?? "",
    iconImage: category?.iconImage ?? "",
    showOnMenu: category?.showOnMenu ?? true,
  }));
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [showMore, setShowMore] = useState(false);
  const slug = toSlug(form.name);

  const update = (field, value) =>
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));

  // Preview only: the picked file stays in the browser and is never uploaded.
  const chooseIcon = (event) => {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (file) setForm((current) => ({ ...current, iconImage: URL.createObjectURL(file), badge: "" }));
    event.target.value = "";
  };

  const save = (status) => {
    const name = form.name.trim();

    if (!name) return setError("Category Name is required.");
    if (existingNames.some((existing) => existing.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())) {
      return setError(`"${name}" already exists.`);
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      name,
      slug,
      priority: Number(form.priority) || 0,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      status,
    });
  };

  const submit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    save("active");
  };

  const footer = (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
        Cancel
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => save("draft")}
        className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#B96916] transition hover:bg-orange-100"
      >
        Save as Draft
      </button>
      <button type="submit" form="category-form" className={`col-span-2 ${primaryButtonClass}`}>
        {category ? "Save Changes" : "Create Category"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={category ? "Edit Category" : "Add Category"}
      description="Group menu items so customers can browse them easily."
      footer={footer}
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-2xl"
    >
      {/* Phones show the essentials first; sm:contents lets the extra fields join the desktop grid. */}
      <form id="category-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="sm:order-2">
          <label htmlFor="category-name" className={labelClass}>
            Category Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="category-name"
            type="text"
            value={form.name}
            onChange={(event) => {
              update("name", event.target.value);
              setError("");
            }}
            autoFocus
            aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
            aria-describedby={error ? "category-name-error" : undefined}
            className={fieldClass({ error: Boolean(error) })}
          />
          {error && (
            <p id="category-name-error" className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="sm:order-5">
          <label htmlFor="category-group" className={labelClass}>Department / Group</label>
          <select
            id="category-group"
            value={form.group}
            onChange={(event) => update("group", event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          >
            {categoryGroups.map((group) => (
              <option key={group} value={group}>{group}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 py-1 pl-4 pr-1 sm:order-8 sm:self-end">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">Show on Menu</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              {form.showOnMenu ? "Visible to customers" : "Hidden from customers"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <ToggleSwitch
            checked={form.showOnMenu}
            label="Show category on menu"
            onToggle={() => update("showOnMenu", !form.showOnMenu)}
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowMore((value) => !value)}
          aria-expanded={showMore}
          aria-controls="category-more"
          className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:hidden"
        >
          More details
          <ChevronDown size={18} className={`transition-transform ${showMore ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
        </button>

        <div
          id="category-more"
          className={`${showMore ? "grid" : "hidden"} grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:contents`}
        >
          <div className="col-span-2 sm:order-1">
            <p className={labelClass}>Category Icon</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <label className="flex h-16 w-16 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916] transition focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-orange-200 hover:border-[#E58422]">
                {form.iconImage ? (
                  <img src={form.iconImage} alt="Category icon preview" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  <ImagePlus size={22} />
                )}
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={chooseIcon}
                  aria-label="Upload category icon"
                  className="sr-only"
                />
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">or pick a badge</span>
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                {categoryBadges.map(({ name, label, icon: Icon }) => {
                  const selected = form.badge === name;

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={name}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, badge: name, iconImage: "" }))}
                      aria-pressed={selected}
                      aria-label={label}
                      title={label}
                      className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border transition ${
                        selected
                          ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]"
                          : "border-gray-200 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Icon size={18} />
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:order-3">
            <label htmlFor="category-slug" className={labelClass}>Slug</label>
            <input
              id="category-slug"
              type="text"
              value={slug}
              readOnly
              placeholder="auto-generated"
              className={`${fieldClass({ background: "bg-gray-100" })} cursor-default`}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:order-4">
            <label htmlFor="category-priority" className={labelClass}>Sort Priority</label>
            <input
              id="category-priority"
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min="0"
              value={form.priority}
              onChange={(event) => update("priority", event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="col-span-2 sm:order-6">
            <label htmlFor="category-description" className={labelClass}>Description</label>
            <textarea
              id="category-description"
              rows={2}
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(event) => update("description", event.target.value)}
              className={textareaClass}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="col-span-2 sm:order-7 sm:col-span-1">
            <p className={labelClass}>Highlight Color</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap">
              {highlightColors.map(({ name, value }) => (
                <button
                  key={value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => update("color", value)}
                  aria-pressed={form.color === value}
                  aria-label={name}
                  title={name}
                  className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full"
                >
                  <span
                    style={{ backgroundColor: value }}
                    className={`h-7 w-7 rounded-full ring-offset-2 transition ${
                      form.color === value ? "ring-2 ring-[#19244E]" : ""
                    }`}
                  />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}
```

```
export const categoryGroups = [
  "Beverages - Coffee Bar",
  "Beverages - Non-Coffee",
  "Food",
];

export const toSlug = (name) =>
  name
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/AnswerField.jsx

```
import { inputClass, textareaClass } from "../formStyles";

// One registration-form question, drawn the way customers see it.
// Used by the form preview and by the participant panel (to edit answers).
export default function AnswerField({ id, question, value, onChange }) {
  const { label, type, required, help_text: helpText, options = [] } = question;
  const helpId = helpText ? `${id}-help` : undefined;
  const listValue = Array.isArray(value) ? value : value ? [value] : [];

  const labelText = (
    <>
      {label || "Untitled question"}
      {required && <span className="text-rose-500"> *</span>}
    </>
  );

  const toggleCheckbox = (option) =>
    onChange(
      listValue.includes(option)
        ? listValue.filter((entry) => entry !== option)
        : [...listValue, option]
    );

  if (type === "multiple_choice" || type === "checkboxes") {
    return (
      <fieldset aria-describedby={helpId}>
        <legend className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{labelText}</legend>
        {helpText && <p id={helpId} className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">{helpText}</p>}
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
          {options.map((option) => (
            <label key={option} className="flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-[#F8F6F3]">
              <input
                type={type === "checkboxes" ? "checkbox" : "radio"}
                name={id}
                checked={listValue.includes(option)}
                onChange={() =>
                  type === "checkboxes" ? toggleCheckbox(option) : onChange(option)
                }
                className="h-4 w-4 accent-[#E58422]"
              />
              {option}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </fieldset>
    );
  }

  const shared = {
    id,
    value: Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : value ?? "",
    onChange: (event) => onChange(event.target.value),
    required,
    "aria-describedby": helpId,
  };

  let control;
  if (type === "paragraph") {
    control = <textarea rows={3} {...shared} className={textareaClass} />;
  } else if (type === "dropdown") {
    control = (
      <select {...shared} className={inputClass}>
        <option value="">Choose…</option>
        {options.map((option) => (
          <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
    );
  } else {
    const inputType = { date: "date", email: "email", phone: "tel" }[type] ?? "text";
    control = <input type={inputType} {...shared} className={inputClass} />;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
        {labelText}
      </label>
      {helpText && <p id={helpId} className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">{helpText}</p>}
      <div className="mt-2">{control}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```
import { BadgeCheck, MailWarning } from "lucide-react";
import { REGISTRATION_STATUS } from "./eventUtils";

// White pill with a coloured dot, readable on top of cover photos.
// `className` sets the display (e.g. "hidden sm:inline-flex"), so it never clashes with a built-in one.
// `flat` swaps the shadow for a border when the pill sits on a white card.
export function EventPill({ pill, className = "inline-flex", flat = false }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/95 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${
        flat ? "border border-[#EAE5DF]" : "shadow-sm"
      } ${pill.text} ${className}`}
    >
      <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${pill.dot}`} />
      {pill.label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function RegistrationStatusBadge({ status }) {
  const { label, className } = REGISTRATION_STATUS[status] ?? REGISTRATION_STATUS.pending;

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${className}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function VerifiedBadge({ verified }) {
  return verified ? (
    <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
      <BadgeCheck size={12} />
      Verified
    </span>
  ) : (
    <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500">
      <MailWarning size={12} />
      Not verified
    </span>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/EventCard.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Image as ImageIcon, MoreHorizontal, Pencil, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { EventPill } from "./Badges";
import { formatTime, parseDate } from "./eventUtils";

const menuItemClass =
  "flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 text-sm font-bold transition";

// Short event card. On laptops the cover strip shrinks (88px down to 32px)
// so two rows of cards always fit the screen without page scroll.
export default function EventCard({
  event,
  pill,
  taken,
  capacity,
  typeCount,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onDuplicate,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;

    const onPointerDown = (pointerEvent) => {
      if (!menuRef.current?.contains(pointerEvent.target)) setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (keyEvent) => {
      if (keyEvent.key === "Escape") setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  const date = parseDate(event.event_date);
  const percent = capacity ? Math.min(100, (taken / capacity) * 100) : 0;

  const pick = (action) => {
    setMenuOpen(false);
    action(event);
  };

  return (
    <article className="flex min-h-0 flex-col rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white shadow-sm">
      <div className="relative h-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-2xl bg-[#FFF3E7] sm:h-[88px] lg:h-auto lg:max-h-[88px] lg:min-h-8 lg:flex-1 lg:shrink">
        {event.cover_image_url ? (
          <img src={event.cover_image_url} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
        ) : (
          <ImageIcon size={22} className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#E58422]/60" />
        )}

        <span className="absolute left-2 top-1.5 flex items-baseline gap-1 rounded-lg bg-white/95 px-2 py-0.5 shadow-sm">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-[#E58422]">
            {date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short" })}
          </span>
          <span className="font-display text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{date.getDate()}</span>
        </span>

        <EventPill pill={pill} className="absolute right-2 top-1.5 hidden sm:inline-flex" />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-3 lg:flex-1 lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-1">
          <h3
            title={event.title}
            className="line-clamp-2 min-w-0 flex-1 break-words text-sm font-bold leading-5 text-[#19244E] sm:line-clamp-1"
          >
            {event.title}
          </h3>

          <div ref={menuRef} className="relative -mr-2 -mt-2.5 shrink-0 sm:-mr-1 sm:-mt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
              aria-label={`More actions for ${event.title}`}
              aria-haspopup="menu"
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 sm:h-7 sm:w-7 ${menuOpen ? "bg-gray-100" : ""}`}
            >
              <MoreHorizontal size={18} />
            </button>

            {menuOpen && (
              <div
                role="menu"
                className="absolute right-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-40 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white py-1 shadow-lg"
              >
                <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => pick(onEdit)} className={`${menuItemClass} text-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]`}>
                  <Pencil size={15} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  Edit
                </button>
                <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => pick(onDuplicate)} className={`${menuItemClass} text-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]`}>
                  <Copy size={15} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  Duplicate
                </button>
                <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => pick(onDelete)} className={`${menuItemClass} text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50`}>
                  <Trash2 size={15} />
                  Delete
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <EventPill pill={pill} flat className="inline-flex self-start sm:hidden" />

        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 sm:truncate">
          <span className="block truncate sm:inline">
            {date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })}
            {event.start_time && ` · ${formatTime(event.start_time)}`}
          </span>
          <span className="hidden sm:inline"> · </span>
          <span className="block truncate sm:inline" title={event.venue}>{event.venue}</span>
        </p>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-2 text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-gray-500">
                <strong className="text-[#19244E]">{taken} / {capacity}</strong> registered
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                {typeCount} participant {typeCount === 1 ? "type" : "types"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100">
              <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-[#E58422]" style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onView(event)}
            aria-label={`View more about ${event.title}`}
            className="min-h-11 w-full shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f] sm:min-h-8 sm:w-auto"
          >
            View More
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ImagePlus } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "../ModalWrapper";
import {
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  textareaClass,
  labelClass,
  cancelButtonClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
} from "../formStyles";

const emptyEvent = {
  title: "",
  description: "",
  event_date: "",
  start_time: "",
  end_time: "",
  venue: "",
  cover_image_url: "",
  registration_opens_at: "",
  registration_closes_at: "",
};

// Used for both Create Event (event = null) and Edit.
export default function EventFormModal({ event, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({ ...emptyEvent, ...event }));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const update = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: "" }));
  };

  const pickCover = (file) => {
    if (file?.type.startsWith("image/")) update("cover_image_url", URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const submit = (submitEvent) => {
    submitEvent.preventDefault();
    const nextErrors = {
      title: form.title.trim() ? "" : "Event title is required.",
      event_date: form.event_date ? "" : "Pick the event date.",
      venue: form.venue.trim() ? "" : "Venue is required.",
      end_time:
        form.start_time && form.end_time && form.end_time <= form.start_time
          ? "End time must be after the start time."
          : "",
      registration_closes_at:
        form.registration_opens_at &&
        form.registration_closes_at &&
        form.registration_closes_at < form.registration_opens_at
          ? "Closing date must be on or after the opening date."
          : "",
    };

    if (Object.values(nextErrors).some(Boolean)) {
      setErrors(nextErrors);
      return;
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      venue: form.venue.trim(),
    });
  };

  const fieldError = (field) =>
    errors[field] && (
      <p id={`event-${field}-error`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
        {errors[field]}
      </p>
    );

  const errorProps = (field) => ({
    "aria-invalid": Boolean(errors[field]),
    "aria-describedby": errors[field] ? `event-${field}-error` : undefined,
    className: fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors[field]) }),
  });

  const footer = (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
        Cancel
      </button>
      <button type="submit" form="event-form" className={primaryButtonClass}>
        {event ? "Save Changes" : "Create Event"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={event ? "Edit Event" : "Create Event"}
      description={
        event
          ? "Customers see these details on the events page."
          : "New events start as Draft. Set who can register in the Registration Forms tab."
      }
      footer={footer}
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-2xl"
      sheetOnPhone
      dismissible
    >
      <form id="event-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="event-title" className={labelClass}>
            Event Title <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="event-title"
            type="text"
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(e) => update("title", e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
            {...errorProps("title")}
          />
          {fieldError("title")}
        </div>

        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="event-description" className={labelClass}>Description</label>
          <textarea
            id="event-description"
            rows={3}
            value={form.description}
            onChange={(e) => update("description", e.target.value)}
            className={textareaClass}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="event-date" className={labelClass}>
            Date <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="event-date"
            type="date"
            value={form.event_date}
            onChange={(e) => update("event_date", e.target.value)}
            {...errorProps("event_date")}
          />
          {fieldError("event_date")}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="event-start" className={labelClass}>Starts</label>
            <input
              id="event-start"
              type="time"
              value={form.start_time}
              onChange={(e) => update("start_time", e.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="event-end" className={labelClass}>Ends</label>
            <input
              id="event-end"
              type="time"
              value={form.end_time}
              onChange={(e) => update("end_time", e.target.value)}
              {...errorProps("end_time")}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="col-span-2 -mt-2">{fieldError("end_time")}</div>
        </div>

        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="event-venue" className={labelClass}>
            Venue <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="event-venue"
            type="text"
            value={form.venue}
            onChange={(e) => update("venue", e.target.value)}
            {...errorProps("venue")}
          />
          {fieldError("venue")}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="event-opens" className={labelClass}>Registration opens</label>
          <input
            id="event-opens"
            type="date"
            value={form.registration_opens_at}
            onChange={(e) => update("registration_opens_at", e.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="event-closes" className={labelClass}>Registration closes</label>
          <input
            id="event-closes"
            type="date"
            value={form.registration_closes_at}
            min={form.registration_opens_at || undefined}
            onChange={(e) => update("registration_closes_at", e.target.value)}
            {...errorProps("registration_closes_at")}
          />
          {fieldError("registration_closes_at")}
        </div>

        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <p className={labelClass}>Cover image</p>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <label className="relative flex aspect-[16/7] w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7]/50 text-center sm:w-64">
              {form.cover_image_url ? (
                <img src={form.cover_image_url} alt="Cover preview" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ImagePlus size={22} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Click to upload</span>
                </>
              )}
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={(e) => pickCover(e.target.files[0])}
                aria-label="Upload cover image"
                className="sr-only"
              />
            </label>
            {form.cover_image_url && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => update("cover_image_url", "")}
                className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
              >
                Remove image
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/EventsTab.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { CalendarDays, Search } from "lucide-react";
import Pagination from "../Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../usePageSize";
import EmptyState from "../EmptyState";
import EventCard from "./EventCard";
import { eventPhase, eventPill, eventTotals } from "./eventUtils";

const PHASES = [
  { id: "all", label: "All" },
  { id: "upcoming", label: "Upcoming" },
  { id: "active", label: "Active" },
  { id: "past", label: "Past" },
];

// 3 × 2 cards on desktop, 2 × 2 on phones, so every page of the grid is even.
const GRID_PAGE_SIZES = { desktop: 6, phone: 4 };

const controlClass =
  "h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-sm text-gray-700 outline-none transition focus:border-orange-300 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50 lg:h-10";

// On laptops this tab fills the space it is given (no page scroll); the card grid takes what is left.
export default function EventsTab({
  events,
  participantTypes,
  registrations,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onDuplicate,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("date");

  const counts = Object.fromEntries(
    PHASES.map(({ id }) => [
      id,
      id === "all" ? events.length : events.filter((event) => eventPhase(event) === id).length,
    ])
  );

  const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const listed = events
    .filter(
      (event) =>
        (phase === "all" || eventPhase(event) === phase) &&
        (!term ||
          event.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          event.venue.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    )
    .sort((a, b) =>
      sort === "newest" ? b.id - a.id : a.event_date.localeCompare(b.event_date)
    );

  const pager = usePagination(listed, [phase, term, sort], GRID_PAGE_SIZES);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:min-h-0 lg:flex-1">
      <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label="Show events"
          className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-1 lg:inline-grid"
        >
          {PHASES.map((option) => (
            <button
              key={option.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPhase(option.id)}
              aria-pressed={phase === option.id}
              className={`flex min-h-11 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-x-1.5 rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-bold transition sm:flex-row lg:min-h-8 lg:px-3 ${
                phase === option.id
                  ? "bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                  : "text-gray-500 hover:text-[#19244E]"
              }`}
            >
              {option.label}
              <span
                className={`rounded-md px-1.5 text-[10px] ${
                  phase === option.id ? "bg-white/80" : "bg-gray-100"
                }`}
              >
                {counts[option.id]}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 lg:w-60 lg:flex-none">
            <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search events..."
              aria-label="Search events"
              className={`${controlClass} w-full pl-9 pr-3`}
            />
          </div>
          <select
            value={sort}
            onChange={(event) => setSort(event.target.value)}
            aria-label="Sort events"
            className={`${controlClass} w-36 shrink-0 px-3 sm:w-48`}
          >
            <option value="date">Sort: Event date</option>
            <option value="newest">Sort: Newest</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {listed.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={CalendarDays}
          className="justify-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white lg:flex-1"
          title={events.length === 0 ? "No events yet. Time to plan a throwdown?" : "No events match that."}
          message={
            events.length === 0
              ? "Use Create Event to set up your first one."
              : "Try another filter or search."
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:min-h-0 lg:flex-1 lg:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-rows-2 lg:gap-4">
          {pager.pageItems.map((event) => {
            const { types, taken, capacity } = eventTotals(event, participantTypes, registrations);

            return (
              <EventCard
                key={event.id}
                event={event}
                pill={eventPill(event, participantTypes, registrations)}
                taken={taken}
                capacity={capacity}
                typeCount={types.length}
                onView={onView}
                onEdit={onEdit}
                onDuplicate={onDuplicate}
                onDelete={onDelete}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <Pagination {...pager} label="Event pages" className="shrink-0" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/eventUtils.js

```
// Labels and small helpers shared by the three Events tabs.

export const REGISTRATION_STATUS = {
  pending: { label: "Pending verification", className: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700" },
  confirmed: { label: "Confirmed", className: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" },
  waitlisted: { label: "Waitlisted", className: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700" },
  cancelled: { label: "Cancelled", className: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600" },
};

// Statuses an admin can pick by hand ("pending" only changes when the person verifies their email).
export const ADMIN_STATUSES = ["confirmed", "waitlisted", "cancelled"];

export const PRESET_TYPES = ["Competitor", "Spectator/Guest", "Sponsor", "Volunteer"];

export const QUESTION_TYPES = {
  short_answer: "Short answer",
  paragraph: "Paragraph",
  multiple_choice: "Multiple choice",
  checkboxes: "Checkboxes",
  dropdown: "Dropdown",
  date: "Date",
  email: "Email",
  phone: "Phone",
};

// Question types that need a list of options.
export const CHOICE_TYPES = ["multiple_choice", "checkboxes", "dropdown"];

export const chipClass = (active) =>
  `inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
    active
      ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
      : "border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
  }`;

export const nextId = (rows) => Math.max(0, ...rows.map((row) => row.id)) + 1;

const pad = (number) => String(number).padStart(2, "0");

export const todayISO = () => {
  const today = new Date();
  return `${today.getFullYear()}-${pad(today.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(today.getDate())}`;
};

// Local time as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00", the same shape as the sample timestamps.
export const nowISO = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  return `${todayISO()}T${pad(now.getHours())}:${pad(now.getMinutes())}:00`;
};

// "YYYY-MM-DD" is read as a local date (not UTC) so it never shifts by a day.
export const parseDate = (value) => {
  const [year, month, day] = value.slice(0, 10).split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
};

export const formatDate = (
  value,
  options = { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }
) => (value ? parseDate(value).toLocaleDateString("en-US", options) : "Not set");

// "16:00" → "4:00 PM"
export const formatTime = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "";
  const [hours, minutes] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${hours % 12 || 12}:${pad(minutes)} ${hours < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
};

// "2026-10-22T09:55:00" → "Oct 22, 2026 · 9:55 AM"
export const formatDateTime = (value) =>
  value ? `${formatDate(value)} · ${formatTime(value.slice(11, 16))}` : "Never";

export const timeRange = (event) =>
  [event.start_time, event.end_time].filter(Boolean).map(formatTime).join(" – ") ||
  "Time not set";

// "past" | "active" (happening today) | "upcoming"
export const eventPhase = (event) => {
  const today = todayISO();
  if (event.event_date < today) return "past";
  if (event.event_date === today) return "active";
  return "upcoming";
};

export const answerText = (value) =>
  Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : value ?? "";

export const confirmedCount = (registrations, typeId) =>
  registrations.filter(
    (registration) =>
      registration.participant_type_id === typeId && registration.status === "confirmed"
  ).length;

// Confirmed spots and total capacity across all participant types of one event.
export const eventTotals = (event, participantTypes, registrations) => {
  const types = participantTypes.filter((type) => type.event_id === event.id);
  return {
    types,
    taken: types.reduce((sum, type) => sum + confirmedCount(registrations, type.id), 0),
    capacity: types.reduce((sum, type) => sum + type.capacity, 0),
  };
};

// The pill shown on event cards and in the View More pop-up.
export const eventPill = (event, participantTypes, registrations) => {
  const phase = eventPhase(event);
  const { taken, capacity } = eventTotals(event, participantTypes, registrations);

  if (event.status === "draft") return { label: "Draft", dot: "bg-gray-400", text: "text-gray-600" };
  if (event.status === "cancelled") return { label: "Cancelled", dot: "bg-rose-500", text: "text-rose-700" };
  if (phase === "past" || event.status === "completed") return { label: "Past", dot: "bg-gray-400", text: "text-gray-600" };
  if (phase === "active") return { label: "Happening now", dot: "bg-violet-500 animate-pulse", text: "text-violet-700" };
  if (event.status === "closed") return { label: "Registration closed", dot: "bg-amber-500", text: "text-amber-700" };
  if (event.registration_opens_at && event.registration_opens_at > todayISO()) {
    return {
      label: `Opens ${formatDate(event.registration_opens_at, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}`,
      dot: "bg-sky-500",
      text: "text-sky-700",
    };
  }
  if (capacity > 0 && taken >= capacity) return { label: "Full", dot: "bg-rose-500", text: "text-rose-700" };
  return { label: "Registration open", dot: "bg-emerald-500", text: "text-emerald-700" };
};

export const sortQuestions = (questions) =>
  [...questions].sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order);
```

```
import { useEffect } from "react";
import {
  CalendarDays,
  ClipboardList,
  Clock,
  Lock,
  MapPin,
  Pencil,
  Unlock,
  Users,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { EventPill } from "./Badges";
import { confirmedCount, eventPhase, formatDate, timeRange } from "./eventUtils";

const footerButtonClass =
  "inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-bold transition disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 sm:px-4 sm:text-sm";

function InfoBox({ icon: Icon, label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 rounded-xl bg-[#F8F6F3] p-3">
      <dt className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
        <Icon size={13} />
        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

// "View More" pop-up. Full-screen sheet on phones; Esc or a click outside closes it.
export default function EventViewModal({
  event,
  pill,
  types,
  registrations,
  onClose,
  onEdit,
  onToggleRegistration,
  onOpenForm,
  onOpenParticipants,
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (keyEvent) => {
      if (keyEvent.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const finished =
    eventPhase(event) === "past" || event.status === "completed" || event.status === "cancelled";
  const registrationOpen = event.status === "open";

  return (
    <div
      onMouseDown={(mouseEvent) => {
        if (mouseEvent.target === mouseEvent.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-950/50 sm:p-6"
    >
      <section
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="event-view-title"
        className="flex h-full w-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-2xl sm:h-auto sm:max-h-full sm:max-w-3xl sm:rounded-2xl"
      >
        <div className="relative h-40 shrink-0 bg-[#FFF3E7] sm:h-48">
          {event.cover_image_url && (
            <img src={event.cover_image_url} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
          )}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/75 via-black/25 to-transparent" />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="absolute right-3 top-3 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/90 text-gray-700 shadow transition hover:bg-white"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 p-4 sm:p-6">
            <EventPill pill={pill} />
            <h2 id="event-view-title" className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold leading-tight text-white sm:text-2xl">
              {event.title}
            </h2>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid min-h-0 flex-1 gap-6 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,3fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <InfoBox icon={CalendarDays} label="Date">
                {formatDate(event.event_date, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })}
              </InfoBox>
              <InfoBox icon={Clock} label="Time">{timeRange(event)}</InfoBox>
              <InfoBox icon={MapPin} label="Place">{event.venue}</InfoBox>
              <InfoBox icon={Lock} label="Registration closes">
                {formatDate(event.registration_closes_at)}
              </InfoBox>
            </dl>

            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">About</h3>
              <p className="mt-1.5 whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-6 text-gray-600">
                {event.description || "No description yet."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">Participant types</h3>
            {types.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                None yet. Add them under Registration form.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="mt-3 space-y-4">
                {types.map((type) => {
                  const taken = confirmedCount(registrations, type.id);
                  const full = type.capacity > 0 && taken >= type.capacity;
                  const percent = type.capacity ? Math.min(100, (taken / type.capacity) * 100) : 0;
                  const waiting = registrations.filter(
                    (entry) =>
                      entry.participant_type_id === type.id &&
                      (entry.status === "waitlisted" || entry.status === "pending")
                  ).length;

                  return (
                    <li key={type.id}>
                      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                        <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">{type.name}</span>
                        <span className={full ? "font-bold text-rose-600" : "text-gray-500"}>
                          {full && "Full · "}
                          <strong className={full ? "" : "text-[#19244E]"}>
                            {taken} / {type.capacity}
                          </strong>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1.5 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100">
                        <div
                          className={`h-full rounded-full ${full ? "bg-rose-500" : "bg-[#E58422]"}`}
                          style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      {waiting > 0 && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                          {waiting} waitlisted or waiting for email verification
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid shrink-0 grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-t border-[#EFEAE4] px-4 py-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:px-6">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onEdit(event)}
            className={`${footerButtonClass} border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]`}
          >
            <Pencil size={15} />
            Edit event
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onToggleRegistration(event)}
            disabled={finished}
            className={`${footerButtonClass} border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-[#19244E] hover:bg-gray-50`}
          >
            {registrationOpen || finished ? <Lock size={15} /> : <Unlock size={15} />}
            {registrationOpen || finished ? "Close registration" : "Open registration"}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenForm(event)}
            className={`${footerButtonClass} border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-[#19244E] hover:bg-gray-50`}
          >
            <ClipboardList size={15} />
            Registration form
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenParticipants(event)}
            className={`${footerButtonClass} border-[#E58422] bg-[#E58422] text-white hover:bg-[#d47414]`}
          >
            <Users size={15} />
            View participants
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/FormBuilder.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { Lock, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import QuestionCard from "./QuestionCard";
import { nextId, sortQuestions } from "./eventUtils";

// Shown at the top of every form; they cannot be edited or removed.
const LOCKED_FIELDS = ["Full name", "Email"];

// Questions for one participant type. Drag the handle (or use the arrows) to reorder.
export default function FormBuilder({ typeId, questions, setQuestions, notify }) {
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState(null);
  const [armedId, setArmedId] = useState(null);
  const [dragId, setDragId] = useState(null);
  const [overId, setOverId] = useState(null);

  const typeQuestions = sortQuestions(
    questions.filter((question) => question.participant_type_id === typeId)
  );

  // Saves the new order as sort_order 1, 2, 3… Extra rows (a duplicate) are added at the same time.
  const saveOrder = (ordered, extraRows = []) => {
    const position = new Map(ordered.map((question, index) => [question.id, index + 1]));
    setQuestions((all) =>
      [...all, ...extraRows].map((question) =>
        position.has(question.id) ? { ...question, sort_order: position.get(question.id) } : question
      )
    );
  };

  const updateQuestion = (id, changes) =>
    setQuestions((all) =>
      all.map((question) => (question.id === id ? { ...question, ...changes } : question))
    );

  const addQuestion = () => {
    const id = nextId(questions);
    setQuestions((all) => [
      ...all,
      {
        id,
        participant_type_id: typeId,
        label: "",
        type: "short_answer",
        required: false,
        help_text: "",
        options: [],
        sort_order: typeQuestions.length + 1,
      },
    ]);
    setActiveId(id);
  };

  const duplicateQuestion = (question) => {
    const copy = { ...question, id: nextId(questions), label: `${question.label} (copy)`, options: [...question.options] };
    const ordered = [...typeQuestions];
    ordered.splice(ordered.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === question.id) + 1, 0, copy);
    saveOrder(ordered, [copy]);
    setActiveId(copy.id);
  };

  const deleteQuestion = (question) => {
    setQuestions((all) => all.filter((entry) => entry.id !== question.id));
    notify(`“${question.label || "Untitled question"}” was deleted.`);
  };

  const moveTo = (fromId, toIndex) => {
    const ordered = [...typeQuestions];
    const fromIndex = ordered.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === fromId);
    if (fromIndex === -1 || toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= ordered.length) return;
    const [moved] = ordered.splice(fromIndex, 1);
    ordered.splice(toIndex, 0, moved);
    saveOrder(ordered);
  };

  const clearDrag = () => {
    setArmedId(null);
    setDragId(null);
    setOverId(null);
  };

  // Native drag and drop; the card only becomes draggable while its handle is pressed,
  // so selecting text inside the inputs still works.
  const dragPropsFor = (question, index) => ({
    draggable: armedId === question.id,
    onDragStart: (event) => {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", String(question.id));
      setDragId(question.id);
    },
    onDragOver: (event) => {
      if (dragId === null) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (overId !== question.id) setOverId(question.id);
    },
    onDrop: (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (dragId !== null && dragId !== question.id) moveTo(dragId, index);
      clearDrag();
    },
    onDragEnd: clearDrag,
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {LOCKED_FIELDS.map((label) => (
          <li
            key={label}
            className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#EAE5DF] bg-[#F8F6F3] px-4 py-3"
          >
            <Lock size={16} className="shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                {label} <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Always included · cannot be removed</p>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      {typeQuestions.length > 0 && (
        <ol className="space-y-3" onPointerUp={() => setArmedId(null)}>
          {typeQuestions.map((question, index) => (
            <QuestionCard
              key={question.id}
              question={question}
              index={index}
              total={typeQuestions.length}
              active={activeId === question.id}
              dragOver={overId === question.id && dragId !== question.id}
              dragProps={dragPropsFor(question, index)}
              onArmDrag={() => setArmedId(question.id)}
              onActivate={() => setActiveId(question.id)}
              onChange={(changes) => updateQuestion(question.id, changes)}
              onDuplicate={() => duplicateQuestion(question)}
              onDelete={() => deleteQuestion(question)}
              onMove={(direction) => moveTo(question.id, index + direction)}
            />
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={addQuestion}
        className="flex min-h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 text-sm font-bold text-[#E58422] transition hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]"
      >
        <Plus size={18} />
        Add question
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/FormPreview.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BadgeCheck, CalendarDays, Clock, MapPin, X } from "lucide-react";
import AnswerField from "./AnswerField";
import { inputClass } from "../formStyles";
import { formatDate, sortQuestions, timeRange } from "./eventUtils";

const NAME_QUESTION = { id: "name", label: "Full name", type: "short_answer", required: true };
const EMAIL_QUESTION = { id: "email", label: "Email", type: "email", required: true };
const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const RESEND_SECONDS = 60;

// Shown right after the Email field: send a code, type the 6 digits, verify.
function EmailVerification({ email, verified, onVerified }) {
  const [codeSent, setCodeSent] = useState(false);
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState(0);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (secondsLeft <= 0) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setSecondsLeft((seconds) => seconds - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [secondsLeft]);

  const emailValid = EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email.trim());

  const sendCode = () => {
    setCodeSent(true);
    setCode("");
    setError("");
    setSecondsLeft(RESEND_SECONDS);
    setMessage(`We sent a 6-digit code to ${email.trim()}.`);
  };

  const verify = () => {
    // BACKEND: real code is emailed and checked on the server.
    // In this preview any 6 digits count as correct.
    if (/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) {
      onVerified();
      setError("");
    } else {
      setError("Enter the 6-digit code from the email.");
    }
  };

  if (verified) {
    return (
      <p role="status" className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">
        <BadgeCheck size={18} />
        Email verified
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[#EAE5DF] bg-[#F8F6F3] p-3 sm:p-4">
      <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">
        We need to confirm your email before your spot is saved.
      </p>

      {!codeSent ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={sendCode}
          disabled={!emailValid}
          className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          Send code
        </button>
      ) : (
        <>
          {message && <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#19244E]">{message}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              inputMode="numeric"
              autoComplete="one-time-code"
              maxLength={6}
              value={code}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setCode(event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6));
                setError("");
              }}
              placeholder="6-digit code"
              aria-label="6-digit verification code"
              className={`${inputClass} max-w-[11rem] bg-white text-center font-mono tracking-[0.3em]`}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={verify}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
            >
              Verify
            </button>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={sendCode}
            disabled={secondsLeft > 0}
            className="min-h-11 text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-gray-400 disabled:no-underline"
          >
            {secondsLeft > 0 ? `Resend code in ${secondsLeft}s` : "Resend code"}
          </button>
        </>
      )}

      {!emailValid && !codeSent && (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Enter a valid email above first.</p>
      )}
      {error && <p role="alert" className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

// The registration form as customers will see it (full screen on phones).
// Nothing is sent: submitting only shows a note.
export default function FormPreview({ event, type, questions, onClose }) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState({});
  const [verified, setVerified] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (keyEvent) => {
      if (keyEvent.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const typeQuestions = sortQuestions(
    questions.filter((question) => question.participant_type_id === type.id)
  );

  const setValue = (id, value) => {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: value }));
    setResult("");
    // A new email address has to be verified again.
    if (id === "email") setVerified(false);
  };

  const field = (question) => (
    <AnswerField
      id={`preview-${question.id}`}
      question={question}
      value={values[question.id] ?? (question.type === "checkboxes" ? [] : "")}
      onChange={(value) => setValue(question.id, value)}
    />
  );

  const cardClass = "rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-4 sm:p-6";

  return (
    <div
      onMouseDown={(mouseEvent) => {
        if (mouseEvent.target === mouseEvent.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-stretch justify-center bg-gray-950/50 sm:items-center sm:p-6"
    >
      <section
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label="Form preview"
        className="flex h-full w-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#F8F6F3] shadow-2xl sm:h-auto sm:max-h-full sm:max-w-2xl sm:rounded-2xl"
      >
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white px-4 py-2 sm:px-6">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">
            Preview · what customers see
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close preview"
            className="-mr-2 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-700"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 sm:p-6">
          <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white">
            {event.cover_image_url && (
              <img src={event.cover_image_url} alt="" className="aspect-[16/6] w-full object-cover" />
            )}
            <div className="border-t-4 border-[#E58422] p-4 sm:p-6">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:text-2xl">{event.title}</h2>
              <p className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><CalendarDays size={13} />{formatDate(event.event_date)}</span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Clock size={13} />{timeRange(event)}</span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><MapPin size={13} />{event.venue}</span>
              </p>
              <p className="mt-3 inline-block rounded-lg bg-[#FFF3E7] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916]">
                Registering as: {type.name}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-rose-500">* Required</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <form
            onSubmit={(submitEvent) => {
              submitEvent.preventDefault();
              setResult(
                verified
                  ? "Preview only: nothing was sent. On the live site this registers the person."
                  : "Verify your email before submitting."
              );
            }}
            className="mt-3 space-y-3"
          >
            <div className={cardClass}>{field(NAME_QUESTION)}</div>

            <div className={`${cardClass} space-y-3`}>
              {field(EMAIL_QUESTION)}
              <EmailVerification
                key={values.email ?? ""}
                email={values.email ?? ""}
                verified={verified}
                onVerified={() => setVerified(true)}
              />
            </div>

            {typeQuestions.map((question) => (
              <div key={question.id} className={cardClass}>
                {field(question)}
              </div>
            ))}

            {result && (
              <p
                role="status"
                className={`rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold ${
                  verified
                    ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
                    : "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700"
                }`}
              >
                {result}
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#d47414] sm:w-auto"
            >
              Submit Registration
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/FormsTab.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { Eye, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import DataCard from "../DataCard";
import ModalWrapper from "../ModalWrapper";
import { cancelButtonClass, inputClass, labelClass } from "../formStyles";
import FormBuilder from "./FormBuilder";
import FormPreview from "./FormPreview";
import { PRESET_TYPES, chipClass, formatDate, nextId } from "./eventUtils";

const smallInputClass =
  "h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100";

// Step 1: who can register (capacity and dates per type). Step 2: a form per type.
// Changes save as you type in this preview.
export default function FormsTab({
  events,
  participantTypes,
  questions,
  registrations,
  selectedEvent,
  onSelectEvent,
  setParticipantTypes,
  setQuestions,
  notify,
}) {
  const [activeTypeId, setActiveTypeId] = useState(null);
  const [customName, setCustomName] = useState("");
  const [customError, setCustomError] = useState("");
  const [removeTarget, setRemoveTarget] = useState(null);
  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(false);

  if (!selectedEvent) {
    return (
      <DataCard>
        <p className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">Create an event first.</p>
      </DataCard>
    );
  }

  const eventTypes = participantTypes.filter((type) => type.event_id === selectedEvent.id);
  const activeType = eventTypes.find((type) => type.id === activeTypeId) ?? eventTypes[0];
  const customTypes = eventTypes.filter((type) => !PRESET_TYPES.includes(type.name));
  const rows = [
    ...PRESET_TYPES.map((name) => ({ name, type: eventTypes.find((type) => type.name === name) })),
    ...customTypes.map((type) => ({ name: type.name, type })),
  ];

  const registeredCount = (typeId) =>
    registrations.filter((entry) => entry.participant_type_id === typeId).length;
  const questionCount = (typeId) =>
    questions.filter((question) => question.participant_type_id === typeId).length;

  const addType = (name) => {
    const id = nextId(participantTypes);
    setParticipantTypes((all) => [
      ...all,
      {
        id,
        event_id: selectedEvent.id,
        name,
        capacity: 20,
        opens_at: selectedEvent.registration_opens_at,
        closes_at: selectedEvent.registration_closes_at,
      },
    ]);
    setActiveTypeId(id);
  };

  const removeType = (type) => {
    setParticipantTypes((all) => all.filter((entry) => entry.id !== type.id));
    setQuestions((all) => all.filter((question) => question.participant_type_id !== type.id));
    setRemoveTarget(null);
    notify(`${type.name} can no longer register for this event.`);
  };

  // People who already registered keep their type, so it cannot be removed.
  const requestRemove = (type) => {
    const registered = registeredCount(type.id);
    if (registered > 0) {
      notify(`${type.name} has ${registered} registration${registered === 1 ? "" : "s"}, so it stays. Set its closing date to stop new sign-ups.`);
    } else if (questionCount(type.id) > 0) {
      setRemoveTarget(type);
    } else {
      removeType(type);
    }
  };

  const updateType = (id, field, value) =>
    setParticipantTypes((all) =>
      all.map((type) => (type.id === id ? { ...type, [field]: value } : type))
    );

  const addCustomType = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = customName.trim();
    if (!name) {
      setCustomError("Enter a name for the new type.");
      return;
    }
    if (eventTypes.some((type) => type.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())) {
      setCustomError(`${name} is already on the list.`);
      return;
    }
    addType(name);
    setCustomName("");
    setCustomError("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <DataCard bodyClassName="p-4 sm:p-6">
        <label htmlFor="forms-event" className={labelClass}>Event</label>
        <select
          id="forms-event"
          value={selectedEvent.id}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setActiveTypeId(null);
            onSelectEvent(Number(event.target.value));
          }}
          className={`${inputClass} md:max-w-xl`}
        >
          {events.map((event) => (
            <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>
              {event.title} · {formatDate(event.event_date)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </DataCard>

      <DataCard
        title="Step 1 · Who can register?"
        description="Tick each participant type. Each one gets its own capacity, dates and form."
        bodyClassName="space-y-3 p-4 sm:p-6"
      >
        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {rows.map(({ name, type }) => {
            const checked = Boolean(type);
            const datesInvalid = type && type.opens_at && type.closes_at && type.closes_at < type.opens_at;

            return (
              <li
                key={name}
                className={`rounded-2xl border p-3 transition sm:p-4 ${
                  checked ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7]/50" : "border-[#EAE5DF]"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <label className="flex min-h-11 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center gap-3">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={checked}
                      onChange={() => (checked ? requestRemove(type) : addType(name))}
                      className="h-5 w-5 accent-[#E58422]"
                    />
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{name}</span>
                  </label>
                  {checked && (
                    <span className="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">
                      {registeredCount(type.id)} registered
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {checked && !PRESET_TYPES.includes(name) && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => requestRemove(type)}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${name}`}
                      className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-400 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600"
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={16} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {checked && (
                  <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:pl-8">
                    <label className="col-span-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 sm:col-span-1">
                      Capacity
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        inputMode="numeric"
                        min="0"
                        value={type.capacity}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          updateType(type.id, "capacity", Math.max(0, Number(event.target.value) || 0))
                        }
                        className={`mt-1 ${smallInputClass}`}
                      />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">
                      Opens
                      <input
                        type="date"
                        value={type.opens_at}
                        onChange={(event) => updateType(type.id, "opens_at", event.target.value)}
                        className={`mt-1 ${smallInputClass}`}
                      />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">
                      Closes
                      <input
                        type="date"
                        value={type.closes_at}
                        min={type.opens_at || undefined}
                        onChange={(event) => updateType(type.id, "closes_at", event.target.value)}
                        className={`mt-1 ${smallInputClass} ${datesInvalid ? "border-rose-400" : ""}`}
                      />
                    </label>
                    {datesInvalid && (
                      <p className="col-span-2 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 sm:col-span-3">
                        The closing date is before the opening date.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>

        <form onSubmit={addCustomType} className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-[#EFEAE4] pt-4 sm:flex-row">
          <input
            value={customName}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setCustomName(event.target.value);
              setCustomError("");
            }}
            placeholder="Custom type, e.g. Judge or Media"
            aria-label="Custom participant type name"
            className={`${inputClass} sm:max-w-sm`}
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] hover:border-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]"
          >
            <Plus size={16} className="text-[#E58422]" />
            Add custom type
          </button>
        </form>
        {customError && <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">{customError}</p>}
      </DataCard>

      <DataCard
        title="Step 2 · Build the form"
        description="Every type has its own form. Changes save as you go."
        badge={
          activeType && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f]"
            >
              <Eye size={16} />
              Preview
            </button>
          )
        }
        clip={false}
        bodyClassName="space-y-4 p-4 sm:p-6"
      >
        {eventTypes.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
            Choose at least one participant type in Step 1.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1" role="tablist" aria-label="Form for">
              {eventTypes.map((type) => (
                <button
                  key={type.id}
                  type="button"
                  role="tab"
                  aria-selected={activeType.id === type.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTypeId(type.id)}
                  className={chipClass(activeType.id === type.id)}
                >
                  {type.name}
                  <span className="rounded-md bg-white/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                    {questionCount(type.id) + 2}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <FormBuilder
              key={activeType.id}
              typeId={activeType.id}
              questions={questions}
              setQuestions={setQuestions}
              notify={notify}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {removeTarget && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title={`Remove ${removeTarget.name}?`}
          description={`Its form and ${questionCount(removeTarget.id)} question(s) will be deleted.`}
          onClose={() => setRemoveTarget(null)}
          sheetOnPhone
          dismissible
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setRemoveTarget(null)} className={cancelButtonClass}>
              Keep
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => removeType(removeTarget)}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-rose-700"
            >
              Remove
            </button>
          </div>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}

      {previewOpen && activeType && (
        <FormPreview
          event={selectedEvent}
          type={activeType}
          questions={questions}
          onClose={() => setPreviewOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
