## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/ParticipantModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { MailCheck, Send } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "../ModalWrapper";
import { cancelButtonClass } from "../formStyles";
import { RegistrationStatusBadge, VerifiedBadge } from "./Badges";
import {
  ADMIN_STATUSES,
  REGISTRATION_STATUS,
  answerText,
  formatDate,
  formatDateTime,
} from "./eventUtils";

function Detail({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 rounded-xl bg-[#F8F6F3] p-3">
      <dt className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

// Everything one person filled in on the registration form, plus status and email verification.
export default function ParticipantModal({
  registration,
  eventTitle,
  typeName,
  questions,
  answers,
  onClose,
  onStatusChange,
  onResendCode,
}) {
  const [codeMessage, setCodeMessage] = useState("");
  const pending = registration.status === "pending";

  const resend = () => {
    onResendCode(registration.id);
    setCodeMessage(`Code sent again to ${registration.email}`);
  };

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={registration.name}
      description={`${eventTitle} · ${typeName}`}
      onClose={onClose}
      maxWidth="max-w-2xl"
      sheetOnPhone
      dismissible
      footer={
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className={`${cancelButtonClass} w-full sm:w-auto`}>
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <dl className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Detail label="Email">
            <span className="block break-all">{registration.email}</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block">
              <VerifiedBadge verified={registration.email_verified} />
            </span>
          </Detail>
          <Detail label="Registered on">{formatDateTime(registration.registered_at)}</Detail>
          <Detail label="Code last sent">{formatDateTime(registration.verification_sent_at)}</Detail>
        </dl>

        {pending && (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 p-4">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-sky-900">Waiting for email verification</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-sky-800">
              {registration.name.split(" ")[0]} has not entered the 6-digit code yet. Their spot is
              confirmed (or waitlisted) once they do.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={resend}
              className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f]"
            >
              <Send size={15} />
              Resend code
            </button>
            {codeMessage && (
              <p role="status" className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                <MailCheck size={14} />
                {codeMessage}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">Status</h3>
            <RegistrationStatusBadge status={registration.status} />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" role="group" aria-label="Change status">
            {ADMIN_STATUSES.map((status) => (
              <button
                key={status}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onStatusChange(registration.id, status)}
                aria-pressed={registration.status === status}
                className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl border px-2 text-xs font-bold transition sm:text-sm ${
                  registration.status === status
                    ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                    : "border-[#EAE5DF] text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50"
                }`}
              >
                {REGISTRATION_STATUS[status].label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">Registration answers</h3>
          <dl className="mt-2 divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4] rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF]">
            {[
              { id: "name", label: "Full name", value: registration.name },
              { id: "email", label: "Email", value: registration.email },
              ...questions.map((question) => ({
                id: question.id,
                label: question.label || "Untitled question",
                value:
                  question.type === "date" && answers[question.id]
                    ? formatDate(answers[question.id])
                    : answerText(answers[question.id]),
              })),
            ].map((row) => (
              <div key={row.id} className="grid gap-1 px-4 py-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,3fr)] sm:gap-4">
                <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">{row.label}</dt>
                <dd className={`break-words text-sm ${row.value ? "font-semibold text-[#19244E]" : "italic text-gray-400"}`}>
                  {row.value || "No answer"}
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/ParticipantsTab.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { Download, Search, Users } from "lucide-react";
import EmptyState from "../EmptyState";
import DataCard from "../DataCard";
import Pagination from "../Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../usePageSize";
import { inputClass, labelClass } from "../formStyles";
import ParticipantModal from "./ParticipantModal";
import { RegistrationStatusBadge, VerifiedBadge } from "./Badges";
import {
  REGISTRATION_STATUS,
  answerText,
  formatDate,
  sortQuestions,
} from "./eventUtils";

const csvCell = (value) => `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

const slugify = (text) => text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "");

export default function ParticipantsTab({
  events,
  participantTypes,
  registrations,
  questions,
  answers,
  eventFilter,
  onEventFilterChange,
  onStatusChange,
  onResendCode,
}) {
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState("all");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState(null);

  const selectedEvent = events.find((event) => event.id === eventFilter);
  const eventTitle = (eventId) => events.find((event) => event.id === eventId)?.title ?? "Deleted event";
  const typeName = (typeId) =>
    participantTypes.find((type) => type.id === typeId)?.name ?? "Unknown type";
  const answerValue = (registrationId, questionId) =>
    answers.find(
      (answer) => answer.registration_id === registrationId && answer.question_id === questionId
    )?.value;

  // Type names repeat across events, so the type filter works by name.
  const typeNames = [
    ...new Set(
      participantTypes
        .filter((type) => eventFilter === "all" || type.event_id === eventFilter)
        .map((type) => type.name)
    ),
  ];

  const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filtered = registrations
    .filter(
      (entry) =>
        (eventFilter === "all" || entry.event_id === eventFilter) &&
        (typeFilter === "all" || typeName(entry.participant_type_id) === typeFilter) &&
        (statusFilter === "all" || entry.status === statusFilter) &&
        (!term ||
          entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          entry.email.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    )
    .sort((a, b) => b.registered_at.localeCompare(a.registered_at));

  const pager = usePagination(filtered, [eventFilter, typeFilter, statusFilter, search]);
  const openRegistration = registrations.find((entry) => entry.id === openId);

  const changeEvent = (value) => {
    setTypeFilter("all");
    onEventFilterChange(value === "all" ? "all" : Number(value));
  };

  // Downloads every row that matches the filters. With one event picked, each form question gets a column.
  const exportCsv = () => {
    const eventQuestions = selectedEvent
      ? participantTypes
          .filter((type) => type.event_id === selectedEvent.id)
          .flatMap((type) =>
            sortQuestions(questions.filter((question) => question.participant_type_id === type.id))
          )
      : [];

    const header = [
      "Name",
      "Email",
      "Email verified",
      "Event",
      "Participant type",
      "Status",
      "Registered on",
      ...eventQuestions.map(
        (question) => `${typeName(question.participant_type_id)}: ${question.label}`
      ),
    ];
    const rows = filtered.map((entry) => [
      entry.name,
      entry.email,
      entry.email_verified ? "Yes" : "No",
      eventTitle(entry.event_id),
      typeName(entry.participant_type_id),
      REGISTRATION_STATUS[entry.status]?.label ?? entry.status,
      formatDate(entry.registered_at),
      ...eventQuestions.map((question) =>
        question.participant_type_id === entry.participant_type_id
          ? answerText(answerValue(entry.id, question.id))
          : ""
      ),
    ]);

    // The BOM lets Excel read peso signs and accented names correctly.
    const csv = "﻿" + [header, ...rows].map((row) => row.map(csvCell).join(",")).join("\r\n");
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }));
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${selectedEvent ? slugify(selectedEvent.title) : "all-events"}-participants.csv`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <DataCard bodyClassName="p-4 sm:p-6">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.5fr)]">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="participants-event" className={labelClass}>Event</label>
            <select
              id="participants-event"
              value={eventFilter}
              onChange={(event) => changeEvent(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              <option value="all">All events</option>
              {events.map((event) => (
                <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>
                  {event.title} · {formatDate(event.event_date)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="participants-type" className={labelClass}>Participant type</label>
            <select
              id="participants-type"
              value={typeFilter}
              onChange={(event) => setTypeFilter(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              <option value="all">All types</option>
              {typeNames.map((name) => (
                <option key={name} value={name}>{name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="participants-status" className={labelClass}>Status</label>
            <select
              id="participants-status"
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              <option value="all">All statuses</option>
              {Object.entries(REGISTRATION_STATUS).map(([value, { label }]) => (
                <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="participants-search" className={labelClass}>Search</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                id="participants-search"
                type="search"
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Name or email..."
                className={`${inputClass} pl-10`}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DataCard>

      <DataCard
        title="Participants"
        description={selectedEvent ? selectedEvent.title : "All events"}
        badge={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={exportCsv}
            disabled={filtered.length === 0}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <Download size={16} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Export CSV</span>
            <span className="sm:hidden">CSV</span>
          </button>
        }
        bodyClassName=""
        footer={filtered.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="Participant pages" />}
      >
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          registrations.some((entry) => eventFilter === "all" || entry.event_id === eventFilter) ? (
            <EmptyState icon={Users} title="No one matches these filters." message="Try another type, status or search." />
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Users}
              title="No sign-ups yet."
              message="Share the event and they'll come pouring in."
            />
          )
        ) : (
          <>
            <ul className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4] md:hidden">
              {pager.pageItems.map((entry) => (
                <li key={entry.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setOpenId(entry.id)}
                    className="flex min-h-11 w-full flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-3 text-left hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    <span className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{entry.name}</span>
                      <RegistrationStatusBadge status={entry.status} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex w-full items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="truncate text-xs text-gray-500">{entry.email}</span>
                      <VerifiedBadge verified={entry.email_verified} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="truncate text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {eventTitle(entry.event_id)} · {typeName(entry.participant_type_id)} · {formatDate(entry.registered_at)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>

            <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto md:block">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-[#EAE5DF] bg-[#F8F6F3] text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Name</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Email</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Event</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Participant type</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-3 text-right">Registered on</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4]">
                  {pager.pageItems.map((entry) => (
                    <tr
                      key={entry.id}
                      onClick={() => setOpenId(entry.id)}
                      className="cursor-pointer transition hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]/60"
                    >
                      <td className="px-6 py-3">
                        <button type="button" className="text-left text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] hover:underline">
                          {entry.name}
                        </button>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{entry.email}</p>
                        <div className="mt-1">
                          <VerifiedBadge verified={entry.email_verified} />
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="max-w-[220px] px-4 py-3">
                        <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600" title={eventTitle(entry.event_id)}>
                          {eventTitle(entry.event_id)}
                        </p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600">
                        {typeName(entry.participant_type_id)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <RegistrationStatusBadge status={entry.status} />
                      </td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-500">
                        {formatDate(entry.registered_at)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {openRegistration && (
        <ParticipantModal
          registration={openRegistration}
          eventTitle={eventTitle(openRegistration.event_id)}
          typeName={typeName(openRegistration.participant_type_id)}
          questions={sortQuestions(
            questions.filter(
              (question) => question.participant_type_id === openRegistration.participant_type_id
            )
          )}
          answers={Object.fromEntries(
            answers
              .filter((answer) => answer.registration_id === openRegistration.id)
              .map((answer) => [answer.question_id, answer.value])
          )}
          onClose={() => setOpenId(null)}
          onStatusChange={onStatusChange}
          onResendCode={onResendCode}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/QuestionCard.jsx

```
import {
  ArrowDown,
  ArrowUp,
  CheckSquare,
  ChevronDown,
  Circle,
  Copy,
  GripVertical,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { ToggleSwitch } from "../ModalWrapper";
import { inputClass } from "../formStyles";
import { CHOICE_TYPES, QUESTION_TYPES } from "./eventUtils";

const iconButtonClass =
  "flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-[#19244E] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30";

const optionIcons = {
  multiple_choice: Circle,
  checkboxes: CheckSquare,
  dropdown: ChevronDown,
};

// One question in the builder. Collapsed it shows a summary; tapped it opens for editing.
export default function QuestionCard({
  question,
  index,
  total,
  active,
  dragOver,
  dragProps,
  onArmDrag,
  onActivate,
  onChange,
  onDuplicate,
  onDelete,
  onMove,
}) {
  const isChoice = CHOICE_TYPES.includes(question.type);
  const OptionIcon = optionIcons[question.type];

  const changeType = (type) => {
    const needsOptions = CHOICE_TYPES.includes(type);
    onChange({
      type,
      options: needsOptions
        ? question.options.length
          ? question.options
          : ["Option 1"]
        : [],
    });
  };

  const updateOption = (optionIndex, value) =>
    onChange({
      options: question.options.map((option, i) => (i === optionIndex ? value : option)),
    });

  const handle = (
    <button
      type="button"
      onPointerDown={onArmDrag}
      aria-label={`Drag to reorder question ${index + 1}`}
      title="Drag to reorder"
      className="hidden h-11 w-8 shrink-0 cursor-grab items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-300 hover:text-gray-500 active:cursor-grabbing sm:flex"
    >
      <GripVertical size={18} />
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <li
      {...dragProps}
      className={`rounded-2xl border bg-white shadow-sm transition ${
        active ? "border-[#EAE5DF] border-l-4 border-l-[#E58422]" : "border-[#EAE5DF]"
      } ${dragOver ? "ring-2 ring-[#E58422] ring-offset-2" : ""}`}
    >
      {!active ? (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-1 p-2 sm:p-3">
          {handle}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onActivate}
            className="min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 text-left hover:bg-[#F8F6F3]"
          >
            <span className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
              {question.label || "Untitled question"}
              {question.required && <span className="text-rose-500"> *</span>}
            </span>
            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs text-gray-500">
              {QUESTION_TYPES[question.type]}
              {isChoice && ` · ${question.options.length} options`}
              {question.help_text && ` · ${question.help_text}`}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4 p-3 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-1">
              {handle}
              <input
                value={question.label}
                onChange={(event) => onChange({ label: event.target.value })}
                placeholder="Question"
                aria-label="Question text"
                autoFocus={!question.label}
                className={`${inputClass} font-semibold`}
              />
            </div>
            <select
              value={question.type}
              onChange={(event) => changeType(event.target.value)}
              aria-label="Question type"
              className={`${inputClass} sm:w-48`}
            >
              {Object.entries(QUESTION_TYPES).map(([value, label]) => (
                <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <input
            value={question.help_text}
            onChange={(event) => onChange({ help_text: event.target.value })}
            placeholder="Help text (optional)"
            aria-label="Help text"
            className={inputClass}
          />

          {isChoice && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => (
                <div key={optionIndex} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {question.type === "dropdown" ? (
                    <span className="w-5 shrink-0 text-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">
                      {optionIndex + 1}.
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <OptionIcon size={18} className="w-5 shrink-0 text-gray-300" />
                  )}
                  <input
                    value={option}
                    onChange={(event) => updateOption(optionIndex, event.target.value)}
                    aria-label={`Option ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                    className={inputClass}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      onChange({ options: question.options.filter((_, i) => i !== optionIndex) })
                    }
                    disabled={question.options.length === 1}
                    aria-label={`Remove option ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                    className={iconButtonClass}
                  >
                    <X size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  onChange({ options: [...question.options, `Option ${question.options.length + 1}`] })
                }
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-2 text-sm font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]"
              >
                <Plus size={16} />
                Add option
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-[#EFEAE4] pt-3">
            <div className="flex">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => onMove(-1)} disabled={index === 0} aria-label="Move question up" title="Move up" className={iconButtonClass}>
                <ArrowUp size={17} />
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => onMove(1)} disabled={index === total - 1} aria-label="Move question down" title="Move down" className={iconButtonClass}>
                <ArrowDown size={17} />
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={onDuplicate} aria-label="Duplicate question" title="Duplicate" className={iconButtonClass}>
                <Copy size={17} />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onDelete}
                aria-label="Delete question"
                title="Delete"
                className={`${iconButtonClass} hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600`}
              >
                <Trash2 size={17} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-l border-[#EFEAE4] pl-3">
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600">Required</span>
              <ToggleSwitch
                checked={question.required}
                label="Required question"
                onToggle={() => onChange({ required: !question.required })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

```
// Shared styles for forms inside modals.
// Each property is set once here, so callers never need a second class to override it.
export function fieldClass({
  error = false,
  height = "h-11",
  background = "bg-gray-50",
  padding = "px-4",
} = {}) {
  return `w-full rounded-xl border text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none transition focus:border-[#E58422] focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100 ${
    error ? "border-rose-400" : "border-gray-200"
  } ${height} ${background} ${padding}`;
}

export const inputClass = fieldClass();
export const textareaClass = fieldClass({ height: "", padding: "px-4 py-2.5" });
export const labelClass = "mb-1.5 block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500";
export const cancelButtonClass =
  "min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] transition hover:bg-gray-50";
export const primaryButtonClass =
  "min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#cf7419]";

```
```
import { useState } from "react";
import { Archive, ChevronDown, ImagePlus, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "./ModalWrapper";
import {
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  textareaClass,
  labelClass,
  cancelButtonClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
} from "./formStyles";

const temperatureOptions = ["Hot", "Iced"];
const dietaryTags = ["Dairy", "Nuts", "Gluten", "Egg", "Soy", "Vegan", "Vegetarian", "Caffeine-Free"];

let nextAddOnId = 1;
const newAddOn = (name = "", price = "") => ({ id: nextAddOnId++, name, price });

function FieldError({ id, message }) {
  if (!message) return null;

  return (
    <p id={id} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

function TogglePill({ selected, onClick, children }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={selected}
      className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-xs font-bold transition sm:min-h-9 ${
        selected
          ? "border-[#19244E] bg-[#19244E] text-white"
          : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-600 hover:border-orange-200 hover:bg-orange-50"
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export default function ItemModal({ item, categories, onCancel, onSave, onArchive }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({
    name: item?.name ?? "",
    category: item?.category ?? "",
    price: item ? String(item.price) : "",
    available: item?.available ?? true,
    description: item?.description ?? "",
    image: item?.image ?? "",
    temperatures: item?.temperatures ?? [],
    flavor: item?.flavor ?? "",
    calories: item?.calories == null ? "" : String(item.calories),
    tags: item?.tags ?? [],
    addOns: (item?.addOns ?? []).map((addOn) => newAddOn(addOn.name, String(addOn.price))),
  }));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [showMore, setShowMore] = useState(false);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [confirmArchive, setConfirmArchive] = useState(false);

  const update = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: "" }));
  };

  const toggleInList = (field, value) =>
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: current[field].includes(value)
        ? current[field].filter((entry) => entry !== value)
        : [...current[field], value],
    }));

  const updateAddOn = (id, field, value) =>
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      addOns: current.addOns.map((addOn) => (addOn.id === id ? { ...addOn, [field]: value } : addOn)),
    }));

  const removeAddOn = (id) =>
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      addOns: current.addOns.filter((addOn) => addOn.id !== id),
    }));

  // Preview only: the picked file stays in the browser and is never uploaded.
  const pickImage = (file) => {
    if (file?.type.startsWith("image/")) update("image", URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const submit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = form.name.trim();
    const price = Number(form.price);
    const nextErrors = {
      name: name ? "" : "Item Name is required.",
      category: form.category ? "" : "Choose a category.",
      price: form.price && price > 0 ? "" : "Enter a price greater than 0.",
    };

    if (Object.values(nextErrors).some(Boolean)) {
      setErrors(nextErrors);
      return;
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      name,
      price,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      flavor: form.flavor.trim(),
      calories: form.calories === "" ? null : Number(form.calories),
      addOns: form.addOns
        .filter((addOn) => addOn.name.trim())
        .map((addOn) => ({ name: addOn.name.trim(), price: Number(addOn.price) || 0 })),
    });
  };

  const footer = (
    <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
      {item ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setConfirmArchive(true)}
          className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-300 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-rose-600 transition hover:bg-rose-50"
        >
          <Archive size={16} />
          Archive Item
        </button>
      ) : (
        <span className="hidden sm:block" />
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:gap-3">
        <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
          Cancel
        </button>
        <button type="submit" form="item-form" className={primaryButtonClass}>
          {item ? "Save Changes" : "Add Item"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <ModalWrapper
        title={item ? "Edit Item" : "Add New Item"}
        description={item ? `Update the details for ${item.name}.` : "Add a new item to the sample menu."}
        footer={footer}
        onClose={onCancel}
        maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
      >
        <form id="item-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-6">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label
                onDragOver={(event) => {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  setDragging(true);
                }}
                onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
                onDrop={(event) => {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  setDragging(false);
                  pickImage(event.dataTransfer.files[0]);
                }}
                className={`relative flex h-28 cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 text-center transition focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-orange-200 sm:h-32 ${
                  dragging ? "border-[#E58422] bg-orange-50" : "border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 hover:border-orange-200"
                }`}
              >
                {form.image ? (
                  <img src={form.image} alt="Item preview" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ImagePlus size={24} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                      Drag an image here or click to upload
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">PNG or JPG</span>
                  </>
                )}
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    pickImage(event.target.files[0]);
                    event.target.value = "";
                  }}
                  aria-label="Upload item image"
                  className="sr-only"
                />
              </label>
              {form.image && (
                <div className="mt-1 flex justify-end">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => update("image", "")}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-xl px-3 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 sm:min-h-9"
                  >
                    Remove image
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="item-name" className={labelClass}>
                Item Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                id="item-name"
                type="text"
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(event) => update("name", event.target.value)}
                autoFocus
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)}
                aria-describedby={errors.name ? "item-name-error" : undefined}
                className={fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors.name) })}
              />
              <FieldError id="item-name-error" message={errors.name} />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <label htmlFor="item-category" className={labelClass}>
                  Category <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  id="item-category"
                  value={form.category}
                  onChange={(event) => update("category", event.target.value)}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.category)}
                  aria-describedby={errors.category ? "item-category-error" : undefined}
                  className={fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors.category), padding: "px-3" })}
                >
                  <option value="">Select…</option>
                  {categories.map((name) => (
                    <option key={name} value={name}>{name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <FieldError id="item-category-error" message={errors.category} />
              </div>

              <div className="min-w-0">
                <label htmlFor="item-price" className={labelClass}>
                  Price (₱) <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="item-price"
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={form.price}
                  onChange={(event) => update("price", event.target.value)}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.price)}
                  aria-describedby={errors.price ? "item-price-error" : undefined}
                  className={fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors.price) })}
                />
                <FieldError id="item-price-error" message={errors.price} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="item-availability" className={labelClass}>Availability</label>
              <select
                id="item-availability"
                value={form.available ? "available" : "unavailable"}
                onChange={(event) => update("available", event.target.value === "available")}
                className={inputClass}
              >
                <option value="available">Available</option>
                <option value="unavailable">Unavailable</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowMore((value) => !value)}
              aria-expanded={showMore}
              aria-controls="item-description item-more"
              className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:hidden"
            >
              More details
              <ChevronDown size={18} className={`transition-transform ${showMore ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
            </button>

            <div className={`${showMore ? "block" : "hidden"} sm:block`}>
              <label htmlFor="item-description" className={labelClass}>Description</label>
              <textarea
                id="item-description"
                rows={3}
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(event) => update("description", event.target.value)}
                className={textareaClass}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="item-more" className={`${showMore ? "block" : "hidden"} space-y-4 sm:block`}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <p className={labelClass}>Temperature Options</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {temperatureOptions.map((option) => (
                    <TogglePill
                      key={option}
                      selected={form.temperatures.includes(option)}
                      onClick={() => toggleInList("temperatures", option)}
                    >
                      {option}
                    </TogglePill>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="item-calories" className={labelClass}>Calories (kcal)</label>
                <input
                  id="item-calories"
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  min="0"
                  value={form.calories}
                  onChange={(event) => update("calories", event.target.value)}
                  className={fieldClass({ height: "h-11 sm:h-9" })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="item-flavor" className={labelClass}>Flavor Profile</label>
              <input
                id="item-flavor"
                type="text"
                value={form.flavor}
                onChange={(event) => update("flavor", event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Nutty, caramel, cocoa"
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className={labelClass}>Allergen / Dietary Tags</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {dietaryTags.map((tag) => (
                  <TogglePill
                    key={tag}
                    selected={form.tags.includes(tag)}
                    onClick={() => toggleInList("tags", tag)}
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </TogglePill>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className={labelClass}>Add-ons</p>
              {form.addOns.length > 0 && (
                <ul className="mb-2 space-y-2">
                  {form.addOns.map((addOn, index) => (
                    <li key={addOn.id} className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_96px_44px] gap-2">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={addOn.name}
                        onChange={(event) => updateAddOn(addOn.id, "name", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Extra shot"
                        aria-label={`Add-on ${index + 1} name`}
                        className={inputClass}
                      />
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        inputMode="decimal"
                        min="0"
                        step="0.01"
                        value={addOn.price}
                        onChange={(event) => updateAddOn(addOn.id, "price", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="+₱0"
                        aria-label={`Add-on ${index + 1} extra price`}
                        className={fieldClass({ padding: "px-3" })}
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeAddOn(addOn.id)}
                        aria-label={`Remove add-on ${index + 1}`}
                        className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 text-gray-500 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={16} />
                      </button>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, addOns: [...current.addOns, newAddOn()] }))}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-orange-200 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916] transition hover:bg-orange-50 sm:min-h-9"
              >
                <Plus size={15} />
                Add Add-on
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </ModalWrapper>

      {confirmArchive && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title="Archive this item?"
          description={`${item.name} will be removed from the menu catalog.`}
          onClose={() => setConfirmArchive(false)}
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmArchive(false)} className={cancelButtonClass}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onArchive}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-rose-700"
            >
              Archive
            </button>
          </div>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

```
```
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

// The visible track stays small; the button around it gives a 44px tap area.
export function ToggleSwitch({ checked, disabled = false, label, onToggle, className = "" }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="switch"
      aria-checked={checked}
      aria-label={label}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={onToggle}
      className={`group flex h-11 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${className}`}
    >
      <span
        className={`relative h-6 w-11 rounded-full transition-colors group-disabled:opacity-50 ${checked ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-gray-300"}`}
      >
        <span
          className={`absolute top-0.5 h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${checked ? "left-5" : "left-0.5"}`}
        />
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

// Tall content scrolls inside the modal; the footer stays visible.
// sheetOnPhone: fills the whole screen under 640px.
// dismissible: Esc and a click outside call onClose.
export default function ModalWrapper({
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  onClose,
  maxWidth = "max-w-md",
  className = "",
  sheetOnPhone = false,
  dismissible = false,
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dismissible || !onClose) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [dismissible, onClose]);

  return (
    <div
      onMouseDown={
        dismissible && onClose
          ? (event) => {
              if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose();
            }
          : undefined
      }
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-950/50 ${
        sheetOnPhone ? "sm:p-6" : "p-3 sm:p-6"
      }`}
    >
      <section
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title || "Dialog"}
        className={`flex max-h-full w-full flex-col bg-white shadow-2xl ${
          sheetOnPhone ? "h-full sm:h-auto sm:rounded-2xl" : "rounded-2xl"
        } ${maxWidth} ${className}`}
      >
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-5 sm:px-8 sm:pt-7">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            {title && (
              <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:text-xl">
                {title}
              </h2>
            )}

            {description && (
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">
                {description}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {onClose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close"
              className="-mr-3 -mt-2 flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-400 transition hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-700"
            >
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 pb-5 pt-5 sm:px-8 sm:pb-7">
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-gray-100 px-5 py-3 sm:px-8 sm:py-4">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { OWNER } from "./brandAssets";

// Owner photo, or the "JC" initials if the photo cannot load.
export default function OwnerAvatar({ className = "h-9 w-9 text-xs" }) {
  const [photoFailed, setPhotoFailed] = useState(false);

  if (OWNER.photo && !photoFailed) {
    return (
      <img
        src={OWNER.photo}
        alt=""
        onError={() => setPhotoFailed(true)}
        className={`${className} shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover object-[50%_30%]`}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <span className={`${className} flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#19244E] font-bold text-white`}>
      {OWNER.initials}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```
// Page title, one-line description, and an optional actions slot on the right.
// Wide action rows wrap under the title instead of squeezing it.
// inlineActionsOnPhone keeps a small action (like "+ Create") beside the title on phones.
export default function PageHeader({
  title,
  description,
  actions,
  showDescriptionOnPhone = false,
  inlineActionsOnPhone = false,
}) {
  return (
    <header
      className={`flex gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between ${
        inlineActionsOnPhone ? "flex-row items-start justify-between" : "flex-col"
      }`}
    >
      {/* With an action beside it on phones, the title takes the leftover width, wraps, and uses a smaller size. */}
      <div className={inlineActionsOnPhone ? "min-w-0 flex-1" : "min-w-0"}>
        <h1
          className={`font-bold tracking-tight text-[#19244E] sm:text-[1.75rem] sm:leading-9 ${
            inlineActionsOnPhone ? "text-lg leading-6" : "text-xl"
          }`}
        >
          {title}
        </h1>
        {description && (
          <p
            className={`mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500 sm:block sm:text-sm ${
              showDescriptionOnPhone ? "" : "hidden"
            }`}
          >
            {description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {actions && (
        <div
          className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 ${
            inlineActionsOnPhone ? "shrink-0" : "min-w-0"
          }`}
        >
          {actions}
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/Pagination.jsx

```
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

const buttonClass =
  "inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] transition hover:border-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:border-[#EAE5DF] disabled:hover:bg-white sm:px-4";

// "Showing X–Y of Z" with Previous/Next. Pair it with usePagination().
export default function Pagination({
  page,
  pageSize,
  total,
  onPageChange,
  label = "Pages",
  className = "",
}) {
  if (total === 0) return null;

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));
  const first = (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const last = Math.min(page * pageSize, total);

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label={label}
      className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 ${className}`}
    >
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">
        Showing {first}–{last} of {total}
      </p>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
          disabled={page === 1}
          className={buttonClass}
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={16} />
          Previous
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
          disabled={page === pageCount}
          className={buttonClass}
        >
          Next
          <ChevronRight size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/usePageSize.js

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const PHONE_QUERY = "(max-width: 639px)";
const DESKTOP_ROWS = 7;
const PHONE_ROWS = 4;

const isPhoneScreen = () =>
  typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia(PHONE_QUERY).matches;

// 7 rows on screens 640px and up, 4 rows on phones, unless a list asks for other sizes.
export function usePageSize({ desktop = DESKTOP_ROWS, phone = PHONE_ROWS } = {}) {
  const [isPhone, setIsPhone] = useState(isPhoneScreen);

  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia(PHONE_QUERY);
    const onChange = (event) => setIsPhone(event.matches);
    query.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, []);

  return isPhone ? phone : desktop;
}

// Splits a list into pages. When anything in resetKeys (search, filters) changes, it goes back to page 1.
// `sizes` ({ desktop, phone }) is optional, e.g. a card grid that needs an even number per page.
// The result can be spread straight onto <Pagination />.
export function usePagination(items, resetKeys = [], sizes) {
  const pageSize = usePageSize(sizes);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const resetKey = JSON.stringify(resetKeys);
  const [lastResetKey, setLastResetKey] = useState(resetKey);

  if (resetKey !== lastResetKey) {
    setLastResetKey(resetKey);
    setPage(1);
  }

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(items.length / pageSize));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);
  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;

  return {
    page: currentPage,
    pageSize,
    total: items.length,
    onPageChange: setPage,
    pageItems: items.slice(start, start + pageSize),
  };
}

```

```
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Menu,
  Bell,
  MessageSquare,
  CalendarDays,
  ClipboardCheck,
  UserRound,
  LogOut,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
} from "lucide-react";
import AdminSidebar, { LogoutDialog } from "./AdminSidebar";
import OwnerAvatar from "../components/OwnerAvatar";
import { OWNER } from "../components/brandAssets";

const MUTE_KEY = "beardista-admin-notifications-muted";
const OPENING_HOUR = 16; // The café opens at 4:00 PM.

const sampleNotifications = [
  {
    id: "survey-1",
    icon: MessageSquare,
    title: "New survey response",
    message: "Alex Morgan rated their visit 5 stars.",
    time: "5 min ago",
    link: "/admin/analytics?response=1",
    read: false,
  },
  {
    id: "event-join",
    icon: CalendarDays,
    title: "Someone joined an event",
    message: "Bianca Cruz joined the Latte Art Throwdown.",
    time: "1 hr ago",
    link: "/admin/events?tab=participants",
    read: false,
  },
  {
    id: "opening-check",
    icon: ClipboardCheck,
    title: "Opening check",
    message: "These items were unavailable yesterday. Still unavailable today?",
    items: ["Spanish Latte", "Blueberry Cheesecake", "Matcha Cold Brew"],
    time: "4:00 PM",
    read: false,
  },
];

// Arrives 15 seconds after the first click so the sound can be tested.
const demoNotification = {
  id: "survey-2",
  icon: MessageSquare,
  title: "New survey response",
  message: "Jamie Santos rated their visit 5 stars.",
  time: "Just now",
  link: "/admin/analytics?response=2",
  read: false,
};

let audioContext = null;

// Browsers only allow sound after the user has interacted with the page.
function unlockAudio() {
  const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AudioContextClass) return;
  if (!audioContext) audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
  if (audioContext.state === "suspended") audioContext.resume();
}

// Short two-note chime made with the Web Audio API (no sound file needed).
function playChime() {
  if (!audioContext || audioContext.state !== "running") return;

  const now = audioContext.currentTime;
  [880, 1320].forEach((frequency, index) => {
    const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioContext.createGain();
    const start = now + index * 0.12;

    oscillator.type = "sine";
    oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, start + 0.02);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + 0.4);

    oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
    oscillator.start(start);
    oscillator.stop(start + 0.45);
  });
}

function readMuted() {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(MUTE_KEY) === "true";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function NotificationItem({ notification, openingAnswer, onOpen, onAnswer }) {
  const { icon: Icon, title, message, time, items, read } = notification;

  const content = (
    <>
      <span
        className={`mt-0.5 hidden h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl sm:flex ${
          read ? "bg-gray-100 text-gray-400" : "bg-orange-50 text-[#E58422]"
        }`}
      >
        <Icon size={18} />
      </span>

      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <span
            className={`text-sm ${
              read ? "font-semibold text-gray-600" : "font-bold text-[#19244E]"
            }`}
          >
            {title}
          </span>
          <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-gray-400">{time}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500">
          {message}
        </span>
      </span>

      {!read && (
        <span
          aria-label="Unread"
          className="mt-2 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[#E58422]"
        />
      )}
    </>
  );

  if (!items) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onOpen}
        className="flex w-full gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left transition hover:bg-gray-50"
      >
        {content}
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex gap-3">{content}</div>

      <ul className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 sm:pl-12">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <li
            key={item}
            className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-600"
          >
            {item}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      <div className="mt-3 sm:pl-12">
        {openingAnswer ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#19244E]">
            {openingAnswer === "yes"
              ? "Kept as unavailable for today."
              : "Marked as available again."}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onAnswer("yes")}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f]"
            >
              Yes
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onAnswer("no")}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 transition hover:bg-gray-50"
            >
              No
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AdminLayout({
  activePage = "Dashboard",
  children,
}) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState(null);
  const [logoutOpen, setLogoutOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState(sampleNotifications);
  const [openingAnswer, setOpeningAnswer] = useState(null);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(readMuted);
  const mutedRef = useRef(muted);
  const notificationsRef = useRef(null);
  const accountRef = useRef(null);

  const unreadCount = notifications.filter((item) => !item.read).length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mobileOpen) return;

    const close = () => setMobileOpen(false);
    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") close();
    };
    // Matches Tailwind's lg breakpoint, where the sidebar is always shown.
    const desktop = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1024px)");
    const onScreenChange = (event) => {
      if (event.matches) close();
    };
    const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;

    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    desktop.addEventListener("change", onScreenChange);

    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
      desktop.removeEventListener("change", onScreenChange);
    };
  }, [mobileOpen]);

  // Close the open header menu on a tap outside it or on Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openMenu) return;

    const menuRef = openMenu === "notifications" ? notificationsRef : accountRef;
    const onPointerDown = (event) => {
      if (!menuRef.current?.contains(event.target)) setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenMenu(null);
    };

    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [openMenu]);

  useEffect(() => {
    mutedRef.current = muted;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(MUTE_KEY, String(muted));
    } catch {
      // Storage can be blocked (private mode); the toggle still works for this visit.
    }
  }, [muted]);

  // Unlock sound on the first click, then deliver a sample notification 15 seconds later.
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer;
    const onFirstClick = () => {
      unlockAudio();
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setNotifications((current) =>
          current.some((item) => item.id === demoNotification.id)
            ? current
            : [demoNotification, ...current]
        );
        if (!mutedRef.current) playChime();
      }, 15000);
    };

    document.addEventListener("click", onFirstClick, { once: true });
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("click", onFirstClick);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  // When 4:00 PM passes while the page is open, the opening check comes back as new.
  useEffect(() => {
    let wasOpen = new Date().getHours() >= OPENING_HOUR;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const isOpen = new Date().getHours() >= OPENING_HOUR;
      if (isOpen && !wasOpen) {
        setOpeningAnswer(null);
        setNotifications((current) =>
          current.map((item) =>
            item.id === "opening-check" ? { ...item, read: false } : item
          )
        );
        if (!mutedRef.current) playChime();
      }
      wasOpen = isOpen;
    }, 30000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const toggleMenu = (menu) =>
    setOpenMenu((current) => (current === menu ? null : menu));

  const markRead = (id) =>
    setNotifications((current) =>
      current.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, read: true } : item))
    );

  const markAllRead = () =>
    setNotifications((current) =>
      current.map((item) => ({ ...item, read: true }))
    );

  const openNotification = (notification) => {
    markRead(notification.id);
    setOpenMenu(null);
    navigate(notification.link);
  };

  const answerOpeningCheck = (answer) => {
    setOpeningAnswer(answer);
    markRead("opening-check");
  };

  return (
    // Fills the visible screen exactly (dvh ignores the phone address bar), so only <main> scrolls.
    <div className="h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden bg-[#F8F6F3] text-gray-900">
      <AdminSidebar
        activePage={activePage}
        mobileOpen={mobileOpen}
        onClose={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
      />

      <div className="flex h-full min-w-0 flex-col lg:pl-72">
        <header className="relative z-30 flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white/95 px-4 backdrop-blur sm:px-8">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Open navigation"
              onClick={() => setMobileOpen(true)}
              className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-2 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 lg:hidden"
            >
              <Menu size={20} />
            </button>

            <div className="hidden items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-400 sm:flex">
              <span>Admin</span>
              <span>/</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[#19244E]">{activePage}</span>
            </div>

            <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:hidden">
              {activePage}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4">
            <div ref={notificationsRef} className="relative">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleMenu("notifications")}
                aria-label={`Notifications, ${unreadCount} unread`}
                aria-haspopup="true"
                aria-expanded={openMenu === "notifications"}
                className="relative flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                <Bell size={20} />
                {unreadCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="absolute right-1 top-1 flex h-[18px] min-w-[18px] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#E58422] px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white ring-2 ring-white">
                    {unreadCount}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>

              {/* Phones: full-width panel under the header. Larger screens: dropdown under the bell. */}
              {openMenu === "notifications" && (
                <div className="fixed inset-x-3 top-[4.25rem] z-40 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-xl sm:absolute sm:inset-x-auto sm:right-0 sm:top-full sm:mt-2 sm:w-96">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 pl-4 pr-1">
                    <p className="py-3 text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                      Notifications
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      {unreadCount > 0 && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={markAllRead}
                          className="min-h-11 px-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline"
                        >
                          Mark all as read
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setMuted((value) => !value)}
                        aria-pressed={muted}
                        aria-label={muted ? "Unmute notification sound" : "Mute notification sound"}
                        title={muted ? "Sound off" : "Sound on"}
                        className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-[#19244E]"
                      >
                        {muted ? <VolumeX size={18} /> : <Volume2 size={18} />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <ul className="max-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)] divide-y divide-gray-100 overflow-y-auto">
                    {notifications.map((notification) => (
                      <li key={notification.id}>
                        <NotificationItem
                          notification={notification}
                          openingAnswer={openingAnswer}
                          onOpen={() => openNotification(notification)}
                          onAnswer={answerOpeningCheck}
                        />
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div ref={accountRef} className="relative">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleMenu("account")}
                aria-label="Account menu"
                aria-haspopup="menu"
                aria-expanded={openMenu === "account"}
                className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full"
              >
                <OwnerAvatar className="h-9 w-9 text-xs transition hover:ring-4 hover:ring-gray-100" />
              </button>

              {openMenu === "account" && (
                <div
                  role="menu"
                  className="absolute right-0 top-full z-40 mt-2 w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-2 shadow-xl"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2">
                    <OwnerAvatar className="h-9 w-9 text-xs" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{OWNER.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{OWNER.role}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitem"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setOpenMenu(null);
                      navigate("/admin/account");
                    }}
                    className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 transition hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    <UserRound size={18} className="text-gray-400" />
                    My Account
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitem"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setOpenMenu(null);
                      setLogoutOpen(true);
                    }}
                    className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-600 transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
                  >
                    <LogOut size={18} />
                    Log Out
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="w-full min-w-0 px-4 py-5 sm:px-8 sm:py-6">
            {children}
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Kept outside <header>: its backdrop blur would trap a fixed overlay inside it. */}
      <LogoutDialog open={logoutOpen} onCancel={() => setLogoutOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  Coffee,
  ChartNoAxesCombined,
  FileText,
  Users,
  ShieldCheck,
  CalendarDays,
  Settings,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { NavLink, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../../backend/hooks/useAuth";
import ModalWrapper from "../components/ModalWrapper";
import BrandMark from "../components/BrandMark";
import OwnerAvatar from "../components/OwnerAvatar";
import { OWNER } from "../components/brandAssets";

const navigation = [
  { label: "Dashboard", path: "/admin/dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { label: "Menu Management", path: "/admin/menu-management", icon: Coffee },
  { label: "Analytics", path: "/admin/analytics", icon: ChartNoAxesCombined },
  { label: "Content Management", path: "/admin/content-management", icon: FileText },
  { label: "User Management", path: "/admin/user-management", icon: Users },
  { label: "Audit Logs", path: "/admin/audit-logs", icon: ShieldCheck },
  { label: "Events", path: "/admin/events", icon: CalendarDays },
  { label: "Settings", path: "/admin/settings", icon: Settings },
];

export function LogoutDialog({ open, onCancel }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { logOut, isLoggingOut } = useAuth();
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") onCancel();
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [open, onCancel]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    setError("");
    try {
      await logOut();
      onCancel();
      navigate("/admin/login");
    } catch {
      setError("We couldn't log you out. Please try again.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title="Log out?"
      description="You will need to log in again to manage the Beardista Brew menu."
    >
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="mb-3 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600 transition hover:bg-gray-50"
        >
          Cancel
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleLogout}
          disabled={isLoggingOut}
          className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
        >
          {isLoggingOut ? "Logging Out..." : "Log Out"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}

export default function AdminSidebar({
  activePage = "Dashboard",
  mobileOpen = false,
  onClose,
}) {
  const [logoutOpen, setLogoutOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <>
      {mobileOpen && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close navigation backdrop"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/40 lg:hidden"
        />
      )}

      <aside
        className={`fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex w-[min(18rem,85vw)] flex-col bg-[#19244E] text-white shadow-xl transition-transform duration-300 lg:translate-x-0 ${
          mobileOpen ? "translate-x-0" : "-translate-x-full"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex h-20 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <BrandMark />
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-extrabold">BEARDISTA BREW</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] text-white/50">
                ADMIN PANEL
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close sidebar"
            className="rounded-lg p-2 hover:bg-white/10 lg:hidden"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <p className="px-8 pb-2 pt-7 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white/40">
          Workspace
        </p>

        <nav
          aria-label="Admin navigation"
          className="flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-2"
        >
          {navigation.map(({ label, path, icon: Icon }) => (
            <NavLink
              key={path}
              to={path}
              onClick={onClose}
              end
              className={({ isActive }) =>
                `flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${
                  isActive || activePage === label
                    ? "bg-[#E58422] text-white shadow-md"
                    : "text-white/70 hover:bg-white/10"
                }`
              }
            >
              <Icon size={19} />
              <span>{label}</span>
            </NavLink>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <div className="mt-auto shrink-0 border-t border-white/10 p-5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setLogoutOpen(true)}
            className="mb-3 flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-rose-300/10 bg-rose-400/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-200 transition-colors hover:bg-rose-400/20"
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">↪</span>
            <span>Log Out</span>
          </button>

          <NavLink
            to="/admin/account"
            onClick={onClose}
            title="Open My Account"
            className={({ isActive }) =>
              `flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-3 transition-colors hover:bg-white/10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#E58422] ${
                isActive ? "bg-white/15" : "bg-white/5"
              }`
            }
          >
            <OwnerAvatar className="h-10 w-10 text-sm ring-2 ring-white/15" />
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold">{OWNER.name}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-white/50">{OWNER.role}</p>
            </div>
            <span className="sr-only">, open My Account</span>
          </NavLink>

          <p className="px-2 pt-4 text-xs text-white/50">
            v1.0.0 | Beardista Brew
          </p>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Kept outside <aside>: its transform would trap a fixed overlay inside the sidebar. */}
      <LogoutDialog open={logoutOpen} onCancel={() => setLogoutOpen(false)} />
    </>
  );
}
```
