```
import { useState } from "react";
import { CalendarDays, Eye, MessageSquare, UtensilsCrossed } from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import StatCard, { StatGrid } from "../components/StatCard";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";
import Pagination from "../components/Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../components/usePageSize";
import pastaPhoto from "../../../assets/pasta.jpg";
import saladPhoto from "../../../assets/salad.jpg";
import nachosPhoto from "../../../assets/nachos.png";
import juicesPhoto from "../../../assets/juices.png";

// Most viewed sample items this month, each with its real menu photo.
const favorites = [
  { name: "Truffle Carbonara", category: "Pasta", photo: pastaPhoto, views: 1284 },
  { name: "Garden Caesar Salad", category: "Salad", photo: saladPhoto, views: 962 },
  { name: "Loaded Nachos", category: "Savory Bites", photo: nachosPhoto, views: 874 },
  { name: "Fresh Fruit Juice", category: "Zero-Proof", photo: juicesPhoto, views: 803 },
];

const stats = [
  { label: "Total Menu Items", value: "17", sub: "Across 13 categories", icon: UtensilsCrossed },
  { label: "Menu Views", value: "12,480", sub: "This month · sample data", icon: Eye },
  { label: "Survey Responses", value: "326", sub: "This month · sample data", icon: MessageSquare },
  { label: "Active Events", value: "3", sub: "Running or coming up", icon: CalendarDays },
];

function greetingFor(hour) {
  if (hour < 12) return "Good morning";
  if (hour < 18) return "Good afternoon";
  return "Good evening";
}

export default function AdminDashboard() {
  const [storeOnline, setStoreOnline] = useState(true);
  const pager = usePagination(favorites);

  const now = new Date();
  const today = now.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });

  const storeToggle = (
    <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white px-4 py-2.5 shadow-sm sm:w-auto">
      <div>
        <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${storeOnline ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-gray-600"}`}>
          {storeOnline ? "● Menu online" : "○ Menu paused"}
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">Opens at 4:00 PM</p>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={storeOnline}
        aria-label="Toggle store status"
        onClick={() => setStoreOnline((value) => !value)}
        className="flex h-11 shrink-0 items-center"
      >
        <span
          className={`relative inline-flex h-7 w-14 items-center rounded-full transition-colors ${storeOnline ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-gray-400"}`}
        >
          <span
            className={`h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${storeOnline ? "translate-x-8" : "translate-x-1"}`}
          />
        </span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title={`${greetingFor(now.getHours())}, Jim Carlo`}
        description={today}
        showDescriptionOnPhone
        actions={storeToggle}
      />

      {!storeOnline && (
        <div role="alert" className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-950">Menu is paused.</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-800">
            Items show as unavailable until the store is back online.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <StatGrid>
        {stats.map((stat) => (
          <StatCard key={stat.label} {...stat} />
        ))}
      </StatGrid>

      <DataCard
        title="Customer Favorites This Month"
        description="Most viewed menu items · Sample data"
        bodyClassName="px-4 sm:px-6"
        footer={<Pagination {...pager} label="Customer favorites pages" />}
      >
        <ol className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4]">
          {pager.pageItems.map(({ name, category, photo, views }) => {
            const rank = favorites.findIndex((item) => item.name === name) + 1;

            return (
              <li key={name} className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3 py-3">
                <span
                  className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold ${
                    rank === 1
                      ? "bg-[#E58422] text-white"
                      : "bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {rank}
                </span>

                <img
                  src={photo}
                  alt=""
                  className="h-11 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-xl object-cover"
                />

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{name}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">{category}</p>
                </div>

                <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">
                  <Eye size={13} className="hidden text-gray-400 sm:block" />
                  {views.toLocaleString()}
                  <span className="hidden font-semibold text-gray-400 sm:inline">views</span>
                </span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      </DataCard>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/pages/AdminLogin.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Mail, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../backend/hooks/useAuth";
import BaristaAnimation from "../components/BaristaAnimation";
import BrandMark from "../components/BrandMark";
import BrewingLoader from "../components/BrewingLoader";

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

const inputClass =
  "h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 pl-11 text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none transition focus:border-[#E58422] focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100";

// Desktop: 60% brand panel + 40% login card. Phones: only the card, logo on top.
export default function AdminLogin() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { logIn, sendPasswordReset, isLoggingIn, isSendingPasswordReset } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [info, setInfo] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setInfo("");

    if (!email.trim() || !password) {
      setError("Enter your email and password.");
      return;
    }
    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email.trim())) {
      setError("Enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    try {
      await logIn({ email: email.trim(), password });
      navigate("/admin/dashboard");
    } catch (authError) {
      if (authError.code === "invalid_credentials") {
        setError("Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.");
      } else if (authError.code === "account_disabled") {
        setError("This account is disabled. Contact the owner for help.");
      } else if (authError.code === "profile_missing") {
        setError("Your staff profile is not set up yet. Contact the owner for help.");
      } else {
        setError("We couldn't log you in. Please try again.");
      }
    }
  };

  const handleForgotPassword = async () => {
    setError("");
    setInfo("");

    if (!email.trim() || !EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email.trim())) {
      setError("Enter a valid email address to reset your password.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await sendPasswordReset(email.trim());
      setInfo("If an account exists for that email, a password reset link will be sent.");
    } catch {
      setError("We couldn't send a reset link. Please try again.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8F6F3] lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[3fr_2fr]">
      <aside className="relative hidden overflow-hidden bg-[#19244E] px-12 py-10 text-white lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:justify-between">
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -right-24 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-[#E58422]/15" />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -bottom-32 -left-20 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-white/5" />

        <div className="relative flex items-center gap-3">
          <BrandMark />
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-extrabold tracking-wide">BEARDISTA BREW</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] text-white/50">ADMIN PANEL</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <BaristaAnimation className="relative mx-auto w-full max-w-md" />

        <p className="relative text-xs text-white/50">Gentleman's Coffee · Caloocan City</p>
      </aside>

      <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center px-4 py-10 sm:px-8">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md">
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center sm:flex-row sm:text-left lg:flex-col lg:items-start">
              <BrandMark size="lg" />
              <div className="mt-3 sm:ml-3 sm:mt-0 lg:ml-0 lg:mt-3">
                <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">BEARDISTA BREW</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] text-gray-400">ADMIN PANEL</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <h1 className="mt-6 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#19244E] sm:mt-8">
              Welcome back
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Log in to manage the Beardista Brew menu.</p>

            {error && (
              <p role="alert" className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            {info && (
              <p role="status" className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#19244E]">
                {info}
              </p>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="mt-6 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="admin-email" className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Email</label>
                <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                  <Mail size={18} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                  <input
                    id="admin-email"
                    type="email"
                    autoComplete="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setEmail(event.target.value);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                    placeholder="you@beardistabrew.com"
                    aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
                    className={`${inputClass} pr-4`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label htmlFor="admin-password" className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Password</label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleForgotPassword}
                    disabled={isSendingPasswordReset}
                    className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline"
                  >
                    {isSendingPasswordReset ? "Sending reset link..." : "Forgot password?"}
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Lock size={18} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                  <input
                    id="admin-password"
                    type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setPassword(event.target.value);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                    placeholder="At least 8 characters"
                    aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
                    className={`${inputClass} pr-12`}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword((value) => !value)}
                    aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                    aria-pressed={showPassword}
                    className="absolute right-0.5 top-1/2 flex h-11 w-11 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-400 hover:text-[#19244E]"
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isLoggingIn}
                className="flex min-h-12 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#cf7419] disabled:cursor-wait"
              >
                {isLoggingIn ? <BrewingLoader tone="light" size={26} /> : "Log In"}
              </button>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">
              <ShieldCheck size={14} />
              Staff access only
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
const ratings = [

];

const audience = [
  { label: "University / Students", percent: 45, color: "#19244E" },
  { label: "Young Professionals", percent: 35, color: "#E58422" },
  { label: "Neighborhood Regulars", percent: 20, color: "#F6AD55" },
];

const weeklyVisits = [
  { label: "Week 1", range: "Oct 1–7", visits: 7240 },
  { label: "Week 2", range: "Oct 8–14", visits: 8610 },
  { label: "Week 3", range: "Oct 15–21", visits: 7900 },
  { label: "Week 4", range: "Oct 22–28", visits: 11170 },
];

const CHART_WIDTH = 500;
const CHART_HEIGHT = 180;
const CHART_MAX = 12000;

// Each point sits in the middle of its week column so it lines up with the label below.
const chartPoints = weeklyVisits.map((week, index) => ({
  ...week,
  x: (CHART_WIDTH / weeklyVisits.length) * (index + 0.5),
  y: CHART_HEIGHT - 10 - (week.visits / CHART_MAX) * (CHART_HEIGHT - 30),
}));

// Smooth curve that passes exactly through every point (Catmull-Rom turned into cubic curves).
function smoothPath(points) {
  return points.reduce((path, point, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return `M${point.x} ${point.y}`;

    const start = points[index - 1];
    const before = points[index - 2] ?? start;
    const after = points[index + 1] ?? point;
    const c1x = start.x + (point.x - before.x) / 6;
    const c1y = start.y + (point.y - before.y) / 6;
    const c2x = point.x - (after.x - start.x) / 6;
    const c2y = point.y - (after.y - start.y) / 6;

    return `${path} C${c1x} ${c1y} ${c2x} ${c2y} ${point.x} ${point.y}`;
  }, "");
}

const linePath = smoothPath(chartPoints);
const areaPath = `${linePath} L${chartPoints.at(-1).x} ${CHART_HEIGHT} L${chartPoints[0].x} ${CHART_HEIGHT} Z`;

const questionTypes = {
  choice: "Multiple choice",
  rating: "Rating 1-5",
  text: "Short text",
};

const initialQuestions = [

  { id: 3, type: "text", text: "What should we add to the menu next?", options: [] },
];

let nextSurveyId = 100;
const newSurveyId = () => nextSurveyId++;

function SectionLabel({ children }) {
  return (

      {children}
    </span>
  );
}


function VisitsChart() {
  const summary = weeklyVisits
    .map((week) => `${week.label} ${week.visits.toLocaleString()}`)
    .join(", ");

  return (
    <div className="mt-4">
      {/* The SVG stretches to fit, so the dots are HTML placed by percentage to stay round and on the line. */}
      <div className="relative h-40 w-full sm:h-48">
        <svg
          className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full"
          viewBox={`0 0 ${CHART_WIDTH} ${CHART_HEIGHT}`}
          preserveAspectRatio="none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`Sample digital visits per week: ${summary}`}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="analyticsVisitGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#E58422" stopOpacity=".3" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#E58422" stopOpacity="0" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          {[30, 80, 130].map((y) => (
            <line
              key={y}
              x1="0"
              y1={y}
              x2={CHART_WIDTH}
              y2={y}
              stroke="#E5E7EB"
              strokeDasharray="4 5"
              vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
            />
          ))}
          <path d={areaPath} fill="url(#analyticsVisitGradient)" />
          <path
            d={linePath}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#E58422"
            strokeWidth="3.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
          />
        </svg>

        {chartPoints.map((point) => (
          <span
            key={point.label}
            aria-hidden="true"
            title={`${point.label}: ${point.visits.toLocaleString()} visits`}
            style={{
              left: `${(point.x / CHART_WIDTH) * 100}%`,
              top: `${(point.y / CHART_HEIGHT) * 100}%`,
            }}
            className="absolute h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-[#19244E] shadow"
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-400 sm:text-[11px]">
        {weeklyVisits.map((week) => (
          <span key={week.label}>
            {week.label}
            <span className="hidden sm:inline"> · {week.range}</span>
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const DONUT_CIRCUMFERENCE = 2 * Math.PI * 38;

// Each slice starts where the previous slices end.
const audienceSlices = audience.map((item, index) => ({
  ...item,
  dash: (DONUT_CIRCUMFERENCE * item.percent) / 100,
  offset: -audience
    .slice(0, index)
    .reduce((sum, previous) => sum + (DONUT_CIRCUMFERENCE * previous.percent) / 100, 0),
}));

function DemographicsChart() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <div className="relative my-4 h-32 w-32 sm:h-36 sm:w-36">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="h-full w-full -rotate-90">
          {audienceSlices.map((item) => (
            <circle
              key={item.label}
              cx="50"
              cy="50"
              r="38"
              fill="none"
              stroke={item.color}
              strokeWidth="15"
              strokeDasharray={`${item.dash} ${DONUT_CIRCUMFERENCE - item.dash}`}
              strokeDashoffset={item.offset}
            />
          ))}
        </svg>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          <strong className="text-xl font-black text-[#19244E]">1,428</strong>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-400">Daily average</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="w-full space-y-2.5 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3">
        {audience.map((item) => (
          <div key={item.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600">
              <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} />
              {item.label}
            </span>
            <strong className="text-[#19244E]">{item.percent}%</strong>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function IconButton({ label, onClick, disabled = false, danger = false, children }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-500 transition disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30 sm:h-9 sm:w-9 ${
        danger ? "hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600" : "hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-[#19244E]"
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function QuestionEditor({ question, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [type, setType] = useState(question?.type ?? "choice");
  const [text, setText] = useState(question?.text ?? "");
  const [options, setOptions] = useState(() =>
    (question?.options.length ? question.options : ["", ""]).map((option) => ({
      id: newSurveyId(),
      text: option,
    }))
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const updateOption = (id, value) =>
    setOptions((current) => current.map((option) => (option.id === id ? { ...option, text: value } : option)));

  const submit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    const filled = options.map((option) => option.text.trim()).filter(Boolean);

    if (!trimmed) return setError("Enter the question.");
    if (type === "choice" && filled.length < 2) return setError("Add at least 2 answer options.");

    onSave({
      id: question?.id ?? newSurveyId(),
      type,
      text: trimmed,
      options: type === "choice" ? filled : [],
    });
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border-2 border-orange-200 bg-orange-50/40 p-3 sm:p-4">
      <div>
        <p className={labelClass}>Question type</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
          {Object.entries(questionTypes).map(([value, label]) => (
            <button
              key={value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setType(value)}
              aria-pressed={type === value}
              className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl border px-2 text-xs font-bold transition sm:min-h-9 ${
                type === value
                  ? "border-[#19244E] bg-[#19244E] text-white"
                  : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-600 hover:border-orange-200"
              }`}
            >
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <label htmlFor="question-text" className={labelClass}>Question</label>
        <input
          id="question-text"
          type="text"
          value={text}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setText(event.target.value);
            setError("");
          }}
          autoFocus
          className={fieldClass({ background: "bg-white" })}
        />
      </div>

      {type === "choice" && (
        <div>
          <p className={labelClass}>Answer options</p>
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {options.map((option, index) => (
              <li key={option.id} className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={option.text}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    updateOption(option.id, event.target.value);
                    setError("");
                  }}
                  placeholder={`Option ${index + 1}`}
                  aria-label={`Option ${index + 1}`}
                  className={fieldClass({ background: "bg-white" })}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOptions((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== option.id))}
                  disabled={options.length <= 2}
                  aria-label={`Remove option ${index + 1}`}
                  className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-500 transition hover:text-rose-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  <X size={16} />
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setOptions((current) => [...current, { id: newSurveyId(), text: "" }])}
            className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-white px-4 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916] transition hover:bg-orange-50 sm:min-h-9"
          >
            <Plus size={15} />
            Add option
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "rating" && (
        <div>
          <p className={labelClass}>Customers pick a score</p>
          <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex gap-1.5">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
              <span key={score} className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white text-sm font-bold text-gray-500">
                {score}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "text" && (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-xs text-gray-400">
          Customers type a short answer.
        </p>
      )}

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">{error}</p>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
        <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
          Cancel
        </button>
        <button type="submit" className={primaryButtonClass}>
          {question ? "Update Question" : "Add Question"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function SurveyBuilderModal({ questions, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(questions);
  // A question id, "new" for the add form, or null when nothing is being edited.
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const busy = editingId !== null;

  const move = (index, step) =>
    setDraft((current) => {
      const next = [...current];
      const [question] = next.splice(index, 1);
      next.splice(index + step, 0, question);
      return next;
    });

  const saveQuestion = (question) => {
    setDraft((current) =>
      editingId === "new"
        ? [...current, question]
        : current.map((entry) => (entry.id === question.id ? question : entry))
    );
    setEditingId(null);
  };

  const footer = (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
        Cancel
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onSave(draft)}
        disabled={busy}
        title={busy ? "Finish the open question first" : undefined}
        className={`${primaryButtonClass} disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50`}
      >
        Save Survey
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title="Survey Builder"
      description="Build the short survey customers fill in after their visit."
      footer={footer}
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-2xl"
    >
      {draft.length === 0 && editingId !== "new" && (
        <p className="mb-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
          No questions yet. Add one to start.
        </p>
      )}

      <ol className="space-y-2">
        {draft.map((question, index) =>
          editingId === question.id ? (
            <li key={question.id}>
              <QuestionEditor
                question={question}
                onCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
                onSave={saveQuestion}
              />
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li
              key={question.id}
              className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center"
            >
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#19244E] text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  {index + 1}
                </span>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{question.text}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-[#B96916]">{questionTypes[question.type]}</span>
                    {question.type === "choice" && ` · ${question.options.join(", ")}`}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex shrink-0 justify-end gap-0.5">
                <IconButton label="Move up" onClick={() => move(index, -1)} disabled={busy || index === 0}>
                  <ArrowUp size={16} />
                </IconButton>
                <IconButton label="Move down" onClick={() => move(index, 1)} disabled={busy || index === draft.length - 1}>
                  <ArrowDown size={16} />
                </IconButton>
                <IconButton label="Edit question" onClick={() => setEditingId(question.id)} disabled={busy}>
                  <Pencil size={16} />
                </IconButton>
                <IconButton
                  label="Delete question"
                  onClick={() => setDraft((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== question.id))}
                  disabled={busy}
                  danger
                >
                  <Trash2 size={16} />
                </IconButton>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        )}
      </ol>

      <div className="mt-3">
        {editingId === "new" ? (
          <QuestionEditor onCancel={() => setEditingId(null)} onSave={saveQuestion} />
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setEditingId("new")}
            disabled={busy}
            className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 text-sm font-bold text-[#B96916] transition hover:bg-orange-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
            Add Question
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}

export default function Analytics() {
  const [timeframe, setTimeframe] = useState("30d");
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(initialFeedback);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState(initialQuestions);
  const [surveyOpen, setSurveyOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();

  // The open response lives in the link (?response=1) so notifications can open it.
  const selectedResponse = feedback.find(
    (item) => String(item.id) === searchParams.get("response")
  );

  const feedbackPager = usePagination(feedback);
  const pageFeedback = feedbackPager.pageItems;

  function openResponse(id) {
    setSearchParams({ response: String(id) });
  }

  function closeResponse() {
    setSearchParams({}, { replace: true });
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedResponse) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setSearchParams({}, { replace: true });
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [selectedResponse, setSearchParams]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!surveyOpen) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setSurveyOpen(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [surveyOpen]);

  function toggleFeedback(id) {
    setFeedback((items) =>
      items.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, syncToVoice: !item.syncToVoice } : item
      )
    );
  }

  function archiveFeedback(item) {
    setFeedback((items) => items.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
    setNotice(`Feedback from ${item.name} was archived.`);
  }

  function saveSurvey(nextQuestions) {
    setQuestions(nextQuestions);
    setSurveyOpen(false);
    setNotice(`Survey saved with ${nextQuestions.length} ${nextQuestions.length === 1 ? "question" : "questions"}.`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {notice && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex max-w-sm items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-xl"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="shrink-0 text-[#E58422]" />
          <span>{notice}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setNotice("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss notification"
            className="ml-1 rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <PageHeader
        title="Analytics & Customer Reports"
        description="Review sample visitor trends, customer satisfaction, and feedback."
        actions={
        <>
          <div className="flex rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-1 shadow-sm">
            {[
              { value: "7d", label: "7 Days" },
              { value: "30d", label: "30 Days" },
              { value: "90d", label: "Quarterly" },
            ].map((option) => (
              <button
                key={option.value}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTimeframe(option.value)}
                aria-pressed={timeframe === option.value}
                className={`min-h-11 rounded-lg px-3 text-[11px] font-bold transition sm:min-h-9 sm:text-xs ${
                  timeframe === option.value
                    ? "bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                    : "text-gray-500 hover:text-[#19244E]"
                }`}
              >
                {option.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSurveyOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 text-xs font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
          >
            <ClipboardList size={15} />
            Survey Builder
          </button>
        </>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-3">
        <DataCard
          className="min-w-0 xl:col-span-2"
          title="Total Digital Visits"
          description={`${timeframe === "7d" ? "Last 7 days" : timeframe === "30d" ? "October 2026" : "Quarterly overview"} · Sample data`}
          badge={
            <div className="text-right">
              <p className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:text-2xl">34,920</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600">↗ 14.2% MoM</p>
            </div>
          }
        >
          <VisitsChart />
        </DataCard>

        <DataCard className="min-w-0" title="Visitor Demographics">
          <DemographicsChart />
        </DataCard>
      </div>

      <DataCard
        title="Customer Experience Rating Distribution"
        description="Ratings from 1 to 5 stars · Sample data"
        badge={
          <span className="inline-block rounded-xl bg-[#FFF3E7] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916]">
            Avg 4.85 / 5
          </span>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {ratings.map((rating) => (
            <div key={rating.label} className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4">
              <span className="w-28 shrink-0 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 sm:w-40 sm:text-xs">
                {rating.label}
              </span>
              <div className="h-3 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100">
                <div
                  className={`h-full rounded-full ${rating.color}`}
                  style={{ width: `${rating.percent}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className="w-[68px] shrink-0 text-right text-[10px] font-extrabold text-gray-700 sm:text-xs">
                {rating.percent}% ({rating.count})
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </DataCard>

      <DataCard
        title="Individual Customer Feedback"
        description="Hide a response from the live feed or archive it."
        badge={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#FFF3E7] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916]">
            <Users size={14} className="hidden sm:block" />
            {feedback.length} submissions
          </span>
        }
        footer={feedback.length > 0 && <Pagination {...feedbackPager} label="Feedback pages" />}
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {feedback.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Star}
              title="No feedback yet."
              message="Every cup tells a story. New survey answers will show up here."
            />
          ) : (
            pageFeedback.map((item) => (
              <article
                key={item.id}
                className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/70 p-3 transition hover:border-gray-300 sm:p-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
                    <strong className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">{item.name}</strong>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{item.date}</span>
                    <span className="rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500">
                      {item.visitFrequency}
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-amber-500">
                      <Star size={12} fill="currentColor" />
                      {item.rating}.0
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm italic leading-6 text-gray-700">
                    “{item.comment}”
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-400">
                    Preference: <strong className="text-gray-600">{item.preference}</strong>
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:justify-start">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openResponse(item.id)}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] transition hover:border-[#19244E]"
                  >
                    View details
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleFeedback(item.id)}
                    aria-pressed={item.syncToVoice}
                    aria-label={`${item.syncToVoice ? "Hide" : "Show"} feedback from ${item.name}`}
                    className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3"
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`relative h-6 w-11 rounded-full transition ${
                        item.syncToVoice ? "bg-[#E58422]" : "bg-gray-300"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`absolute top-1 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${
                          item.syncToVoice ? "left-6" : "left-1"
                        }`}
                      />
                    </span>
                    <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${item.syncToVoice ? "text-[#E58422]" : "text-gray-400"}`}>
                      {item.syncToVoice ? "Live" : "Hidden"}
                    </span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => archiveFeedback(item)}
                    aria-label={`Archive feedback from ${item.name}`}
                    title="Archive"
                    className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-400 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600"
                  >
                    <Archive size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </DataCard>

      {surveyOpen && (
        <SurveyBuilderModal
          questions={questions}
          onCancel={() => setSurveyOpen(false)}
          onSave={saveSurvey}
        />
      )}

      {selectedResponse && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-[#10182f]/50 p-4"
          onClick={closeResponse}
        >
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="response-details-title"
            className="my-auto w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl"
            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <SectionLabel>Survey response</SectionLabel>
                <h3 id="response-details-title" className="mt-1 text-lg font-black text-[#19244E]">
                  {selectedResponse.name}
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-400">{selectedResponse.date}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Close response details"
                onClick={closeResponse}
                className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-4 text-sm italic leading-6 text-gray-700">
              “{selectedResponse.comment}”
            </p>

            <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-100 p-3">
                <dt className="font-bold text-gray-400">Rating</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-extrabold text-amber-500">
                  <Star size={12} fill="currentColor" />
                  {selectedResponse.rating}.0 / 5
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-100 p-3">
                <dt className="font-bold text-gray-400">Visit frequency</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">{selectedResponse.visitFrequency}</dd>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-100 p-3">
                <dt className="font-bold text-gray-400">Preference</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">{selectedResponse.preference}</dd>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-100 p-3">
                <dt className="font-bold text-gray-400">Visibility</dt>
                <dd className={`mt-1 font-extrabold ${selectedResponse.syncToVoice ? "text-[#E58422]" : "text-gray-500"}`}>
                  {selectedResponse.syncToVoice ? "Live" : "Hidden"}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>

            <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleFeedback(selectedResponse.id)}
                className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] transition hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                {selectedResponse.syncToVoice ? "Hide" : "Show"}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  archiveFeedback(selectedResponse);
                  closeResponse();
                }}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-300 px-3 text-sm font-bold text-rose-600 transition hover:bg-rose-50"
              >
                <Archive size={15} />
                Archive
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeResponse}
                className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#27376f]"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
const daysBefore = (date, days) => {
  const day = new Date(date);
  day.setDate(day.getDate() - days);
  return day;
};

// <input type="date"> gives "yyyy-mm-dd"; read it as a local date, not UTC.
const parseInputDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return null;
  const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
};

const formatDay = (date) =>
  date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });

const LOGS = SAMPLE_LOGS.map((log) => {
  const day = daysBefore(startOfToday(), log.daysAgo);
  return { ...log, day, date: formatDay(day) };
});

function rangeBounds(range, from, to) {
  const today = startOfToday();
  if (range === "today") return [today, today];
  if (range === "week") return [daysBefore(today, 6), today];
  if (range === "month") return [new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1), today];
  if (range === "custom") return [parseInputDate(from), parseInputDate(to)];
  return [null, null];
}

// Splits one page of records into day sections, newest first.
function groupByDay(logs) {
  const groups = [];
  logs.forEach((log) => {
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (last && last.date === log.date) last.logs.push(log);
    else groups.push({ date: log.date, logs: [log] });
  });
  return groups;
}

function ActionBadge({ type }) {
  const styles = {
    create: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800",
    update: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800",
    delete: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-800",
    security: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-800",
  };

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide ${
        styles[type] || "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"
      }`}
    >
      {type}
    </span>
  );
}

const chipClass = (active) =>
  `inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
    active
      ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
      : "border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
  }`;

const dateInputClass =
  "h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white px-3 text-sm text-slate-700 outline-none focus:border-orange-300 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50";

// Phones and tablets: two lines (action + item, user + time); tap to see the before/after values.
function LogCard({ log }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <li>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        className={`flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left transition ${open ? "bg-[#FFF3E7]/60" : "hover:bg-slate-50"}`}
      >
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-sm">
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{log.action}</span>
            <span className="text-slate-500"> · {log.itemAffected}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-400">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-600">{log.user}</span> · {log.time}
          </p>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown
          size={18}
          className={`shrink-0 text-slate-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
        />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="space-y-2 bg-[#FFF3E7]/60 px-4 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ActionBadge type={log.actionType} />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">ID: {log.itemId}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-5">
            <div className="break-words rounded-lg bg-white px-2 py-1 text-slate-600">
              <p className="font-sans text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">Previous</p>
              {log.previousValue}
            </div>
            <div className="break-words rounded-lg bg-white px-2 py-1 text-emerald-800">
              <p className="font-sans text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">New</p>
              {log.newValue}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

export default function AuditLogs() {
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState("all");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [range, setRange] = useState("all");
  const [from, setFrom] = useState("");
  const [to, setTo] = useState("");

  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const [start, end] = rangeBounds(range, from, to);

    return LOGS.filter((log) => {
      const matchesFilter = filterType === "all" || log.actionType === filterType;
      const inRange =
        (!start || log.day >= start) && (!end || log.day <= end);

      const searchableText = [
        log.action,
        log.actionType,
        log.itemAffected,
        log.itemId,
        log.user,
        log.date,
        log.time,
        log.previousValue,
        log.newValue,
      ]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();

      return matchesFilter && inRange && (!query || searchableText.includes(query));
    });
  }, [filterType, searchQuery, range, from, to]);

  const counts = useMemo(
    () =>
      FILTERS.reduce((result, filter) => {
        result[filter.id] =
          filter.id === "all"
            ? LOGS.length
            : LOGS.filter((log) => log.actionType === filter.id).length;
        return result;
      }, {}),
    []
  );

  const pager = usePagination(filteredLogs, [filterType, searchQuery, range, from, to]);
  const dayGroups = groupByDay(pager.pageItems);

  const pickRange = (value) => {
    setRange(value);
    setFrom("");
    setTo("");
  };

  const changeFrom = (value) => {
    setFrom(value);
    setRange(value || to ? "custom" : "all");
  };

  const changeTo = (value) => {
    setTo(value);
    setRange(value || from ? "custom" : "all");
  };

  const clearAll = () => {
    setSearchQuery("");
    setFilterType("all");
    pickRange("all");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-800">
      <PageHeader
        title="Security & Audit Logs"
        description="Sample records of admin changes, menu updates, and account events."
        actions={
          <div className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 sm:flex">
            <span className="relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
              <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-40" />
              <span className="relative inline-flex h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">Sample Data Active</span>
          </div>
        }
      />

      <StatGrid columns={3}>
        <StatCard label="Total Records" value={LOGS.length} sub="All sample audit records" icon={List} />
        <StatCard
          label="Record Types"
          value={new Set(LOGS.map((log) => log.actionType)).size}
          sub="Update, create, archive, security"
          icon={Layers}
        />
        <StatCard label="Matching Records" value={filteredLogs.length} sub="With the current filters" icon={Search} />
      </StatGrid>

      <DataCard
        title="Activity History"
        description="Search the user, action, affected item, or recorded values."
        bodyClassName="space-y-4 p-4 sm:p-6"
      >
        <div className="relative w-full lg:max-w-md">
          <Search
            size={16}
            className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
          />
          <input
            type="search"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(event) => setSearchQuery(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search action, item, or user..."
            aria-label="Search audit records"
            className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-[#F8F6F3] pl-10 pr-4 text-sm outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-orange-300 focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1" role="group" aria-label="Action type">
          {FILTERS.map((filter) => (
            <button
              key={filter.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterType(filter.id)}
              aria-pressed={filterType === filter.id}
              className={chipClass(filterType === filter.id)}
            >
              {filter.label}
              <span className="rounded-md bg-white/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                {counts[filter.id]}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-t border-[#EFEAE4] pt-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
          <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1" role="group" aria-label="Date range">
            {DATE_RANGES.map((option) => (
              <button
                key={option.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => pickRange(option.id)}
                aria-pressed={range === option.id}
                className={chipClass(range === option.id)}
              >
                {option.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 lg:w-80">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
              From
              <input
                type="date"
                value={from}
                max={to || undefined}
                onChange={(event) => changeFrom(event.target.value)}
                className={`mt-1 ${dateInputClass}`}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
              To
              <input
                type="date"
                value={to}
                min={from || undefined}
                onChange={(event) => changeTo(event.target.value)}
                className={`mt-1 ${dateInputClass}`}
              />
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DataCard>

      <DataCard
        title="Audit Trail"
        description="Previous and new values for each sample event"
        badge={
          <span className="rounded-lg bg-[#FFF3E7] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916]">
            {filteredLogs.length} {filteredLogs.length === 1 ? "record" : "records"}
          </span>
        }
        bodyClassName=""
        footer={filteredLogs.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="Audit record pages" />}
      >
        {filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Search}
            title="All quiet on the log front."
            message="Nothing matches this search, action or date range."
            action={
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearAll}
                className="min-h-11 px-3 text-sm font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700"
              >
                Clear search and filters
              </button>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="lg:hidden">
              {dayGroups.map((group) => (
                <section key={group.date}>
                  <h3 className="border-b border-[#EFEAE4] bg-[#F8F6F3] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                    {group.date}
                  </h3>
                  <ul className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4]">
                    {group.logs.map((log) => (
                      <LogCard key={log.id} log={log} />
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </section>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto lg:block">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-[#EAE5DF] bg-[#F8F6F3] text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Time &amp; User</th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Action</th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Item Affected</th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Previous State</th>
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">New State</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                {dayGroups.map((group) => (
                  <tbody key={group.date} className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4] border-b border-[#EFEAE4]">
                    <tr>
                      <th
                        colSpan={5}
                        scope="colgroup"
                        className="font-display bg-white px-6 pb-2 pt-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]"
                      >
                        {group.date}
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                    {group.logs.map((log) => (
                      <tr key={log.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                        <td className="px-6 py-3">
                          <p className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                            {log.time}
                          </p>
                          <p className="mt-1 whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
                            {log.user}
                          </p>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-6 py-3">
                          <div className="flex max-w-[220px] flex-col items-start gap-1.5">
                            <ActionBadge type={log.actionType} />
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold leading-5 text-slate-800">
                              {log.action}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        <td className="px-6 py-3">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">{log.itemAffected}</p>
                          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                            ID: {log.itemId}
                          </p>
                        </td>

                        <td className="max-w-[240px] bg-rose-50/30 px-6 py-3">
                          <p
                            title={log.previousValue}
                            className="max-w-[220px] truncate font-mono text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-600"
                          >
                            {log.previousValue}
                          </p>
                        </td>

                        <td className="max-w-[240px] bg-emerald-50/30 px-6 py-3">
                          <p
                            title={log.newValue}
                            className="max-w-[220px] truncate font-mono text-[11px] leading-5 text-emerald-800"
                          >
                            {log.newValue}
                          </p>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                ))}
              </table>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </DataCard>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
}

function Field({ label, value, onChange, placeholder }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className={labelClass}>{label}</label>
      <input
        className={inputClass}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function TextAreaField({ label, value, onChange, placeholder, rows = 4 }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className={labelClass}>{label}</label>
      <textarea
        className={inputClass + " resize-y"}
        rows={rows}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function SectionCard({ title, description, footer, children }) {
  return (

      title={title}
      description={description}
      footer={footer}
      bodyClassName="space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6"
    >
      {children}
    </DataCard>
  );
}

              <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                The Beardista Blend
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-600">
                Use this placeholder for the signature blend image.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-5">
            <Field
              label="Roast Profile"
              value={blend.roast}
              onChange={(value) => updateBlend("roast", value)}
              placeholder="Enter roast profile"
            />
            <TextAreaField
              label="Flavor Notes"
              value={blend.notes}
              onChange={(value) => updateBlend("notes", value)}
              placeholder="Describe the coffee's flavor notes"
              rows={3}
            />
            <Field
              label="Origin"
              value={blend.origin}
              onChange={(value) => updateBlend("origin", value)}
              placeholder="Enter coffee origin"
            />
          </div>
        </SectionCard>
      )}

      {activeTab === "team" && (
        <SectionCard
          title="Barista Team Roster"
          description="Manage team member profiles and the descriptions shown on public story pages."
          footer={team.length > 0 && <Pagination {...teamPager} label="Team member pages" />}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                Team Members
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                {team.length} member{team.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} in this local preview
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAddForm((current) => !current)}
              className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
            >
              {showAddForm ? "Cancel" : "+ Add Barista"}
            </button>
          </div>

          {showAddForm && (
            <form
              onSubmit={addMember}
              className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50/50 p-5"
            >
              <h3 className="font-bold text-[#19244E]">New Team Member</h3>
              <Field
                label="Name"
                value={newMember.name}
                onChange={(value) =>
                  setNewMember((current) => ({ ...current, name: value }))
                }
                placeholder="Enter team member name"
              />
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Role</label>
                <select
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={newMember.role}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setNewMember((current) => ({
                      ...current,
                      role: event.target.value
                    }))
                  }
                >
                  <option>Barista</option>
                  <option>Lead Barista</option>
                  <option>Full-time</option>
                  <option>Part-time</option>
                  <option>Senior Barista</option>
                  <option>Head Roaster</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <TextAreaField
                label="Description"
                value={newMember.description}
                onChange={(value) =>
                  setNewMember((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    description: value
                  }))
                }
                placeholder="Describe their role or specialty"
                rows={3}
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#273875]"
              >
                Add to Team Roster
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
            {teamPager.pageItems.map((member) => {
              const memberNumber = String(team.indexOf(member) + 1).padStart(2, "0");
              const badgeClass =
                "rounded-lg bg-[#FFF3E7] px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916]";
              const removeButtonClass =
                "min-h-11 rounded-lg px-2 text-sm font-bold text-gray-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600";
              const removeMember = () => {
                setTeam((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== member.id));
                setNotice("Team member removed from the local preview.");
              };

              return (
              <article
                key={member.id}
                className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] p-4 transition hover:border-orange-200 sm:p-5"
              >
                {/* Phones: photo, then badge + Remove, then name and role at full width. 640px and up: one row. */}
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:gap-4">
                  <ImagePlaceholder label="Team Photo" size="team" />

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:hidden">
                    <span className={badgeClass}>MEMBER {memberNumber}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={removeMember}
                      className={removeButtonClass}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${member.name}`}
                    >
                      Remove
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className={`hidden sm:inline-block ${badgeClass}`}>
                      MEMBER {memberNumber}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="break-normal text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:mt-2 sm:break-words sm:text-base">
                      {member.name}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">
                      {member.role}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={removeMember}
                    className={`hidden sm:block ${removeButtonClass}`}
                    aria-label={`Remove ${member.name}`}
                    title="Remove team member"
                  >
                    Remove
                  </button>
                </div>
                <TextAreaField
                  label="Description"
                  value={member.description}
                  onChange={(value) =>
                    setTeam((current) =>
                      current.map((item) =>
                        item.id === member.id
                          ? { ...item, description: value }
                          : item
                      )
                    )
                  }
                  placeholder="Enter a short team member description"
                  rows={3}
                />
              </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {team.length === 0 && (
            <EmptyState
              className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300"
              title="No baristas on the roster yet."
              message="Use Add Barista to introduce the crew behind the counter."
            />
          )}
        </SectionCard>
      )}

      {activeTab === "announcements" && (
        <AnnouncementsTab
          announcements={announcements}
          setAnnouncements={setAnnouncements}
          events={sampleEvents}
          menuItems={sampleMenuItems}
          notify={setNotice}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
