## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/pages/Events.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { CheckCircle2, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import ModalWrapper from "../components/ModalWrapper";
import { cancelButtonClass } from "../components/formStyles";
import EventsTab from "../components/events/EventsTab";
import EventViewModal from "../components/events/EventViewModal";
import ParticipantsTab from "../components/events/ParticipantsTab";
import FormsTab from "../components/events/FormsTab";
import EventFormModal from "../components/events/EventFormModal";
import {
  REGISTRATION_STATUS,
  eventPhase,
  eventPill,
  nextId,
  nowISO,
} from "../components/events/eventUtils";
import {
  events as sampleEvents,
  participant_types as sampleParticipantTypes,
  form_questions as sampleQuestions,
  registrations as sampleRegistrations,
  registration_answers as sampleAnswers,
} from "../data/eventsMockData";

const TABS = [
  { id: "events", label: "Events" },
  { id: "participants", label: "Participants" },
  { id: "forms", label: "Registration Forms" },
];

export default function Events() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [events, setEvents] = useState(sampleEvents);
  const [participantTypes, setParticipantTypes] = useState(sampleParticipantTypes);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState(sampleQuestions);
  const [registrations, setRegistrations] = useState(sampleRegistrations);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState(sampleAnswers);
  const [eventModal, setEventModal] = useState(null);
  const [viewId, setViewId] = useState(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  // The open tab and event live in the link (?tab=participants&event=1) so notifications can open them.
  const requestedTab = searchParams.get("tab");
  const tab = TABS.some((entry) => entry.id === requestedTab) ? requestedTab : "events";
  const linkedEvent = events.find((event) => String(event.id) === searchParams.get("event"));
  const nextUpcoming = events
    .filter((event) => eventPhase(event) !== "past")
    .sort((a, b) => a.event_date.localeCompare(b.event_date))[0];
  const formsEvent = linkedEvent ?? nextUpcoming ?? events[0];
  const viewEvent = events.find((event) => event.id === viewId);

  const openTab = (nextTab) =>
    setSearchParams(linkedEvent ? { tab: nextTab, event: String(linkedEvent.id) } : { tab: nextTab });

  const goTo = (nextTab, eventId) => setSearchParams({ tab: nextTab, event: String(eventId) });

  const setLinkedEvent = (id) =>
    setSearchParams(id === "all" ? { tab } : { tab, event: String(id) }, { replace: true });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!notice) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setNotice(""), 3500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [notice]);

  const saveEvent = (values) => {
    const editing = eventModal.event;

    if (editing) {
      setEvents((all) => all.map((event) => (event.id === editing.id ? { ...event, ...values } : event)));
      setNotice(`${values.title} was updated.`);
    } else {
      setEvents((all) => [...all, { ...values, id: nextId(all), status: "draft" }]);
      setNotice(`${values.title} was created as a draft. Set up its registration form next.`);
    }

    setEventModal(null);
  };

  const toggleRegistration = (target) => {
    const status = target.status === "open" ? "closed" : "open";
    setEvents((all) => all.map((event) => (event.id === target.id ? { ...event, status } : event)));
    setNotice(
      status === "open"
        ? `Registration is now open for ${target.title}.`
        : `Registration for ${target.title} is closed.`
    );
  };

  // Copies the event with its participant types and form questions (no registrations) as a draft.
  const duplicateEvent = (source) => {
    const eventId = nextId(events);
    let typeId = nextId(participantTypes);
    let questionId = nextId(questions);
    const typeIds = new Map();

    const copiedTypes = participantTypes
      .filter((type) => type.event_id === source.id)
      .map((type) => {
        typeIds.set(type.id, typeId);
        return { ...type, id: typeId++, event_id: eventId };
      });
    const copiedQuestions = questions
      .filter((question) => typeIds.has(question.participant_type_id))
      .map((question) => ({
        ...question,
        id: questionId++,
        participant_type_id: typeIds.get(question.participant_type_id),
        options: [...question.options],
      }));

    setEvents((all) => [...all, { ...source, id: eventId, title: `${source.title} (copy)`, status: "draft" }]);
    setParticipantTypes((all) => [...all, ...copiedTypes]);
    setQuestions((all) => [...all, ...copiedQuestions]);
    setNotice(`${source.title} was duplicated as a draft.`);
  };

  // Removes the event and everything linked to it in the sample data.
  const deleteEvent = (target) => {
    const typeIds = participantTypes.filter((type) => type.event_id === target.id).map((type) => type.id);
    const registrationIds = registrations.filter((entry) => entry.event_id === target.id).map((entry) => entry.id);

    setEvents((all) => all.filter((event) => event.id !== target.id));
    setParticipantTypes((all) => all.filter((type) => type.event_id !== target.id));
    setQuestions((all) => all.filter((question) => !typeIds.includes(question.participant_type_id)));
    setRegistrations((all) => all.filter((entry) => entry.event_id !== target.id));
    setAnswers((all) => all.filter((answer) => !registrationIds.includes(answer.registration_id)));
    if (linkedEvent?.id === target.id) setLinkedEvent("all");
    setDeleteTarget(null);
    setNotice(`${target.title} was deleted.`);
  };

  const changeRegistrationStatus = (registrationId, status) => {
    const person = registrations.find((entry) => entry.id === registrationId);
    setRegistrations((all) =>
      all.map((entry) => (entry.id === registrationId ? { ...entry, status } : entry))
    );
    setNotice(`${person?.name ?? "Participant"} is now ${REGISTRATION_STATUS[status].label.toLowerCase()}.`);
  };

  const resendCode = (registrationId) =>
    setRegistrations((all) =>
      all.map((entry) =>
        entry.id === registrationId ? { ...entry, verification_sent_at: nowISO() } : entry
      )
    );

  const deleteCount = deleteTarget
    ? registrations.filter((entry) => entry.event_id === deleteTarget.id).length
    : 0;

  const createButtonClass =
    "items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#d47414]";

  return (
    // On laptops the Events tab fills the screen under the top bar exactly, so the page never scrolls.
    <div
      className={
        tab === "events"
          ? "flex flex-col gap-4 lg:h-[calc(100dvh-7rem)] lg:min-h-[520px] lg:gap-3"
          : "space-y-6"
      }
    >
      <PageHeader
        title="Events & Throwdown Manager"
        description="Create events, build their registration forms, and manage who signed up."
        inlineActionsOnPhone
        actions={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setEventModal({ event: null })}
            className={`${createButtonClass} inline-flex h-11 shrink-0 gap-1 px-2.5 text-xs sm:hidden`}
          >
            <Plus size={14} />
            Create
          </button>
        }
      />

      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div
          role="tablist"
          aria-label="Events sections"
          className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 gap-1 rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-1 shadow-sm sm:inline-grid sm:w-auto"
        >
          {TABS.map((entry) => (
            <button
              key={entry.id}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={tab === entry.id}
              onClick={() => openTab(entry.id)}
              className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl px-2 text-xs font-bold transition sm:px-5 sm:text-sm lg:min-h-9 ${
                tab === entry.id
                  ? "bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                  : "text-gray-500 hover:text-[#19244E]"
              }`}
            >
              {entry.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setEventModal({ event: null })}
          className={`${createButtonClass} hidden min-h-11 gap-2 px-4 text-sm sm:inline-flex lg:min-h-10`}
        >
          <Plus size={17} />
          Create Event
        </button>
      </div>

      {tab === "events" && (
        <EventsTab
          events={events}
          participantTypes={participantTypes}
          registrations={registrations}
          onView={(event) => setViewId(event.id)}
          onEdit={(event) => setEventModal({ event })}
          onDuplicate={duplicateEvent}
          onDelete={setDeleteTarget}
        />
      )}

      {tab === "participants" && (
        <ParticipantsTab
          events={events}
          participantTypes={participantTypes}
          registrations={registrations}
          questions={questions}
          answers={answers}
          eventFilter={linkedEvent ? linkedEvent.id : "all"}
          onEventFilterChange={setLinkedEvent}
          onStatusChange={changeRegistrationStatus}
          onResendCode={resendCode}
        />
      )}

      {tab === "forms" && (
        <FormsTab
          events={events}
          participantTypes={participantTypes}
          questions={questions}
          registrations={registrations}
          selectedEvent={formsEvent}
          onSelectEvent={setLinkedEvent}
          setParticipantTypes={setParticipantTypes}
          setQuestions={setQuestions}
          notify={setNotice}
        />
      )}

      {viewEvent && (
        <EventViewModal
          event={viewEvent}
          pill={eventPill(viewEvent, participantTypes, registrations)}
          types={participantTypes.filter((type) => type.event_id === viewEvent.id)}
          registrations={registrations}
          onClose={() => setViewId(null)}
          onEdit={(event) => {
            setViewId(null);
            setEventModal({ event });
          }}
          onToggleRegistration={toggleRegistration}
          onOpenForm={(event) => {
            setViewId(null);
            goTo("forms", event.id);
          }}
          onOpenParticipants={(event) => {
            setViewId(null);
            goTo("participants", event.id);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {eventModal && (
        <EventFormModal
          event={eventModal.event}
          onCancel={() => setEventModal(null)}
          onSave={saveEvent}
        />
      )}

      {deleteTarget && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title="Delete this event?"
          description={`${deleteTarget.title} will be removed${
            deleteCount ? ` together with its ${deleteCount} registration${deleteCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""
          }. This only changes the preview.`}
          onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
          sheetOnPhone
          dismissible
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)} className={cancelButtonClass}>
              Keep
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => deleteEvent(deleteTarget)}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-rose-700"
            >
              Delete Event
            </button>
          </div>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}

      {notice && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="fixed bottom-5 left-4 right-4 z-[80] flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-xl sm:left-auto sm:max-w-sm"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="shrink-0 text-[#E58422]" />
          <span className="flex-1">{notice}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setNotice("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss notification"
            className="-mr-2 flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/pages/MenuManagement.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Search,
  Plus,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  Coffee,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  X,
  Store,
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper, { ToggleSwitch } from "../components/ModalWrapper";
import { cancelButtonClass } from "../components/formStyles";
import ItemModal from "../components/ItemModal";
import CategoryModal from "../components/CategoryModal";
import { categoryGroups, toSlug } from "../components/categoryUtils";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import StatCard, { StatGrid } from "../components/StatCard";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";
import Pagination from "../components/Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../components/usePageSize";
import { menu_items as sampleItems } from "../data/menuMockData";
import EmptyState from "../components/EmptyState";

const ALL_ITEMS = "All Items";

const [coffeeBar, nonCoffee, food] = categoryGroups;
const foodCategories = ["Savory Bites", "Pasta", "Rice", "Salad", "Extras"];
const nonCoffeeCategories = ["Zero-Proof", "Matcha"];

const initialCategories = [
  "Signatures",
  "Specialty Coffee",
  "Competition Artisans",
  "Milk Creations",
  "Zero-Proof",
  "Matcha",
  "Foam Series",
  "Bespokes",
  "Savory Bites",
  "Pasta",
  "Rice",
  "Salad",
  "Extras",
].map((name, index) => {
  const isFood = foodCategories.includes(name);

  return {
    name,
    slug: toSlug(name),
    priority: index + 1,
    description: "",
    group: isFood ? food : nonCoffeeCategories.includes(name) ? nonCoffee : coffeeBar,
    color: "#E58422",
    badge: isFood ? "food" : "coffee",
    iconImage: "",
    showOnMenu: true,
    status: "active",
  };
});

const catalogColumns =
  "lg:grid-cols-[minmax(220px,2fr)_minmax(120px,0.8fr)_100px_140px_100px]";

export default function MenuManagement() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(sampleItems);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState(initialCategories);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(ALL_ITEMS);
  const [storeOnline, setStoreOnline] = useState(true);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
  const [openMenuId, setOpenMenuId] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (openMenuId === null) return;

    const closeMenu = (event) => {
      if (event.type === "keydown" && event.key !== "Escape") return;
      if (event.type === "pointerdown" && event.target.closest("[data-row-menu]")) return;
      setOpenMenuId(null);
    };

    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeMenu);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", closeMenu);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeMenu);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", closeMenu);
    };
  }, [openMenuId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!modal) return;

    const closeOnEscape = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setModal(null);
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
  }, [modal]);

  // Archived items stay in state but leave the catalog and counts.
  const menuItems = items.filter((item) => !item.archived);
  const sortedCategories = [...categories].sort(
    (a, b) => a.priority - b.priority || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
  );
  const selectedCategory = categories.find((entry) => entry.name === category);

  const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filteredItems = menuItems.filter(
    (item) =>
      (category === ALL_ITEMS || item.category === category) &&
      (item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        item.description.toLowerCase().includes(query))
  );

  const pager = usePagination(filteredItems, [search, category]);
  const pageItems = pager.pageItems;

  const availableCount = storeOnline
    ? menuItems.filter((item) => item.available).length
    : 0;

  const notify = (message) => setNotice(message);
  const closeModal = () => setModal(null);

  const changeSearch = (value) => setSearch(value);
  const changeCategory = (value) => setCategory(value);

  const toggleItem = (id) =>
    setItems((current) =>
      current.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, available: !item.available } : item
      )
    );

  const editItem = (item) => {
    setOpenMenuId(null);
    setModal({ type: "item", item });
  };

  const deleteItem = (item) => {
    setOpenMenuId(null);
    setModal({ type: "delete", item });
  };

  const saveItem = (values) => {
    const editing = modal.item;

    if (editing) {
      setItems((current) =>
        current.map((item) => (item.id === editing.id ? { ...item, ...values } : item))
      );
      notify(`${values.name} was updated.`);
    } else {
      setItems((current) => [
        ...current,
        { id: Math.max(0, ...current.map((item) => item.id)) + 1, ...values },
      ]);
      notify(`${values.name} was added to the menu.`);
    }

    closeModal();
  };

  const archiveItem = () => {
    const { item: archived } = modal;
    setItems((current) =>
      current.map((item) => (item.id === archived.id ? { ...item, archived: true } : item))
    );
    notify(`${archived.name} was archived.`);
    closeModal();
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    const { item: removed } = modal;
    setItems((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== removed.id));
    notify(`${removed.name} was deleted.`);
    closeModal();
  };

  const saveCategory = (values) => {
    const editing = modal.category;

    if (editing) {
      setCategories((current) =>
        current.map((entry) => (entry.name === editing.name ? values : entry))
      );

      // A renamed category keeps its items and stays selected.
      if (values.name !== editing.name) {
        setItems((current) =>
          current.map((item) =>
            item.category === editing.name ? { ...item, category: values.name } : item
          )
        );
        if (category === editing.name) setCategory(values.name);
      }
    } else {
      setCategories((current) => [...current, values]);
    }

    if (values.status === "draft") notify(`${values.name} was saved as a draft.`);
    else notify(`${values.name} category was ${editing ? "updated" : "created"}.`);
    closeModal();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {notice && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex max-w-sm items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-xl"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="shrink-0 text-[#E58422]" />
          <span>{notice}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setNotice("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss notification"
            className="ml-1 rounded-lg p-1 hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal?.type === "item" && (
        <ItemModal
          item={modal.item}
          categories={sortedCategories.map((entry) => entry.name)}
          onCancel={closeModal}
          onSave={saveItem}
          onArchive={archiveItem}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === "category" && (
        <CategoryModal
          category={modal.category}
          existingNames={[ALL_ITEMS, ...categories.map((entry) => entry.name)].filter(
            (name) => name !== modal.category?.name
          )}
          defaultPriority={Math.max(0, ...categories.map((entry) => entry.priority)) + 1}
          onCancel={closeModal}
          onSave={saveCategory}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === "delete" && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title="Delete Item?"
          description={`${modal.item.name} will be removed from the sample menu list.`}
          onClose={closeModal}
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
            <button type="button" onClick={closeModal} className={cancelButtonClass}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={confirmDelete}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-rose-700"
            >
              Delete
            </button>
          </div>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}

      <PageHeader
        title="Menu Management"
        description="Manage menu categories, item details, and availability for Beardista Brew."
        actions={
        <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-3 sm:w-auto sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-stretch sm:justify-end">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white px-4 py-1.5 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]">
              <Store size={18} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">
                Global Availability
              </p>
              <p className={`mt-0.5 text-xs font-extrabold ${storeOnline ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-rose-600"}`}>
                {storeOnline ? "Store Online" : "Store Offline"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <ToggleSwitch
              checked={storeOnline}
              label="Toggle global store availability"
              onToggle={() => setStoreOnline((value) => !value)}
              className="ml-auto sm:ml-0"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:items-stretch">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setModal({ type: "category", category: null })}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] transition hover:border-[#E58422] hover:bg-orange-50 sm:px-4 sm:text-sm"
            >
              <Plus size={17} className="shrink-0 text-[#E58422]" />
              Add Category
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setModal({ type: "item", item: null })}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#cf7419] sm:px-4 sm:text-sm"
            >
              <Plus size={18} className="shrink-0" />
              Add New Item
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        }
      />

      {!storeOnline && (
        <section className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-amber-950">
              Global store availability is paused.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-800">
              All items show as unavailable while the store is offline.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setStoreOnline(true)}
            className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#253570] sm:self-auto"
          >
            Turn Store Online
          </button>
        </section>
      )}

      <StatGrid columns={2}>
        <StatCard
          label="Total Menu Items"
          value={menuItems.length}
          sub={`Across ${categories.length} categories`}
          icon={Coffee}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Available Items"
          value={`${availableCount} of ${menuItems.length}`}
          sub={storeOnline ? "Store online" : "Store offline"}
          icon={CircleCheck}
        />
      </StatGrid>

      <DataCard bodyClassName="space-y-3 p-4 sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex gap-2 sm:items-center">
          <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
            <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => changeSearch(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by item name or description..."
              aria-label="Search menu items"
              className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none transition focus:border-[#E58422] focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100 sm:h-10"
            />
            {search && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changeSearch("")}
                aria-label="Clear search"
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-lg p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700"
              >
                <X size={17} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowFilters((value) => !value)}
            aria-expanded={showFilters}
            aria-label="Filters"
            className={`inline-flex h-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-sm font-bold transition sm:h-10 ${showFilters ? "border-[#19244E] bg-[#19244E] text-white" : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal size={16} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Filters</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {showFilters && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-orange-50/50 px-3 py-2.5">
            <p className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E]">
              Availability filter
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-600">
              {availableCount} of {menuItems.length} items are available.
              Use the availability switches to change this local preview.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
            {[{ name: ALL_ITEMS }, ...sortedCategories].map((entry) => {
              const count =
                entry.name === ALL_ITEMS
                  ? menuItems.length
                  : menuItems.filter((menuItem) => menuItem.category === entry.name).length;
              const selected = category === entry.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={entry.name}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => changeCategory(entry.name)}
                  aria-pressed={selected}
                  className={`inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold transition sm:min-h-8 ${
                    selected
                      ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                      : "border-transparent bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-orange-50 hover:text-[#19244E]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {entry.color && (
                    <span
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: entry.color }}
                      className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full"
                    />
                  )}
                  {entry.name}
                  {entry.status === "draft" && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-400">
                      Draft
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="rounded-md bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                    {count}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {selectedCategory && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setModal({ type: "category", category: selectedCategory })}
              aria-label={`Edit ${selectedCategory.name} category`}
              title="Edit category"
              className="mb-1 flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-gray-500 transition hover:border-orange-200 hover:bg-orange-50 hover:text-[#E58422] sm:h-8 sm:w-8"
            >
              <Pencil size={15} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </DataCard>

      <DataCard
        title="Menu Catalog"
        badge={
          <span className="rounded-full bg-[#FFF3E7] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#B96916]">
            {filteredItems.length} {filteredItems.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"} found
          </span>
        }
        bodyClassName=""
        clip={false}
        footer={filteredItems.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="Catalog pages" />}
      >
        {filteredItems.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div className={`hidden gap-4 border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/80 px-6 py-2 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 lg:grid ${catalogColumns}`}>
              <span>Image & Item Name</span>
              <span>Category</span>
              <span>Price</span>
              <span className="text-center">Availability</span>
              <span className="text-right">Actions</span>
            </div>

            <ul className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {pageItems.map((item) => {
                const itemAvailable = storeOnline && item.available;
                const menuOpen = openMenuId === item.id;

                return (
                  <li
                    key={item.id}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 sm:gap-3 sm:px-6 lg:grid lg:gap-4 ${catalogColumns}`}
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => editItem(item)}
                      aria-label={`Edit ${item.name}`}
                      className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl text-left focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-200"
                    >
                      <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]">
                        {item.image ? (
                          <img src={item.image} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                        ) : (
                          <ImageIcon size={18} />
                        )}
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0">
                        <span className="block truncate text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                          {item.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-gray-500 lg:hidden">
                          {item.category} · ₱{item.price.toFixed(2)}
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 hidden truncate text-xs text-gray-500 lg:block">
                          {item.description}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    <div className="hidden lg:block">
                      <span className="inline-flex rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">
                        {item.category}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <span className="hidden font-black text-[#19244E] lg:block">
                      ₱{item.price.toFixed(2)}
                    </span>

                    <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
                      <ToggleSwitch
                        checked={item.available}
                        disabled={!storeOnline}
                        label={`Toggle ${item.name} availability`}
                        onToggle={() => toggleItem(item.id)}
                      />
                      <span className={`hidden w-16 text-[10px] font-bold lg:block ${itemAvailable ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-gray-500"}`}>
                        {itemAvailable ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="hidden justify-end gap-2 sm:flex">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title={`Edit ${item.name}`}
                        aria-label={`Edit ${item.name}`}
                        onClick={() => editItem(item)}
                        className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-2 text-gray-500 transition hover:border-orange-200 hover:bg-orange-50 hover:text-[#E58422]"
                      >
                        <Pencil size={16} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title={`Delete ${item.name}`}
                        aria-label={`Delete ${item.name}`}
                        onClick={() => deleteItem(item)}
                        className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-2 text-gray-500 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={16} />
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    <div data-row-menu className="relative shrink-0 sm:hidden">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setOpenMenuId(menuOpen ? null : item.id)}
                        aria-label={`More actions for ${item.name}`}
                        aria-haspopup="menu"
                        aria-expanded={menuOpen}
                        className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 ${menuOpen ? "bg-gray-100" : ""}`}
                      >
                        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-xl font-bold leading-none">⋮</span>
                      </button>

                      {menuOpen && (
                        <div
                          role="menu"
                          className="absolute right-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-40 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg"
                        >
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            role="menuitem"
                            onClick={() => editItem(item)}
                            className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] hover:bg-orange-50"
                          >
                            <Pencil size={16} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                            Edit
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            role="menuitem"
                            onClick={() => deleteItem(item)}
                            className="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={16} />
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            title={menuItems.length === 0 ? "The menu board is empty." : "Nothing on this shelf."}
            message={
              menuItems.length === 0
                ? "Add your first drink or dish with Add New Item."
                : "No items match this search or category."
            }
            action={
              menuItems.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    changeSearch("");
                    changeCategory(ALL_ITEMS);
                  }}
                  className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#253570]"
                >
                  Reset Search and Category
                </button>
              )
            }
          />
        )}
      </DataCard>
    </div>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/pages/MyAccount.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  CalendarClock,
  KeyRound,
  Mail,
  MailCheck,
  Pencil,
  ShieldCheck,
  UserRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "../components/ModalWrapper";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import OwnerAvatar from "../components/OwnerAvatar";
import { OWNER } from "../components/brandAssets";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

const initialAccount = {
  name: OWNER.name,
  email: OWNER.email,
  // A new email waits here until the confirmation code is entered.
  pendingEmail: "",
  role: OWNER.role,
  lastLogin: "Oct 22, 2026 · 8:14 AM",
};

const passwordFields = [
  { name: "current", label: "Current password", autoComplete: "current-password" },
  { name: "next", label: "New password", autoComplete: "new-password" },
  { name: "confirm", label: "Confirm new password", autoComplete: "new-password" },
];

const emptyForm = { current: "", next: "", confirm: "" };

const inputClass =
  "mt-1.5 h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 text-sm text-gray-800 outline-none transition focus:border-[#E58422] focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100";

const secondaryButtonClass =
  "min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600 transition hover:bg-gray-50";

export default function MyAccount() {
  const [account, setAccount] = useState(initialAccount);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({ name: "", email: "" });
  const [detailsError, setDetailsError] = useState("");
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

  const draftEmailChanged =
    draft.email.trim().toLowerCase() !== account.email.toLowerCase();

  const details = [
    { label: "Name", value: account.name, icon: UserRound },
    { label: "Email", value: account.email, icon: Mail, pending: account.pendingEmail },
    { label: "Role", value: account.role, icon: ShieldCheck, badge: true },
    { label: "Last login", value: account.lastLogin, icon: CalendarClock },
  ];

  const startEditing = () => {
    setDraft({ name: account.name, email: account.pendingEmail || account.email });
    setDetailsError("");
    setSuccess("");
    setEditing(true);
  };

  const cancelEditing = () => {
    setEditing(false);
    setDetailsError("");
  };

  const saveDetails = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = draft.name.trim();
    const email = draft.email.trim();

    if (!name) {
      setDetailsError("Enter your name.");
      return;
    }
    if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)) {
      setDetailsError("Enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }

    setAccount((current) => ({
      ...current,
      name,
      pendingEmail: draftEmailChanged ? email : "",
    }));
    setEditing(false);
    setSuccess(
      draftEmailChanged
        ? "We'll send a confirmation code to the new email. Your email changes once the code is entered. (Preview only, no email was sent.)"
        : "Account details updated. (Preview only, nothing was saved.)"
    );
  };

  const closeModal = () => {
    setModalOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setError("");
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!modalOpen) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") closeModal();
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [modalOpen]);

  const handleSubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const { current, next, confirm } = form;

    if (!current || !next || !confirm) {
      setError("Fill in all three password fields.");
      return;
    }
    if (current.length < 8) {
      setError("Current password must be at least 8 characters.");
      return;
    }
    if (next.length < 8) {
      setError("New password must be at least 8 characters.");
      return;
    }
    if (next !== confirm) {
      setError("New passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }
    if (next === current) {
      setError("New password must be different from your current one.");
      return;
    }

    closeModal();
    setSuccess("Password changed. (Preview only, nothing was saved.)");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="My Account"
        description="View and edit your account details, or change your password."
      />

      {success && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700"
        >
          {success}
        </p>
      )}

      <DataCard>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <OwnerAvatar className="h-12 w-12 text-sm sm:h-14 sm:w-14" />
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="truncate text-base font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:text-lg">
                {account.name}
              </h2>
              <p className="truncate text-xs text-gray-500 sm:text-sm">
                {account.email}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
            {!editing && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={startEditing}
                className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${secondaryButtonClass}`}
              >
                <Pencil size={16} className="hidden sm:block" />
                Edit Details
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSuccess("");
                setModalOpen(true);
              }}
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f]"
            >
              <KeyRound size={16} className="hidden sm:block" />
              Change Password
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {editing ? (
          <form onSubmit={saveDetails} noValidate className="mt-5 space-y-4 sm:mt-6">
            {detailsError && (
              <p
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700"
              >
                {detailsError}
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="account-name" className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                  Name
                </label>
                <input
                  id="account-name"
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="name"
                  value={draft.name}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }));
                    setDetailsError("");
                  }}
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="account-email" className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                  Email
                </label>
                <input
                  id="account-email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={draft.email}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, email: event.target.value }));
                    setDetailsError("");
                  }}
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {draftEmailChanged && (
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#19244E]">
                <MailCheck size={18} className="mt-0.5 hidden shrink-0 text-[#E58422] sm:block" />
                We'll send a confirmation code to the new email.
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
              <button type="button" onClick={cancelEditing} className={secondaryButtonClass}>
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
              >
                Save
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <dl className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:mt-6 sm:gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {details.map(({ label, value, icon: Icon, badge, pending }) => (
              <div key={label} className="min-w-0 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-3 sm:p-4">
                <dt className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
                  <Icon size={14} className="hidden sm:block" />
                  {label}
                </dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                  {badge ? (
                    <span
                      className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold ${
                        value === "Owner"
                          ? "bg-orange-50 text-[#E58422]"
                          : "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {value}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    value
                  )}
                  {pending && (
                    <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#E58422]">
                      Pending: {pending} (waiting for code)
                    </span>
                  )}
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {modalOpen && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title="Change password"
          description="Your new password needs at least 8 characters."
        >
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
            {error && (
              <p
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-rose-700"
              >
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            {passwordFields.map(({ name, label, autoComplete }) => (
              <div key={name}>
                <label
                  htmlFor={`password-${name}`}
                  className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]"
                >
                  {label}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`password-${name}`}
                  type="password"
                  autoComplete={autoComplete}
                  value={form[name]}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: event.target.value }));
                    setError("");
                  }}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>
            ))}

            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 pt-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
              <button type="button" onClick={closeModal} className={secondaryButtonClass}>
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#cf7419]"
              >
                Save Password
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { QRCodeCanvas } from "qrcode.react";
import {
  MapPin,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Save,
  CheckCircle2,
  Download,
  QrCode,
} from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";

const defaults = {
  storeName: "Beardista Brew",
  tagline: "Brewing Good Times, One Cup at a Time",
  address: "Caloocan City, Philippines",
  openingTime: "4:00 PM",
  closingTime: "12:00 AM",
  wifiSSID: "Beardista_Guest",
  wifiPass: "guestpassword123",
};

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#19244E] outline-none transition focus:border-[#E58422] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100";

const labelClass =
  "mb-1.5 block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500";

// The PNG is drawn at 640px and shown at 160px, so the download stays sharp when printed.
const QR_DOWNLOAD_SIZE = 640;

// Characters with a special meaning in the Wi-Fi QR format need a backslash in front.
const escapeWifi = (value) => value.replace(/([\\;,:"])/g, "\\$1");

const wifiQrText = (ssid, password) =>
  `WIFI:T:WPA;S:${escapeWifi(ssid)};P:${escapeWifi(password)};;`;

function Field({ id, label, value, onChange, placeholder, type = "text" }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <label htmlFor={id} className={labelClass}>{label}</label>
      <input
        id={id}
        type={type}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className={inputClass}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Settings() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(defaults);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(defaults);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [showWifi, setShowWifi] = useState(false);
  const qrRef = useRef(null);

  const update = (key, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setNotice("");
  };

  const saveSettings = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaved({ ...form });
    setNotice("Settings saved in this preview session only.");
  };

  const downloadQr = () => {
    const canvas = qrRef.current?.querySelector("canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;

    const link = document.createElement("a");
    const name = form.wifiSSID.trim().replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_") || "wifi";
    link.download = `${name}-wifi-qr.png`;
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    link.click();
  };

  const hasChanges = JSON.stringify(form) !== JSON.stringify(saved);
  const hasNetwork = form.wifiSSID.trim() !== "";
  const qrText = wifiQrText(form.wifiSSID, form.wifiPass);
  // Shown under the fields; the password stays hidden unless the eye toggle is on.
  const qrPreviewText = wifiQrText(
    form.wifiSSID,
    showWifi ? form.wifiPass : "•".repeat(Math.min(form.wifiPass.length, 12))
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="System & Store Settings"
        description="Configure store information and guest Wi-Fi details."
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 sm:items-end">
            <button
              type="submit"
              form="settings-form"
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
            >
              <Save size={17} /> Save All Settings
            </button>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
              {hasChanges ? "You have unsaved changes." : "All changes saved."}
            </p>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {notice && (
        <div role="status" className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-3 text-sm text-green-800">
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="shrink-0" />
          <p><strong>Preview saved.</strong> {notice}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <form id="settings-form" onSubmit={saveSettings} className="space-y-6">
        <DataCard
          title="Café Brand & Physical Location"
          description="Store identity and operating hours shown to customers."
          bodyClassName="space-y-4 p-4 sm:p-6"
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field id="store-name" label="Store Name" value={form.storeName} onChange={(v) => update("storeName", v)} />
            <Field id="store-tagline" label="Tagline / Concept" value={form.tagline} onChange={(v) => update("tagline", v)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="store-address" className={labelClass}><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><MapPin size={14} /> Branch Street Address</span></label>
            <input id="store-address" value={form.address} onChange={(e) => update("address", e.target.value)} className={inputClass} />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Field id="store-opening" label="Opening Time" value={form.openingTime} onChange={(v) => update("openingTime", v)} placeholder="4:00 PM" />
            <Field id="store-closing" label="Closing Time" value={form.closingTime} onChange={(v) => update("closingTime", v)} placeholder="12:00 AM" />
          </div>
        </DataCard>

        <DataCard
          title="Guest Wi-Fi"
          description="Customers scan the QR code to join the guest network."
        >
          <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto]">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <Field id="wifi-ssid" label="Network Name (SSID)" value={form.wifiSSID} onChange={(v) => update("wifiSSID", v)} />
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="wifi-password" className={labelClass}>Wi-Fi Password</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    id="wifi-password"
                    type={showWifi ? "text" : "password"}
                    value={form.wifiPass}
                    onChange={(e) => update("wifiPass", e.target.value)}
                    className={`${inputClass} pr-12 font-mono`}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={showWifi ? "Hide Wi-Fi password" : "Show Wi-Fi password"}
                    aria-pressed={showWifi}
                    onClick={() => setShowWifi(!showWifi)}
                    className="absolute right-0.5 top-1/2 flex h-11 w-11 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-200"
                  >
                    {showWifi ? <EyeOff size={17} /> : <Eye size={17} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2">
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">QR code text</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 break-all font-mono text-xs text-[#19244E]">{qrPreviewText}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 md:w-44">
              <p className="self-start text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 md:self-center">
                Live Preview
              </p>

              {hasNetwork ? (
                <div
                  ref={qrRef}
                  className="rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-2"
                >
                  <QRCodeCanvas
                    value={qrText}
                    size={QR_DOWNLOAD_SIZE}
                    marginSize={2}
                    level="M"
                    fgColor="#19244E"
                    bgColor="#FFFFFF"
                    title={`Wi-Fi QR code for ${form.wifiSSID}`}
                    style={{ width: 144, height: 144 }}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex aspect-square w-40 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7]/50 p-3 text-center">
                  <QrCode size={32} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">QR appears here</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Enter a network name first.</p>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={downloadQr}
                disabled={!hasNetwork}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-40 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#29386f] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <Download size={15} /> Download PNG
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DataCard>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
