## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/pages/UserManagement.jsx

```
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { CircleCheck, Crown, MailCheck, UserX, Users } from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import StatCard, { StatGrid } from "../components/StatCard";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";
import Pagination from "../components/Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../components/usePageSize";
import EmptyState from "../components/EmptyState";

const INITIAL_USERS = [
  { id: 1, name: "Jim Carlo Gorospe", email: "founder@beardistabrew.com", role: "Owner", status: "Active", lastLogin: "Oct 16, 2026 · 09:42 AM" },
  { id: 2, name: "Ben Cabazeres", email: "admin@beardistabrew.com", role: "Admin", status: "Active", lastLogin: "Oct 16, 2026 · 08:15 AM" },
  { id: 3, name: "Gab Evora", email: "barista.lead@beardistabrew.com", role: "Admin", status: "Active", lastLogin: "Oct 15, 2026 · 05:30 PM" },
  { id: 4, name: "Jahnyne Galindez", email: "dave.tan@beardistabrew.com", role: "Admin", status: "Suspended", lastLogin: "Sep 28, 2026 · 02:10 PM" },
];

// New accounts are always Staff and stay Pending until the confirmation code is used.
const emptyForm = {
  firstName: "",
  lastName: "",
  email: "",
  role: "Staff",
  status: "Pending",
  password: "",
};

const ROLE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "Owner", label: "Owner Admin" },
  { value: "Admin", label: "Store Admin" },
  { value: "Staff", label: "Staff / Employee" },
];

const fieldClass =
  "mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3.5 py-3 font-normal outline-none focus:border-orange-300 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50";

const initials = (name) =>
  name
    .split(" ")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const styles = {
    Active: ["bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700", "bg-emerald-500"],
    Pending: ["bg-amber-50 text-amber-700", "bg-amber-500"],
    Suspended: ["bg-rose-50 text-rose-700", "bg-rose-500"],
  };
  const [badge, dot] = styles[status] ?? styles.Suspended;

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${badge}`}>
      <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dot}`} />
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}

function RoleBadge({ role }) {
  const styles = {
    Owner: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700",
    Admin: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700",
    Staff: "bg-orange-50 text-orange-700",
  };

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${styles[role] ?? styles.Staff}`}>
      {role}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function UserManagement() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState(INITIAL_USERS);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("All");
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [codeSentTo, setCodeSentTo] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState("");
  const [revokeUser, setRevokeUser] = useState(null);

  const editing = editingId !== null;
  const activeCount = users.filter((user) => user.status === "Active").length;
  const suspendedCount = users.filter((user) => user.status === "Suspended").length;
  const roleCount = (role) => users.filter((user) => user.role === role).length;

  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return users.filter((user) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !term ||
        user.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        user.email.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        user.role.toLowerCase().includes(term);

      const matchesFilter =
        filter === "All" ||
        (filter === "Suspended"
          ? user.status === "Suspended"
          : user.role === filter);

      return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
    });
  }, [users, search, filter]);

  const pager = usePagination(filteredUsers, [search, filter]);
  const pageUsers = pager.pageItems;

  function notify(message) {
    setToast(message);
    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(""), 2600);
  }

  function changeSearch(value) {
    setSearch(value);
  }

  function changeFilter(value) {
    setFilter(value);
  }

  function openAddDrawer() {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setFormError("");
    setShowPassword(false);
    setCodeSentTo(null);
    setDrawerOpen(true);
  }

  function openEditDrawer(user) {
    const parts = user.name.split(" ");
    setEditingId(user.id);
    setForm({
      firstName: parts.shift() || "",
      lastName: parts.join(" "),
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      status: user.status,
      password: "",
    });
    setFormError("");
    setShowPassword(false);
    setCodeSentTo(null);
    setDrawerOpen(true);
  }

  function updateField(field, value) {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
  }

  function generateDemoPassword() {
    const demoPassword = "Demo-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) + "!26";
    updateField("password", demoPassword);
    setShowPassword(true);
    notify("Demo password generated locally.");
  }

  async function copyDemoPassword() {
    if (!form.password) {
      setFormError("Generate a demo password first.");
      return;
    }

    // This preview intentionally does not access the system clipboard.
    notify("Demo password selected. Copying is disabled in this preview.");
  }

  function saveUser(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setFormError("");

    const firstName = form.firstName.trim();
    const lastName = form.lastName.trim();
    const email = form.email.trim();

    if (!firstName || !lastName || !email) {
      setFormError("Please complete the first name, last name, and email.");
      return;
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      setFormError("Please enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }

    const duplicateEmail = users.some(
      (user) =>
        user.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase() &&
        user.id !== editingId
    );

    if (duplicateEmail) {
      setFormError("This email already exists in the demo directory.");
      return;
    }

    const fullName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim();

    if (editing) {
      setUsers((current) =>
        current.map((user) =>
          user.id === editingId
            ? { ...user, name: fullName, email, role: form.role, status: form.status }
            : user
        )
      );
      notify("Demo user updated locally.");
      setDrawerOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    const newUser = {
      id: Date.now(),
      name: fullName,
      email,
      role: "Staff",
      status: "Pending",
      lastLogin: "Never",
    };
    setUsers((current) => [newUser, ...current]);
    // UI only: no email is sent. The drawer switches to the confirmation step.
    setCodeSentTo(email);
  }

  function confirmRevoke() {
    if (!revokeUser) return;

    setUsers((current) => current.filter((user) => user.id !== revokeUser.id));
    setRevokeUser(null);
    notify("Demo user removed from this preview.");
  }

  const filters = [
    { label: "All Users", value: "All", count: users.length },
    { label: "Owner", value: "Owner", count: roleCount("Owner") },
    { label: "Admin", value: "Admin", count: roleCount("Admin") },
    { label: "Staff", value: "Staff", count: roleCount("Staff") },
    { label: "Suspended", value: "Suspended", count: suspendedCount },
  ];

  const drawerTitle = codeSentTo ? "Staff Added" : editing ? "Edit User" : "Add New Staff";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-800">
      <PageHeader
        title="User Management"
        description="Manage administrative personnel, assign roles, and review account status."
        actions={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={openAddDrawer}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#F28A28] px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#DD7517] focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-100"
          >
            <span className="text-lg leading-none">+</span>
            Add New Staff
          </button>
        }
      />

      <StatGrid>
        <StatCard label="Total Users" value={users.length} sub="Listed in this demo directory" icon={Users} />
        <StatCard label="Active Accounts" value={activeCount} sub="Currently marked active" icon={CircleCheck} />
        <StatCard label="Suspended" value={suspendedCount} sub="Currently marked suspended" icon={UserX} />
        <StatCard label="Owner Accounts" value={roleCount("Owner")} sub="Owner role in the demo" icon={Crown} />
      </StatGrid>

      <DataCard
        bodyClassName=""
        footer={filteredUsers.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="User pages" />}
      >
        <div className="border-b border-[#EFEAE4] p-3 sm:p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                Administrative Directory
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-slate-500">
                Search, filter, and manage the sample user records.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full lg:max-w-sm">
              <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400">
                ⌕
              </span>
              <input
                type="search"
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => changeSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search name, email, or role..."
                aria-label="Search users"
                className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-orange-300 focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50 sm:h-10"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
            {filters.map((item) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={item.value}
                onClick={() => changeFilter(item.value)}
                aria-pressed={filter === item.value}
                className={`inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-sm font-semibold transition sm:min-h-9 ${
                  filter === item.value
                    ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                    : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50"
                }`}
              >
                {item.label}
                <span
                  className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs ${
                    filter === item.value
                      ? "bg-white/80 text-[#B96916]"
                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.count}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Users}
            title={users.length === 0 ? "It's quiet behind the counter." : "No one by that name here."}
            message={users.length === 0 ? "Add your first staff member to get started." : "Try another search term or filter."}
            action={
              users.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { changeSearch(""); changeFilter("All"); }}
                  className="min-h-11 px-3 text-sm font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700"
                >
                  Clear search and filters
                </button>
              )
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Below xl: stacked cards instead of a wide table. */}
            <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100 xl:hidden">
              {pageUsers.map((user) => (
                <li key={user.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="hidden h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-orange-50 text-sm font-extrabold text-[#A95012] sm:flex">
                    {initials(user.name)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate font-bold text-[#19244E]">{user.name}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{user.email}</p>
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                      <RoleBadge role={user.role} />
                      <StatusBadge status={user.status} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-1.5 sm:flex-row">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openEditDrawer(user)}
                      className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700"
                    >
                      Edit
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setRevokeUser(user)}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${user.name} from the demo`}
                      className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50"
                    >
                      Remove
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>

            <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto xl:block">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50/80 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Name</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Email Address</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Role</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Status</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Last Login</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {pageUsers.map((user) => (
                    <tr key={user.id} className="transition hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                      <td className="px-6 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-orange-50 text-sm font-extrabold text-[#A95012]">
                            {initials(user.name)}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-bold text-[#19244E]">{user.name}</p>
                            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-400">
                              ID: USR-{String(user.id).slice(-4).padStart(4, "0")}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600">{user.email}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3"><RoleBadge role={user.role} /></td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3"><StatusBadge status={user.status} /></td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500">{user.lastLogin}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => openEditDrawer(user)}
                            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700"
                          >
                            Edit
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setRevokeUser(user)}
                            aria-label={`Remove ${user.name} from the demo`}
                            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50"
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {toast && (
        <div role="status" className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-[70] max-w-sm rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-xl">
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}

      {drawerOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Close user form"
            onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
            className="absolute inset-0 cursor-default bg-slate-950/40 backdrop-blur-[2px]"
          />

          <aside
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="user-drawer-title"
            className="relative flex h-full w-full max-w-xl flex-col bg-white shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-8">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-orange-600">
                  User Directory
                </p>
                <h2 id="user-drawer-title" className="mt-1 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:text-2xl">
                  {drawerTitle}
                </h2>
                {!codeSentTo && (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {editing
                      ? "Update the fields for this local demo record."
                      : "New accounts are created as Staff / Employee."}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Close"
                className="-mr-2 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-xl text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                ×
              </button>
            </div>

            {codeSentTo ? (
              <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <div role="status" className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-10 text-center sm:px-8">
                  <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600">
                    <MailCheck size={26} />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mt-4 break-words text-lg font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                    Confirmation code sent to {codeSentTo}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
                    The new staff member enters this code to confirm their email.
                    Their account shows as <strong className="text-amber-700">Pending</strong> until then.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 sm:px-8">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => notify(`Code resent to ${codeSentTo}.`)}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    Resend Code
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#F28A28] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#DD7517]"
                  >
                    Done
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={saveUser} className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-5 sm:px-8">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">Personal Information</h3>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Enter the name and email for the directory.</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      First Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                      <input
                        required
                        value={form.firstName}
                        onChange={(event) => updateField("firstName", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Jamie"
                        className={fieldClass}
                      />
                    </label>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      Last Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                      <input
                        required
                        value={form.lastName}
                        onChange={(event) => updateField("lastName", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Santos"
                        className={fieldClass}
                      />
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Email Address <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                    <input
                      required
                      type="email"
                      value={form.email}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("email", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="name@beardistabrew.com"
                      className={fieldClass}
                    />
                  </label>

                  {editing ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-5">
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">Role & Access</h3>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">These selections are visual demo settings only.</p>
                      </div>

                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        Assigned Role
                        <select
                          value={form.role}
                          onChange={(event) => updateField("role", event.target.value)}
                          className={`${fieldClass} bg-white`}
                        >
                          {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                            <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </label>

                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Account Status</p>
                        {form.status === "Pending" && (
                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-amber-700">
                            Waiting for the confirmation code. Pick a status to change it.
                          </p>
                        )}
                        <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                          {["Active", "Suspended"].map((status) => (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              key={status}
                              onClick={() => updateField("status", status)}
                              aria-pressed={form.status === status}
                              className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl border px-4 text-sm font-bold transition ${
                                form.status === status
                                  ? status === "Active"
                                    ? "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-2 ring-emerald-100"
                                    : "border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 ring-2 ring-rose-100"
                                  : "border-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {status === "Active" ? "✓ " : "⊘ "}{status}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Role</p>
                        <RoleBadge role="Staff" />
                      </div>

                      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                          <div>
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">Temporary Password Demo</h3>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                              Generates sample text only. It does not create credentials.
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <span className="rounded-lg bg-amber-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-800">
                            Demo
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                          <input
                            type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                            value={form.password}
                            onChange={(event) => updateField("password", event.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Generate sample password"
                            autoComplete="off"
                            aria-label="Temporary password"
                            className="min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-300"
                          />
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setShowPassword((current) => !current)}
                            className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                          >
                            {showPassword ? "Hide" : "Show"}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={generateDemoPassword}
                            className="min-h-11 rounded-lg bg-[#19244E] px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#26356B] sm:min-h-9"
                          >
                            Generate Sample
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={copyDemoPassword}
                            className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 sm:min-h-9"
                          >
                            Copy (Preview)
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}

                  {formError && (
                    <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-rose-700">
                      {formError}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 sm:px-8">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                    className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl bg-[#F28A28] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#DD7517]"
                  >
                    {editing ? "Save Changes" : "Save Staff"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}

      {revokeUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/45 p-4">
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="remove-user-title"
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 text-xl text-rose-600">
              !
            </div>
            <h2 id="remove-user-title" className="mt-4 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
              Remove demo user?
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
              <strong className="text-slate-700">{revokeUser.name}</strong> will
              be removed from this preview's temporary list. This does not
              revoke or change any real account.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRevokeUser(null)}
                className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={confirmRevoke}
                className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-rose-700"
              >
                Remove from Preview
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import React from "react";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import {
  HashRouter,
  Routes,
  Route,
  Navigate,
  Link,
} from "react-router-dom";

import "../../index.css";
import "./admin.css";
import AdminLayout from "./layout/AdminLayout";
import AdminDashboard from "./pages/AdminDashboard";
import MenuManagement from "./pages/MenuManagement";
import Analytics from "./pages/Analytics";
import ContentManagement from "./pages/ContentManagement";
import UserManagement from "./pages/UserManagement";
import AuditLogs from "./pages/AuditLogs";
import Events from "./pages/Events";
import Settings from "./pages/Settings";
import AdminLogin from "./pages/AdminLogin";
import MyAccount from "./pages/MyAccount";

const sections = [
  {
    path: "/admin/menu-management",
    title: "Menu Management",
    description: "Manage and organize the cafÃ© menu.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/analytics",
    title: "Analytics",
    description: "Review cafÃ© performance and business insights.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/content-management",
    title: "Content Management",
    description: "Manage the content displayed across the cafÃ© system.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/user-management",
    title: "User Management",
    description: "View and manage system user information.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/audit-logs",
    title: "Audit Logs",
    description: "Review a record of system activities.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/events",
    title: "Events",
    description: "Organize and review cafÃ© events.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/settings",
    title: "Settings",
    description: "Review administrator settings.",
  },
];

function PlaceholderPage({ title, description }) {
  return (
    <AdminLayout activePage={title}>
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#E58422]">
            ADMIN WORKSPACE
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:text-3xl">
            {title}
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">{description}</p>
        </div>

        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8">
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center py-8 text-center">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-orange-50 text-2xl">
              â˜•
            </div>
            <h2 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-[#19244E]">
              Page ready for development
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">
              Routing is working. The actual {title.toLowerCase()} features
              have not been implemented in this preview yet.
            </p>
            <Link
              to="/admin/dashboard"
              className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f]"
            >
              Return to Dashboard
            </Link>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}

function NotFoundPage() {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-[#F8F6F3] px-5">
      <div className="max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-8 text-center shadow-sm">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#E58422]">404 ERROR</p>
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
          Page not found
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">
          This URL does not match a page in the admin preview.
        </p>
        <Link
          to="/admin/dashboard"
          className="mt-6 inline-flex rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#27376f]"
        >
          Go to Dashboard
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AdminRebuildApp() {
  return (
    <HashRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/admin/dashboard" replace />} />
        <Route path="/admin" element={<Navigate to="/admin/dashboard" replace />} />
        <Route path="/admin/login" element={<AdminLogin />} />
        <Route
          path="/admin/dashboard"
          element={
            <AdminLayout activePage="Dashboard">
              <AdminDashboard />
            </AdminLayout>
          }
        />
        <Route
          path="/admin/account"
          element={
            <AdminLayout activePage="My Account">
              <MyAccount />
            </AdminLayout>
          }
        />


        {sections.map((section) => (
          <Route
            key={section.path}
            path={section.path}
          element={
  section.path === "/admin/menu-management" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Menu Management">
      <MenuManagement />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/analytics" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Analytics">
      <Analytics />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/content-management" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Content Management">
      <ContentManagement />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/user-management" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="User Management">
      <UserManagement />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/audit-logs" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Audit Logs">
      <AuditLogs />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/events" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Events">
      <Events />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/settings" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Settings">
      <Settings />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : (
    <PlaceholderPage
      title={section.title}
      description={section.description}
    />
  )
            }
          />

        ))}
      </Routes>
    </HashRouter>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <AdminRebuildApp />
  </React.StrictMode>
);
```

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Event Registration Confirmation</title>
</head>
<body style="margin: 0; padding: 0; background-color: #131826; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;">

  <!-- Outer Dark Background Container -->
  <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" border="0" style="background-color: #131826; min-height: 100vh; padding: 40px 20px;">
    <tr>
      <td align="center" valign="middle">
        
        <!-- Main Card Container -->
        <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" border="0" style="max-width: 440px; background-color: #FAF8F5; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);">
          <tr>
            <td style="padding: 40px 32px; text-align: center;">
              
              <!-- Icon Container -->
              <div style="margin: 0 auto 16px auto; width: 56px; height: 56px; background-color: #131826; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; line-height: 56px;">
                <!-- Event / Ticket Checkmark Icon -->
                <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#EF5A24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="vertical-align: middle; display: inline-block;">
                  <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
                  <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
                </svg>
              </div>

              <!-- Registration Badge Pill -->
              <div style="display: inline-block; background-color: #FFF2EC; border: 1px solid #FFDACB; border-radius: 20px; padding: 4px 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                <span style="color: #EF5A24; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; display: block;">
                  ✦ EVENT REGISTRATION
                </span>
              </div>

              <!-- Title -->
              <h1 style="color: #131826; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 12px 0; letter-spacing: -0.3px;">
                Registration Confirmed!
              </h1>

              <!-- Message Body -->
              <p style="color: #64748B; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 24px 0;">
                Thank you for registering for our upcoming event.<br><br>
                Please verify your email address and finalize your registration by clicking the button below:
              </p>

              <!-- Primary Action Button (Beardista Orange) -->
              <div style="margin-bottom: 24px;">
                <a href="{{verify_link}}" style="background-color: #EF5A24; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 10px; display: block; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(239, 90, 36, 0.25); transition: background-color 0.2s ease;">
                  Verify Email & Confirm Registration &rarr;
                </a>
              </div>

              <!-- Footer Sign-off -->
              <p style="color: #94A3B8; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #E2E8F0;">
                See you there!
              </p>

            </td>
          </tr>
        </table>

      </td>
    </tr>
```

## beardista-brew/supabase/functions/event-code/index.ts

```
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
    "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
};

type RegisterRequest = {
  action: "register";
  eventId: number;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
  phone?: string | null;
};

type VerifyRequest = {
  action: "verify";
  registrationId: string;
  code: string;
};

type RegistrationResult = {
  id: string;
  eventId: number;
  userEmail: string;
  fullName: string;
};

type VerificationResult = RegistrationResult & {
  eventTitle: string;
  status: "confirmed" | "waitlisted";
};

function jsonResponse(body: Record<string, unknown>, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function getRequiredSecret(name: string) {
  const value = Deno.env.get(name);
  if (!value) throw new Error(`Missing required Edge Function secret: ${name}`);
  return value;
}

function createVerificationCode() {
  const range = 0x1_0000_0000;
  const limit = range - (range % 1_000_000);
  const values = new Uint32Array(1);
  do {
    crypto.getRandomValues(values);
  } while (values[0] >= limit);
  return (values[0] % 1_000_000).toString().padStart(6, "0");
}

function escapeHtml(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => {
    const entities: Record<string, string> = {
      "&": "&amp;",
      "<": "&lt;",
      ">": "&gt;",
      '"': "&quot;",
      "'": "&#39;",
    };
    return entities[character];
  });
}

async function sendBrevoEmail(
  email: string,
  name: string,
  subject: string,
  htmlContent: string,
) {
  const apiKey = getRequiredSecret("BREVO_API_KEY");
  const senderEmail = getRequiredSecret("BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL");
  const senderName = Deno.env.get("BREVO_SENDER_NAME") ?? "Beardista Brew";

  const response = await fetch("https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      accept: "application/json",
      "api-key": apiKey,
      "content-type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      sender: { email: senderEmail, name: senderName },
      to: [{ email, name }],
      subject,
      htmlContent,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error("Brevo email delivery failed", response.status);
    throw new Error("Email delivery failed");
  }
}

function isValidEmail(email: unknown): email is string {
  return (
    typeof email === "string" &&
    email.length <= 254 &&
    /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)
  );
}

async function register(request: RegisterRequest, supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>) {
  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(request.eventId) ||
    request.eventId <= 0 ||
    !isValidEmail(request.email) ||
    typeof request.fullName !== "string" ||
    request.fullName.trim().length < 1 ||
    request.fullName.length > 200 ||
    (request.phone != null &&
      (typeof request.phone !== "string" || request.phone.length > 40))
  ) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Valid event, email, name, and phone are required." }, 400);
  }

  const code = createVerificationCode();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("create_event_registration", {
    p_event_id: request.eventId,
    p_user_email: request.email.trim(),
    p_full_name: request.fullName.trim(),
    p_phone: request.phone?.trim() || null,
    p_verification_code: code,
  });

  if (error) {
    if (error.code === "55000") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: error.message }, 429);
    }
    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: "This email is already registered for the event." }, 409);
    }
    if (error.code === "P0002") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: "This event is not open for registration." }, 404);
    }
    console.error("Could not create event registration", error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Could not create the event registration." }, 500);
  }

  const registration = data as RegistrationResult;
  try {
    await sendBrevoEmail(
      registration.userEmail,
      registration.fullName,
      "Verify your Beardista Brew event registration",
      `<p>Hello ${escapeHtml(registration.fullName)},</p><p>Your verification code is <strong>${code}</strong>.</p><p>Enter this code to complete your event registration.</p>`,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not send event verification email", error);
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        error: "Registration was saved, but the verification email could not be sent. Please retry.",
        registrationId: registration.id,
      },
      502,
    );
  }

  return jsonResponse({
    registrationId: registration.id,
    status: "pending",
    message: "Verification code sent.",
  });
}

async function verify(request: VerifyRequest, supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>) {
  if (
    typeof request.registrationId !== "string" ||
    !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(
      request.registrationId,
    ) ||
    typeof request.code !== "string" ||
    !/^\d{6}$/.test(request.code)
  ) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "A valid registration ID and six-digit code are required." }, 400);
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("verify_event_registration", {
    p_registration_id: request.registrationId,
    p_verification_code: request.code,
  });

  if (error) {
    if (error.code === "P0002") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: "Registration not found." }, 404);
    }
    if (error.code === "22023") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: error.message }, 400);
    }
    console.error("Could not verify event registration", error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Could not verify the event registration." }, 500);
  }

  const registration = data as VerificationResult;
  if ("error" in registration) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: registration.error }, 400);
  }

  try {
    const statusMessage =
      registration.status === "confirmed"
        ? "Your registration is confirmed."
        : "The event is at capacity. You have been added to the waitlist.";
    await sendBrevoEmail(
      registration.userEmail,
      registration.fullName,
      `Your ${registration.eventTitle} registration`,
      `<p>Hello ${escapeHtml(registration.fullName)},</p><p>${escapeHtml(statusMessage)}</p>`,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not send event confirmation email", error);
    return jsonResponse(
      { error: "Registration verified, but the confirmation email could not be sent." },
      502,
    );
  }

  return jsonResponse({
    registrationId: registration.id,
    status: registration.status,
    message:
      registration.status === "confirmed"
        ? "Registration confirmed."
        : "Registration verified and added to the waitlist.",
  });
}

Deno.serve(async (request: Request) => {
  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }
  if (request.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Method not allowed." }, 405);
  }

  let body: RegisterRequest | VerifyRequest;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Request body must be valid JSON." }, 400);
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createClient(
      getRequiredSecret("SUPABASE_URL"),
      getRequiredSecret("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"),
      { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } },
    );

    if (body.action === "register") return await register(body, supabase);
    if (body.action === "verify") return await verify(body, supabase);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Unsupported action." }, 400);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Event verification function failed", error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Event registration service is unavailable." }, 500);
  }
});

```

## beardista-brew/supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql

```
-- Tables and unique constraints for Beardista Brew

create table if not exists categories (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  name text not null,
  sort_order int default 0,
  constraint categories_name_key unique (name)
);

create table if not exists items (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  slug text unique,
  category_id bigint references categories(id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  description text,
  price numeric(10,2) not null,
  image_url text,
  flavor_profile text[] default '{}',
  contains text,
  details jsonb default '{}',
  is_available boolean default true,
  is_featured boolean default false,
  sort_order int default 0,
  constraint items_category_name_key unique (category_id, name)
);

create table if not exists events (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  tag text,
  title text not null,
  description text,
  button_label text,
  image_url text,
  details jsonb default '{}',
  is_active boolean default true
);

create table if not exists reviews (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  quote text not null,
  author text not null,
  rating int check (rating between 1 and 5),
  status text default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','approved','spam')),
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

create table if not exists faqs (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  question text not null,
  answer text not null,
  sort_order int default 0
);

create table if not exists settings (
  key text primary key,
  value text
);

create index if not exists items_category_available_idx on items (category_id, is_available);
```

## beardista-brew/supabase/migrations/002_policies.sql

```
-- Row Level Security: public reads, admins write

alter table categories enable row level security;
alter table items      enable row level security;
alter table events     enable row level security;
alter table reviews    enable row level security;
alter table faqs       enable row level security;
alter table settings   enable row level security;

-- Public read
drop policy if exists "read categories" on categories;
create policy "read categories" on categories for select using (true);

drop policy if exists "read items" on items;
create policy "read items" on items for select using (true);

drop policy if exists "read events" on events;
create policy "read events" on events for select using (is_active);

drop policy if exists "read faqs" on faqs;
create policy "read faqs" on faqs for select using (true);

drop policy if exists "read approved reviews" on reviews;
create policy "read approved reviews" on reviews for select
  to anon, authenticated using (status = 'approved');

drop policy if exists "read settings" on settings;
create policy "read settings" on settings for select using (true);

-- Visitors may submit reviews, but only as pending
drop policy if exists "submit review" on reviews;
create policy "submit review" on reviews for insert
  to anon, authenticated with check (status = 'pending');

-- Admins (logged-in users) write everything
drop policy if exists "admin all categories" on categories;
create policy "admin all categories" on categories for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);

drop policy if exists "admin all items" on items;
create policy "admin all items" on items for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);

drop policy if exists "admin all events" on events;
create policy "admin all events" on events for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);

drop policy if exists "admin all reviews" on reviews;
create policy "admin all reviews" on reviews for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);

drop policy if exists "admin all faqs" on faqs;
create policy "admin all faqs" on faqs for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);

drop policy if exists "admin all settings" on settings;
create policy "admin all settings" on settings for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);
```

## beardista-brew/supabase/migrations/005_events.sql

```
alter table public.events
  add column if not exists location text,
  add column if not exists start_time timestamptz,
  add column if not exists end_time timestamptz,
  add column if not exists capacity integer,
  add column if not exists status text,
  add column if not exists created_at timestamptz not null default now();

update public.events
set status = case when is_active then 'upcoming' else 'cancelled' end
where status is null;

alter table public.events
  alter column status set default 'upcoming',
  alter column status set not null;

alter table public.events
  add constraint events_status_check
    check (status in ('draft', 'upcoming', 'completed', 'cancelled')),
  add constraint events_capacity_check
    check (capacity is null or capacity > 0),
  add constraint events_end_time_check
    check (end_time is null or start_time is null or end_time > start_time);

create or replace function public.sync_event_active_status()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if new.status = 'upcoming' and not new.is_active then
      new.status := 'cancelled';
    end if;
    new.is_active := new.status in ('upcoming', 'completed');
  elsif new.status is distinct from old.status then
    new.is_active := new.status in ('upcoming', 'completed');
  elsif new.is_active is distinct from old.is_active then
    new.status := case when new.is_active then 'upcoming' else 'cancelled' end;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists sync_event_active_status on public.events;
create trigger sync_event_active_status
  before insert or update of is_active, status on public.events
  for each row execute function public.sync_event_active_status();

create table if not exists public.event_registrations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  event_id bigint not null references public.events(id) on delete cascade,
  user_email text not null,
  full_name text not null,
  phone text,
  status text not null default 'pending'
    check (status in ('pending', 'confirmed', 'waitlisted', 'cancelled')),
  verification_code text,
  verification_attempts integer not null default 0,
  verification_expires_at timestamptz,
  verification_sent_at timestamptz,
  is_verified boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create unique index if not exists event_registrations_active_email_idx
  on public.event_registrations (event_id, lower(user_email))
  where status <> 'cancelled';

create index if not exists event_registrations_event_status_idx
  on public.event_registrations (event_id, status, is_verified);

alter table public.events enable row level security;
alter table public.event_registrations enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "read events" on public.events;
drop policy if exists "admin all events" on public.events;
drop policy if exists "active staff all events" on public.events;
drop policy if exists "events public read" on public.events;
drop policy if exists "events staff all" on public.events;
create policy "events public read" on public.events
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (status <> 'draft');

create policy "events staff all" on public.events
  for all to authenticated
  using ((select public.is_staff()))
  with check ((select public.is_staff()));

drop policy if exists "event registrations public insert" on public.event_registrations;
create policy "event registrations public insert" on public.event_registrations
  for insert to anon, authenticated
  with check (
    status = 'pending'
    and not is_verified
    and verification_code is null
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.events
      where id = event_id and status = 'upcoming'
    )
  );

drop policy if exists "event registrations staff all" on public.event_registrations;
create policy "event registrations staff all" on public.event_registrations
  for all to authenticated
  using ((select public.is_staff()))
  with check ((select public.is_staff()));

create or replace function public.create_event_registration(
  p_event_id bigint,
  p_user_email text,
  p_full_name text,
  p_phone text,
  p_verification_code text
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_event_status text;
  v_registration public.event_registrations%rowtype;
begin
  select status
  into v_event_status
  from public.events
  where id = p_event_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_event_status <> 'upcoming' then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'Event is not open for registration';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_registration
  from public.event_registrations
  where event_id = p_event_id
    and lower(user_email) = lower(p_user_email)
    and status <> 'cancelled'
  for update;

  if found then
    if v_registration.is_verified or v_registration.status <> 'pending' then
      raise exception using errcode = '23505', message = 'This email is already registered for the event';
    end if;
    if v_registration.verification_sent_at > pg_catalog.now() - interval '1 minute' then
      raise exception using errcode = '55000', message = 'Please wait before requesting another code';
    end if;

    update public.event_registrations
    set verification_code = p_verification_code,
        verification_attempts = 0,
        verification_expires_at = pg_catalog.now() + interval '15 minutes',
        verification_sent_at = pg_catalog.now()
    where id = v_registration.id
    returning * into v_registration;
  else
    insert into public.event_registrations (
      event_id,
      user_email,
      full_name,
      phone,
      verification_code,
      verification_expires_at,
      verification_sent_at
    )
    values (
      p_event_id,
      lower(p_user_email),
      p_full_name,
      p_phone,
      p_verification_code,
      pg_catalog.now() + interval '15 minutes',
      pg_catalog.now()
    )
    returning * into v_registration;
  end if;

  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_registration.id,
    'eventId', p_event_id,
    'userEmail', v_registration.user_email,
    'fullName', v_registration.full_name
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_event_registration(bigint, text, text, text, text) from public;
grant execute on function public.create_event_registration(bigint, text, text, text, text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.verify_event_registration(
  p_registration_id uuid,
  p_verification_code text
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_event_id bigint;
  v_capacity integer;
  v_event_status text;
  v_registration public.event_registrations%rowtype;
  v_event_title text;
  v_confirmed_count integer;
  v_registration_status text;
  v_attempts integer;
begin
  select event_id
  into v_event_id
  from public.event_registrations
  where id = p_registration_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'Registration not found';
  end if;

  select capacity, title, status
  into v_capacity, v_event_title, v_event_status
  from public.events
  where id = v_event_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_event_status <> 'upcoming' then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Event is not open for registration';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_registration
  from public.event_registrations
  where id = p_registration_id
  for update;

  if v_registration.status = 'cancelled' then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Registration was cancelled';
  end if;

  if v_registration.verification_code is distinct from p_verification_code then
    if v_registration.is_verified then
      return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'Invalid verification code');
    end if;

    if v_registration.verification_expires_at is null
      or v_registration.verification_expires_at <= pg_catalog.now() then
      update public.event_registrations
      set verification_code = null
      where id = p_registration_id;
      return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'Verification code expired');
    end if;

    if v_registration.verification_attempts >= 5 then
      return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'Too many verification attempts');
    end if;

    v_attempts := v_registration.verification_attempts + 1;
    update public.event_registrations
    set verification_attempts = v_attempts,
        verification_code = case when v_attempts >= 5 then null else verification_code end
    where id = p_registration_id;
    return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'error',
      case when v_attempts >= 5
        then 'Too many verification attempts'
        else 'Invalid verification code'
      end
    );
  end if;

  if v_registration.is_verified then
    v_registration_status := v_registration.status;
  else
    if v_registration.verification_expires_at is null
      or v_registration.verification_expires_at <= pg_catalog.now() then
      update public.event_registrations
      set verification_code = null
      where id = p_registration_id;
      return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'Verification code expired');
    end if;

    if v_registration.verification_attempts >= 5 then
      return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'Too many verification attempts');
    end if;

    select count(*)::integer
    into v_confirmed_count
    from public.event_registrations
    where event_id = v_event_id
      and status = 'confirmed'
      and is_verified;

    v_registration_status := case
      when v_capacity is null or v_confirmed_count < v_capacity then 'confirmed'
      else 'waitlisted'
    end;

    update public.event_registrations
    set is_verified = true, status = v_registration_status
    where id = p_registration_id;
  end if;

  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_registration.id,
    'eventId', v_event_id,
    'eventTitle', v_event_title,
    'userEmail', v_registration.user_email,
    'fullName', v_registration.full_name,
    'status', v_registration_status
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.verify_event_registration(uuid, text) from public;
grant execute on function public.verify_event_registration(uuid, text) to service_role;
```

## beardista-brew/supabase/migrations/008_feedback.sql

```
alter table public.reviews
  add column if not exists comment text,
  add column if not exists customer_name text,
  add column if not exists is_published boolean not null default false;

update public.reviews
set comment = coalesce(comment, quote),
    customer_name = coalesce(customer_name, author),
    is_published = status = 'approved';

alter table public.reviews
  alter column comment set not null,
  alter column customer_name set not null;

create or replace function public.sync_review_legacy_fields()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    new.comment := coalesce(new.comment, new.quote);
    new.quote := coalesce(new.quote, new.comment);
    new.customer_name := coalesce(new.customer_name, new.author);
    new.author := coalesce(new.author, new.customer_name);
    new.is_published := new.is_published or new.status = 'approved';
  else
    if new.comment is distinct from old.comment then
      new.quote := new.comment;
    elsif new.quote is distinct from old.quote then
      new.comment := new.quote;
    end if;

    if new.customer_name is distinct from old.customer_name then
      new.author := new.customer_name;
    elsif new.author is distinct from old.author then
      new.customer_name := new.author;
    end if;

    if new.is_published is distinct from old.is_published then
      new.status := case when new.is_published then 'approved' else 'pending' end;
    elsif new.status is distinct from old.status then
      new.is_published := new.status = 'approved';
    end if;
  end if;

  if new.is_published then
    new.status := 'approved';
  elsif new.status = 'approved' then
    new.status := 'pending';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists sync_review_legacy_fields on public.reviews;
create trigger sync_review_legacy_fields
  before insert or update of quote, author, status, comment, customer_name, is_published
  on public.reviews
  for each row execute function public.sync_review_legacy_fields();

create table if not exists public.surveys (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title text not null,
  questions jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.survey_responses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  survey_id uuid not null references public.surveys(id) on delete cascade,
  answers jsonb not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists survey_responses_survey_created_idx
  on public.survey_responses (survey_id, created_at desc);

  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (is_published);

create policy "reviews public submit" on public.reviews
  for insert to anon, authenticated
  with check (
    not is_published
    and status = 'pending'
    and rating between 1 and 5
    and length(trim(comment)) > 0
    and length(trim(customer_name)) > 0
  );

      from public.surveys

    )
  );

create or replace function public.get_dashboard_analytics()
returns table (
  total_sales numeric,
  active_menu_items_count bigint,
  upcoming_events_count bigint,
  average_rating numeric
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not (select public.is_staff()) then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Active staff access required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    0::numeric,
    (
      select count(*) from public.menu_items
      where is_available
    ),
    (
      select count(*) from public.events
      where is_active
    ),
    (
      select avg(rating)::numeric from public.reviews
      where is_published
    );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.get_dashboard_analytics() from public;
grant execute on function public.get_dashboard_analytics() to authenticated;
```
